context.en-US: ABT-263 inhibits Bcl-2. ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor to ABT-737 whose Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The relationship is directional, with ABT-263 acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-2 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: ABT-263 抑制 Bcl-2。 ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物利用型後繼者，其 Bcl-xL 抑製作用會導致標靶血小板減少症。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-263 充當 Bcl-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: ABT-263 causes Thrombocytopenia. ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor to ABT-737 whose Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia. Thrombocytopenia is an abnormally low platelet count that, when caused by Bcl-xL inhibition, reflects the dependence of platelets on that survival protein. The relationship is directional, with ABT-263 acting as the operative agent upon Thrombocytopenia rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: ABT-263 導致Thrombocytopenia。 ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物利用型後繼者，其 Bcl-xL 抑製作用會導致標靶血小板減少症。 Thrombocytopenia 是異常低的血小板計數，當由 Bcl-xL 抑制引起時，反映了血小板對此存活蛋白的依賴性。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-263 充當 Thrombocytopenia 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: ABT-737 inhibits Bcl-2. ABT-737 is a pioneering pan-BH3 mimetic that binds Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Bcl-w but spares Mcl-1. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The relationship is directional, with ABT-737 acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-2 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: ABT-737 抑制 Bcl-2。 ABT-737 是一種開創性的泛 BH3 類似物，它結合 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w，但保留 Mcl-1。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-737 充當 Bcl-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: ABT-737 inhibits Bcl-xL. ABT-737 is a pioneering pan-BH3 mimetic that binds Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, and Bcl-w but spares Mcl-1. Bcl-xL is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein that maintains mitochondrial integrity and is essential for platelet and many tumor-cell survival. The relationship is directional, with ABT-737 acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-xL rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: ABT-737 抑制 Bcl-xL。 ABT-737 是一種開創性的泛 BH3 類似物，它結合 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w，但保留 Mcl-1。 Bcl-xL 是一種抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，可維持粒線體完整性，對於血小板和許多腫瘤細胞的存活至關重要。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-737 充當 Bcl-xL 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Resistance to ABT-737 is commonly driven by Mcl-1, a pro-survival Bcl-2 family protein that ABT-737 does not inhibit. Because Mcl-1 remains available to bind and sequester pro-apoptotic effectors, MOMP is not fully engaged. The relationship is directional and defines a specific, targetable vulnerability rather than a general failure. Co-targeting Mcl-1 restores the apoptotic commitment that ABT-737 alone cannot achieve.
context.zh-TW: 對 ABT-737 的抗性通常由 Mcl-1 驅動，這是 ABT-737 不抑制的一種促生存 Bcl-2 family 蛋白。由於 Mcl-1 仍可結合和隔離促凋亡效應子，因此 MOMP 並未完全發揮作用。這種關係是定向的，定義了特定的、可針對的漏洞，而不是一般的故障。共同靶向 Mcl-1 恢復了單獨 ABT-737 無法實現的凋亡承諾。

context.en-US: DNMT3a-mutant clones are frequently detectable in preleukemic states, linking age-associated clonal hematopoiesis to overt acute myeloid leukemia. These clones can persist in the bone marrow years before diagnosis and survive chemotherapy, seeding relapse. Clonal hematopoiesis is thus a precursor state for AML.
context.zh-TW: DNMT3a 突變克隆常在前白血病狀態中可被偵測到，將年齡相關的克隆性造血與明顯的急性骨髓性白血病連結起來。這些克隆可在診斷前數年持續存在於骨髓中，並在化療後存活，播下復發的種子。因此克隆性造血是 AML 的前驅狀態。

context.en-US: Recurrent mutations in the DNA methyltransferase DNMT3a occur in approximately 20% of acute myeloid leukemia cases, with the R882H hotspot most frequent. These mutations reduce methyltransferase activity and disrupt DNA methylation at regulatory regions controlling stem cell behavior. This epigenetic dysregulation cooperates with other mutations to drive leukemogenesis.
context.zh-TW: DNA 甲基轉移酶 DNMT3a 的反覆突變發生在約 20% 的急性骨髓性白血病病例中，其中 R882H 熱點最常見。這些突變降低甲基轉移酶活性，並擾亂控制幹細胞行為的調控區域之 DNA 甲基化。這種表觀遺傳失調與其他突變合作驅動白血病發生。

context.en-US: Acute myeloid leukemia arises through the sequential acquisition of mutations in hematopoietic stem cells, the cell of origin where DNMT3A mutations arise and persist as preleukemic clones. This origin in stem cells underlies the clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts. Targeting the mutant clone rather than only the blast population is a key therapeutic rationale.
context.zh-TW: 急性骨髓性白血病透過造血幹細胞中突變的依序獲得而發生，造血幹細胞是 DNMT3A 突變產生並以白血病前克隆持續存在的起源細胞。這種起源於幹細胞的性質是不成熟骨髓母細胞克隆擴張的基礎。靶向突變克隆而非僅針對母細胞族群是關鍵的治療依據。

context.en-US: Acute myeloid leukemia is the most common acute leukemia in adults and belongs to the broader disease category of leukemia. It is characterized by clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts that fail to differentiate. AML is a distinct subtype within the leukemia family.
context.zh-TW: 急性骨髓性白血病是成人中最常見的急性白血病，屬於更廣泛的白血病疾病類別。其特徵是不成熟骨髓母細胞的克隆擴張且未能分化。AML 是白血病家族中的一個獨特亞型。

context.en-US: p53 is among the cooperating mutations that drive leukemogenesis in acute myeloid leukemia alongside DNMT3a, FLT3, NPM1, and IDH. Mutational status of TP53 informs risk stratification and is associated with adverse-risk AML and chemotherapy resistance. p53 alterations contribute to the genetic complexity of AML.
context.zh-TW: p53 是與 DNMT3a、FLT3、NPM1 和 IDH 並列、驅動急性骨髓性白血病白血病發生的合作突變之一。TP53 的突變狀態指導風險分層，並與不良風險 AML 和化療抗性有關。p53 改變促成 AML 的基因複雜性。

context.en-US: AIF induces chromatin condensation. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Chromatin condensation is a terminal morphologic hallmark of death in which DNA is compacted, classically by caspase or AIF action. The relationship is directional, with AIF acting as the operative agent upon chromatin condensation rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: AIF 誘發chromatin condensation。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 chromatin condensation 是死亡的終末形態學標誌，其中 DNA 被壓縮，通常是透過 caspase 或 AIF 作用實現的。這種關係是有方向的，AIF 充當 chromatin condensation 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: AIF relates to MOMP through the relation is_released_from. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: AIF 透過關係式 is_released_from 與 MOMP 相關。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: ALIX regulates EGFR. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon EGFR rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: ALIX調節EGFR。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 EGFR 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: ALIX regulates Exosomes. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. Exosomes are nanovesicles shed by tumor cells that traffic immune-checkpoint ligands and growth signals within the microenvironment. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon Exosomes rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: ALIX 調節 Exosomes。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 Exosomes 是腫瘤細胞脫落的奈米囊泡，在微環境中傳遞免疫檢查點配體和生長訊號。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 Exosomes 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: ALIX regulates PD-L1. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon PD-L1 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: ALIX 調節 PD-L1。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 PD-L1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

subject: Apoptosis

context.en-US: Apoptosis is inhibited by Bcl-2. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 toward Apoptosis, so Bcl-2 is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 被 Bcl-2 抑制。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。方向性從 Bcl-2 朝向 Apoptosis，因此 Bcl-2 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is restored by BH3 mimetics. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward Apoptosis, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 由 BH3 mimetics 恢復。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從 BH3 mimetics 朝向 Apoptosis，因此 BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosis converges at Common Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The common execution phase of apoptosis is the point at which all initiation routes converge on effector caspases that proteolyze the cellular proteome. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Common Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 收斂於 Common Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的共同執行階段是所有起始途徑匯聚到效應器半胱天冬酶上的點，該效應器半胱天冬酶對細胞蛋白質組進行蛋白質分解。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Common Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosis has the pathway Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 有路徑 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Apoptosis has the pathway Extrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Extrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Extrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Extrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is induced by Fenbendazole. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. The directionality runs from Fenbendazole toward Apoptosis, so Fenbendazole is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 由 Fenbendazole 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。方向性從 Fenbendazole 向 Apoptosis，因此 Fenbendazole 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is induced by Gossypol. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. The directionality runs from Gossypol toward Apoptosis, so Gossypol is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 由 Gossypol 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。方向性從 Gossypol 向 Apoptosis，因此 Gossypol 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Resisting cell death, and apoptosis in particular, is enumerated as one of the original hallmarks of cancer. By disabling the apoptotic machinery, tumor cells tolerate genomic instability and survive therapies that depend on death execution. The relationship is directional: loss of apoptosis enables cancer rather than cancer instructing the loss. Most cytotoxic and targeted agents ultimately require restoration of apoptosis to succeed.
context.zh-TW: 抵抗細胞死亡，特別是細胞凋亡，被列為原始Hallmarks of Cancer之一。透過禁用凋亡機制，腫瘤細胞可以耐受基因組不穩定性並在依賴死亡執行的治療中存活下來。這種關係是方向性的：細胞凋亡的喪失會引發癌症，而不是癌症導致細胞凋亡。大多數細胞毒性藥物和標靶藥物最終需要恢復細胞凋亡才能成功。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is inhibited by Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The directionality runs from Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins toward Apoptosis, so Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 被 Apoptosis 抑制。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。方向性從Apoptosis向Apoptosis延伸，因此Apoptosis是活性劑，Apoptosis是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Apoptosis has the pathway Intrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Intrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Intrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Intrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is induced by Ivermectin. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Apoptosis, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 由 Ivermectin 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 Apoptosis，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is induced by melittin. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward Apoptosis, so melittin is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 由 melittin 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 向 Apoptosis，因此 melittin 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is induced by TRAIL. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The directionality runs from TRAIL toward Apoptosis, so TRAIL is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 由 TRAIL 誘發。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。方向性從 TRAIL 向 Apoptosis，因此 TRAIL 是主動主體，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosome is composed of Apaf-1. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Apaf-1 is the scaffolding adaptor of the apoptosome, containing CARD, NB-ARC, and WD40 domains that bind cytochrome c and recruit procaspase-9. The directionality runs from Apaf-1 toward Apoptosome, so Apaf-1 is the active agent and Apoptosome the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome由Apaf-1組成。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Apaf-1 是凋亡體的支架接頭，包含結合 Cytochrome c 並募集 procaspase-9 的 CARD、NB-ARC 和 WD40 結構域。方向性從 Apaf-1 朝向 Apoptosome，因此 Apaf-1 是活性劑，Apoptosome 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Apoptosome is prevented by Bcl-2. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 toward Apoptosome, so Bcl-2 is the active agent and Apoptosome the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome 被 Bcl-2 阻止。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。方向性從 Bcl-2 朝向 Apoptosome，因此 Bcl-2 是活性劑，Apoptosome 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Apoptosome activates Caspase-3. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosome acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome 啟動 Caspase-3。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosome 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosome activates Caspase-9. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosome acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-9 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome 啟動 Caspase-9。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosome 充當 Caspase-9 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosome is triggered by Cytochrome c. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. Cytochrome c is an electron-carrier of the respiratory chain that, once released to the cytosol, nucleates apoptosome assembly. The directionality runs from Cytochrome c toward Apoptosome, so Cytochrome c is the active agent and Apoptosome the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome 由Cytochrome c 觸發。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 Cytochrome c 是呼吸鏈的電子載體，一旦釋放到細胞質中，就會使凋亡體組裝成核。方向性從 Cytochrome c 朝向 Apoptosome，因此 Cytochrome c 是活性劑，Apoptosome 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Apoptosome is inhibited by XIAP. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Apoptosome, so XIAP is the active agent and Apoptosome the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosome 被 XIAP 抑制。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Apoptosome，因此 XIAP 是活性劑，Apoptosome 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: AKT phosphorylates ASK1 at Ser83, which suppresses ASK1 activity and promotes cell survival. This inhibitory phosphorylation adds a survival-oriented regulatory layer on top of redox control. It illustrates how growth-factor and stress signaling converge antagonistically on ASK1.
context.zh-TW: AKT 在 Ser83 磷酸化 ASK1，這會抑制 ASK1 活性並促進細胞存活。此抑制性磷酸化在氧化還原調控之上增添了以存活為導向的調控層。這說明生長因子與壓力訊號如何以拮抗方式匯聚於 ASK1。

context.en-US: In Alzheimer's disease, ASK1-JNK signaling drives Tau hyperphosphorylation and mediates the toxicity of A-beta peptide. This positions the ASK1-JNK axis as a contributor to neurodegeneration. ASK1 inhibition has therefore been explored as a neuroprotective strategy.
context.zh-TW: 在阿茲海默症中，ASK1–JNK 訊號傳導驅動 Tau 過度磷酸化，並調節 A-beta 胜肽的毒性。這使 ASK1–JNK 軸成為神經退化的促成因素。因此 ASK1 抑制已被探索為神經保護策略。

context.en-US: ASK1 activation propagates through the JNK and p38 MAPK cascades to engage the intrinsic apoptosis machinery. In ischemia-reperfusion injury, ASK1 activation leads to cardiomyocyte and neuronal apoptosis, and ASK1-deficient mice show reduced infarct size. ASK1 thereby couples environmental stress to apoptotic outcomes.
context.zh-TW: ASK1 的激活經由 JNK 和 p38 MAPK 級聯傳導，進而啟動內源性細胞凋亡機制。在缺血再灌流損傷中，ASK1 激活導致心肌細胞與神經元凋亡，而 ASK1 缺陷小鼠的梗塞面積較小。因此 ASK1 將環境壓力與細胞凋亡結果連結起來。

context.en-US: ASK1 phosphorylates and activates the dual-specificity MAP2Ks MKK4 and MKK7, which in turn activate JNK. ASK1 sits upstream of the JNK cascade and links diverse cellular stressors to JNK-dependent transcription. This makes ASK1 a central conduit for stress-induced JNK signaling that governs inflammation, apoptosis, and cell survival.
context.zh-TW: ASK1 磷酸化並激活雙特異性 MAP2K（MKK4 和 MKK7），後者進而激活 JNK。ASK1 位於 JNK 級聯上游，將各種細胞壓力與 JNK 依賴性轉錄連結起來。這使 ASK1 成為壓力誘導之 JNK 訊號傳導的核心通道，調控發炎、細胞凋亡與細胞存活。

context.en-US: Under basal conditions reduced Thioredoxin-1 binds ASK1 and holds it inactive. During oxidative stress, elevated ROS oxidize Thioredoxin-1, causing its dissociation from ASK1 and permitting ASK1 dimerization and activation. This makes oxidative stress a primary, receptor-independent activator of ASK1.
context.zh-TW: 在基礎條件下，還原態的 Thioredoxin-1 與 ASK1 結合並使其保持不活化。在氧化壓力期間，升高的 ROS 會氧化 Thioredoxin-1，使其與 ASK1 分離，進而允許 ASK1 二聚化並激活。這使氧化壓力成為 ASK1 的主要、不依賴受體的激活因子。

context.en-US: ASK1 phosphorylates and activates MKK3 and MKK6, the upstream MAP2Ks that activate p38 MAPK. This places ASK1 at a bottleneck position in stress-responsive MAPK signaling. ASK1-p38 signaling is implicated in dopaminergic neuron death in Parkinson's disease and in hepatic metabolic dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: ASK1 磷酸化並激活 MKK3 和 MKK6，也就是激活 p38 MAPK 的上游 MAP2K。這使 ASK1 位於壓力反應性 MAPK 訊號傳導的瓶頸位置。ASK1–p38 訊號傳導與帕金森氏症中的多巴胺神經元死亡以及肝臟代謝功能障礙有關。

context.en-US: Reduced Thioredoxin-1 binds the N-terminal domain of ASK1, maintaining the kinase in an inactive monomeric state. Oxidation of Thioredoxin-1 during oxidative stress releases ASK1 from this inhibition. Thioredoxin-1 thus functions as a key redox-sensitive inhibitor of ASK1 activity.
context.zh-TW: 還原態的 Thioredoxin-1 與 ASK1 的 N 端結構域結合，使激酶維持在不活化的單體狀態。在氧化壓力期間，Thioredoxin-1 的氧化會使 ASK1 脫離此抑制。因此 Thioredoxin-1 是 ASK1 活性的關鍵氧化還原敏感性抑制因子。

context.en-US: ASK1 is activated by TNF-alpha. TNF-α signaling engages TNFR1, which recruits TRADD, TRAF2, and TRAF6; these adaptors promote ASK1 activation, placing ASK1 downstream of TNF-α and upstream of the JNK and p38 MAPK cascades. The relationship is directional: TNF-α acts as the upstream trigger and ASK1 as the responding stress kinase.
context.zh-TW: ASK1 會被 TNF-alpha 活化。TNF-α 訊息傳遞會接合 TNFR1，並招募 TRADD、TRAF2 和 TRAF6；這些銜接蛋白會促進 ASK1 的活化，使 ASK1 位於 TNF-α 下游、JNK 與 p38 MAPK 級聯的上游。此關係具有方向性：TNF-α 是上游觸發訊號，ASK1 是反應的壓力激酶。

context.en-US: In lung and colon cancer models, deletion or silencing of ASK1 accelerates KRAS-driven tumorigenesis, supporting a tumor-suppressive function. Loss of ASK1 impairs stress-induced apoptosis, allowing oncogenic clones to survive genotoxic and oxidative insults. The relationship is context-dependent, since persistent ASK1 activation may also drive inflammation-associated tumor promotion.
context.zh-TW: 在肺癌和結腸癌模型中，刪除或沉默 ASK1 會加速 KRAS 驅動的腫瘤發生，支持其腫瘤抑制功能。ASK1 缺失會損害壓力誘導的細胞凋亡，使致癌性克隆得以在基因毒性與氧化傷害中存活。此關係具有情境依賴性，因為持續的 ASK1 激活也可能驅動與發炎相關的腫瘤促進。

context.en-US: ATM phosphorylates BRCA1 to coordinate DNA repair and maintain genome integrity after double-strand breaks. This connects ATM activation to homologous-recombination repair. BRCA1 is thus a downstream ATM substrate in the damage-response network.
context.zh-TW: ATM 磷酸化 BRCA1，以在雙股斷裂後協調 DNA 修復並維持基因體完整性。這將 ATM 激活與同源重組修復連結起來。因此 BRCA1 是損傷反應網路中 ATM 的下游受質。

context.en-US: Activation of ATM by DNA double-strand breaks initiates cell-cycle arrest, a principal functional output of the kinase. Through CHK2 and p53, ATM enforces arrest that provides time for repair. This makes ATM a master coordinator of the damage checkpoint.
context.zh-TW: ATM 因 DNA 雙股斷裂而激活，進而啟動細胞週期停滯，這是該激酶的主要功能性輸出。透過 CHK2 和 p53，ATM 強制實施停滯，為修復爭取時間。這使 ATM 成為損傷檢查點的主要協調者。

context.en-US: Activated ATM phosphorylates the checkpoint kinase CHK2, which propagates the DNA-damage checkpoint signal. This cascade initiates cell-cycle arrest and coordinates the damage response. CHK2 is thus a direct downstream substrate of ATM.
context.zh-TW: 激活的 ATM 磷酸化檢查點激酶 CHK2，進而傳播 DNA 損傷檢查點訊號。此級聯啟動細胞週期停滯並協調損傷反應。因此 CHK2 是 ATM 的直接下游受質。

context.en-US: ATM orchestrates the cellular DNA-repair response to double-strand breaks by phosphorylating downstream effectors including CHK2, p53, and BRCA1. This coordinates repair processes that restore genome integrity. ATM thereby functions as the master coordinator of the DNA-damage response.
context.zh-TW: ATM 透過磷酸化 CHK2、p53 和 BRCA1 等下游效應因子，協調對雙股斷裂的細胞 DNA 修復反應。這協調了恢復基因體完整性的修復過程。因此 ATM 是 DNA 損傷反應的主要協調者。

context.en-US: Ionizing radiation causes DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM at the site of damage, converting it to an active monomer. This makes ionizing radiation a primary exogenous trigger for ATM activation. Activated ATM then coordinates cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 游離輻射會造成 DNA 雙股斷裂，在損傷處招募並使 ATM 自體磷酸化，將其轉化為活化的單體。這使游離輻射成為 ATM 激活的主要外源性觸發因子。激活的 ATM 隨後協調細胞週期停滯、修復與細胞凋亡。

context.en-US: ATM also responds to oxidative stress and replication stress, so its activation is not uniquely radiation-driven. This broader activation means ATM sits at the nexus of multiple genotoxic and metabolic stresses. It expands the physiological role of ATM beyond ionizing radiation.
context.zh-TW: ATM 也會對氧化壓力和複製壓力作出反應，因此其激活並非僅由輻射驅動。這種更廣泛的激活意味著 ATM 位於多種基因毒性與代謝壓力的交會點。這擴展了 ATM 在游離輻射之外的生理角色。

context.en-US: ATM phosphorylates the tumor suppressor p53 as part of the DNA-damage response. This stabilizes and activates p53, which mediates cell-cycle arrest and, when damage is irreparable, apoptosis. p53 is therefore a key downstream effector of ATM signaling.
context.zh-TW: ATM 在 DNA 損傷反應中磷酸化腫瘤抑制因子 p53。這會穩定並激活 p53，後者調節細胞週期停滯，並在損傷不可修復時促進細胞凋亡。因此 p53 是 ATM 訊號傳導的關鍵下游效應因子。

context.en-US: ATM functions as a tumor suppressor; its loss drives genomic instability and predisposes to lymphoid malignancies and solid tumors. Loss-of-function mutations cause ataxia-telangiectasia, a syndrome of neurodegeneration, immunodeficiency, and cancer predisposition. ATM inhibitors are explored clinically as radiosensitizers and via synthetic lethality.
context.zh-TW: ATM 具有腫瘤抑制功能；其缺失會驅動基因體不穩定，並易導致淋巴惡性腫瘤與實體腫瘤。功能缺失突變會造成毛細血管擴張性運動失調症，這是一種以神經退化、免疫缺陷與癌症易感性為特徵的症候群。ATM 抑制劑在臨床上被探索作為放射增敏劑並利用合成致死機制。

context.en-US: Avermectin's derivative ivermectin is under active preclinical investigation for anticancer repositioning (Wnt/beta-catenin, AKT/mTOR and PAK1 inhibition; apoptosis; multidrug-resistance reversal).
context.zh-TW: Avermectin 的衍生物伊維菌素正在積極進行抗癌重新定位的臨牀前研究（Wnt/β-連環蛋白、AKT/mTOR 和 PAK1 抑制；細胞凋亡；逆轉多重抗藥性）。

context.en-US: Avermectins also potentiate invertebrate GABA-gated chloride channels; vertebrate GABA_A receptors require roughly 100-fold higher concentrations, underpinning selective safety.
context.zh-TW: Avermectins 也能增強無脊椎動物 GABA-gated chloride channels；脊椎動物 GABA_A 受體需要約高出 100 倍的濃度，以確保選擇性安全。

context.en-US: Avermectins are allosteric potentiators/agonists of invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls); Cl- influx hyperpolarizes and paralyzes parasites.
context.zh-TW: 是無脊椎動物穀氨酸門控氯離子通道 (GluCls) 的變構增強劑/激動劑； Cl-流入使寄生蟲超極化並麻痺。

context.en-US: Avermectin B1a is the natural macrocyclic-lactone precursor of ivermectin (22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a), the semi-synthetic lead derivative developed for human and veterinary medicine.
context.zh-TW: Avermectin B1a 是伊維菌素（22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a）的天然大環內酯前體，伊維菌素是為人類和獸醫開發的半合成先導衍生物。

context.en-US: Avermectin was discovered from a soil actinomycete isolated at the Kitasato Institute; the lead strain yielded the ivermectin precursor.
context.zh-TW: Avermectin 是從 Kitasato Institute 分離的土壤放線菌中發現的；主要菌株產生伊維菌素前驅物。

context.en-US: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
context.zh-TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

context.en-US: Bad is inhibited by Akt. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The directionality runs from Akt toward Bad, so Akt is the active agent and Bad the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Bad 被 Akt 抑制。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 Akt 向 Bad，因此 Akt 是主動主體，Bad 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Bad is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bad, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bad the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bad 是 Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從 Bcl-2 family 向 Bad，因此 Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bad 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bad binds Bcl-w. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Bcl-w is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member overexpressed in several carcinomas and hematologic malignancies where it blunts chemotherapy-induced death. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-w rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Bad 綁定 Bcl-w。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-w 是一種抗凋亡 Bcl-2 family 成員，在多種癌症和血液惡性腫瘤中過度表達，可減少化療引起的死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Bcl-w 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Bad binds Bcl-xL. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Bcl-xL is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein that maintains mitochondrial integrity and is essential for platelet and many tumor-cell survival. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-xL rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Bad 綁定 Bcl-xL。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-xL 是一種抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，可維持粒線體完整性，對於血小板和許多腫瘤細胞的存活至關重要。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Bcl-xL 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Bad promotes Intrinsic Pathway. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Intrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Bad 促進Intrinsic Pathway。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Intrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Bad is inhibited by PAK1. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. The directionality runs from PAK1 toward Bad, so PAK1 is the active agent and Bad the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Bad 被 PAK1 抑制。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 PAK1 向 Bad，因此 PAK1 是主動主體，Bad 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family includes Bak. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bak rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 包括 Bak。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當 Bak 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family includes Bax. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bax is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector that, upon activation, oligomerizes to form the pores that permeabilize the mitochondrial outer membrane. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bax rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 包括Bax。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bax 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，活化後會寡聚形成使粒線體外膜通透的孔。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當Bax 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family includes Bcl-2. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-2 rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 包括Bcl-2。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當 Bcl-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family includes Bcl-xL. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bcl-xL is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein that maintains mitochondrial integrity and is essential for platelet and many tumor-cell survival. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-xL rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 包括 Bcl-xL。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bcl-xL 是一種抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，可維持粒線體完整性，對於血小板和許多腫瘤細胞的存活至關重要。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當 Bcl-xL 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family includes Bid. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bid is a BH3-only protein cleaved by caspase-8 into truncated Bid, physically linking the extrinsic and intrinsic apoptotic routes. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bid rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 包括Bid。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bid 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，被 caspase-8 切割成截短的 Bid，在物理上連接外源性和內源性細胞凋亡途徑。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當Bid 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family includes Bim. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bim is a sentinel BH3-only protein sequestered at microtubules that is released by stress to directly activate Bax/Bak. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bim rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 包括Bim。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bim 是一種隔離在微管中的前哨 BH3 蛋白，壓力釋放時可直接活化 Bax/Bak。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當Bim 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family is dysregulated in Cancer. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Bcl-2 family, so Cancer is the active agent and Bcl-2 family the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 在 Cancer 中失調。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Bcl-2 family，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Bcl-2 family 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family includes Mcl-1. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Mcl-1 rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 包括Mcl-1。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當Mcl-1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bcl-2 family regulates MOMP. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon MOMP rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Bcl-2 family 調節 MOMP。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當 MOMP 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. The relationship is directional, with BH3 mimetics acting as the operative agent upon Gossypol rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.

The relationship is directional, with BH3 mimetics acting as the operative agent upon Mcl-1 rather than the reverse. This selective inactivity defines a specific vulnerability or resistance mechanism that must be addressed by additional co-targeting to achieve the desired biological effect.
context.zh-TW: BH3 mimetics 不綁定 Mcl-1。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。這種關係是有方向的，BH3 mimetics 充當Mcl-1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種選擇性不活動定義了特定的脆弱性或抗藥性機制，必須透過額外的共同標靶來解決該機制，以實現所需的生物效應。

context.en-US: BH3 mimetics relates to MOMP through the relation induce. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: BH3 mimetics 透過關係式與 MOMP 相關。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Bik activates Bak. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. The relationship is directional, with Bik acting as the operative agent upon Bak rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Bik 激活 Bak。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。這種關係是有方向的，Bik 充當 Bak 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Bik is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bik, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bik the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Bik 是Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從Bcl-2 family 向Bik 延伸，因此Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bik 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Bik is degraded by ERK. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. The directionality runs from ERK toward Bik, so ERK is the active agent and Bik the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Bik 被 ERK 降級。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。方向性從 ERK 朝向 Bik，因此 ERK 是主動主體，Bik 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Bik is degraded by SRC kinase. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. SRC is a non-receptor tyrosine kinase that promotes survival and, notably, phosphorylates and inactivates caspase-8 and Bik. The directionality runs from SRC kinase toward Bik, so SRC kinase is the active agent and Bik the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.

A tumor suppressor is a gene or protein whose loss of function removes a constraint on proliferation or death, fostering cancer. The relationship is directional, with Bik acting as the operative agent upon Tumor Suppressor rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.

context.en-US: Evasion of apoptosis is a hallmark of bladder cancer, contributing to chemoresistance. Cisplatin and BCG therapy induce urothelial carcinoma cell death in part through apoptotic mechanisms. Apoptosis pathways are therefore central to bladder cancer biology and treatment response.
context.zh-TW: 逃避細胞凋亡是膀胱癌的標誌，並促成化療抗性。Cisplatin 和 BCG 療法部分透過細胞凋亡機制誘導尿路上皮癌細胞死亡。因此細胞凋亡途徑對膀胱癌生物學與治療反應至關重要。

context.en-US: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
context.zh-TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

context.en-US: Cisplatin is central to neoadjuvant and first-line metastatic bladder cancer treatment as a DNA cross-linking agent that activates intrinsic apoptotic pathways. Neoadjuvant cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy followed by radical cystectomy is the standard of care for localized muscle-invasive disease. Cisplatin thus plays a central role in bladder cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 是膀胱癌新輔助與一線轉移治療的核心藥物，作為 DNA 交聯劑激活內源性細胞凋亡途徑。以順鉑為基礎的新輔助聯合化療後接續根除性膀胱切除術是局限性肌層浸潤疾病的標準治療。因此 Cisplatin 在膀胱癌治療中扮演核心角色。

context.en-US: p53 mutations are frequent in high-grade and muscle-invasive bladder cancer and are associated with genomic instability and progression. Loss of p53 function contributes to evasion of apoptosis, a hallmark of bladder cancer. p53 status is therefore relevant to bladder cancer biology and prognosis.
context.zh-TW: p53 突變在高惡性度與肌層浸潤性膀胱癌中很常見，並與基因體不穩定和進展有關。p53 功能喪失促成逃避細胞凋亡，這是膀胱癌的標誌。因此 p53 狀態與膀胱癌生物學和預後相關。

context.en-US: PD-L1 is a biomarker and therapeutic target for immune checkpoint inhibition in bladder cancer. Immune checkpoint inhibitors such as pembrolizumab and atezolizumab targeting PD-1/PD-L1 are approved for metastatic disease. PD-L1 status helps guide immunotherapy selection in bladder cancer.
context.zh-TW: PD-L1 是膀胱癌免疫檢查點抑制的生物標記與治療靶點。靶向 PD-1/PD-L1 的免疫檢查點抑制劑（如 pembrolizumab 和 atezolizumab）已獲批用於轉移性疾病。PD-L1 狀態有助於指導膀胱癌的免疫治療選擇。

context.en-US: Bmf is inhibited by ERK2. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. ERK2 is the predominant isoform of the ERK1/2 MAPK pair that transduces RAS-RAF-MEK output to nuclear and cytoplasmic targets. The directionality runs from ERK2 toward Bmf, so ERK2 is the active agent and Bmf the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.

context.en-US: Bmf suppresses Metastasis. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with Bmf acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Bmf 抑制 Metastasis。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，Bmf 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: BRCA predisposes to Breast Cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The relationship is directional, with BRCA acting as the operative agent upon Breast Cancer rather than the reverse. Such relationships underscore how inherited or intrinsic factors shape cancer susceptibility and inform risk-stratified screening and prevention.
context.zh-TW: BRCA 傾向於Breast Cancer。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。這種關係是有方向的，BRCA 充當 Breast Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種關係強調了遺傳或內在因素如何影響癌症易感性，並為風險分層篩檢和預防提供資訊。

context.en-US: BRCA repairs DNA Damage. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. DNA damage, particularly unrepaired double-strand breaks, is both a driver of mutagenesis and a trigger of p53-dependent tumor suppression. The relationship is directional, with BRCA acting as the operative agent upon DNA Damage rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: BRCA 維修DNA Damage。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。 DNA Damage，尤其是未修復的雙股斷裂，既是誘變的驅動因素，也是p53依賴性腫瘤抑制的觸發因素。這種關係是有方向的，BRCA 充當 DNA Damage 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: BRCA predisposes to ovarian cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. High-grade serous ovarian cancer is characterized by frequent BRCA1/2 dysfunction and exquisite sensitivity to platinum and PARP inhibition. The relationship is directional, with BRCA acting as the operative agent upon ovarian cancer rather than the reverse. Such relationships underscore how inherited or intrinsic factors shape cancer susceptibility and inform risk-stratified screening and prevention.

context.en-US: Ki-67 is expressed in all active phases of the cell cycle and absent in quiescent cells, making it a robust immunohistochemical readout of proliferation. A high Ki-67 labeling index correlates with aggressive biology and, in some tumors, informs adjuvant therapy decisions. The relationship is directional as a biomarker: proliferation evidences the tumor's growth fraction rather than causing it. It is particularly integrated into grading of breast and neuroendocrine neoplasms.
context.zh-TW: Ki-67 在細胞週期的所有活躍階段表達，但在靜止細胞中不存在，使其成為增殖的可靠免疫組織化學讀數。高 Ki-67 標記指數與侵襲性生物學相關，並且在某些腫瘤中可以為輔助治療決策提供資訊。作為生物標記，這種關係是有方向性的：增殖證明瞭腫瘤的生長分數，而不是導致腫瘤生長的原因。它特別被納入乳腺和神經內分泌腫瘤的分級。

context.en-US: Cancer is driven by MAPK. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades relay extracellular signals to transcriptional programs governing proliferation and stress responses. The directionality runs from MAPK toward Cancer, so MAPK is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由MAPK 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。絲裂原活化的蛋白激酶級聯將細胞外訊號傳遞至控制增殖和壓力反應的轉錄程序。方向性從 MAPK 朝向 Cancer，因此 MAPK 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer is treated by melittin. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward Cancer, so melittin is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由 melittin 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 朝向 Cancer，因此 melittin 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Cancer undergoes Metabolic Reprogramming. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Metabolic Reprogramming rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer經歷Metabolic Reprogramming。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Metabolic Reprogramming 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer is driven by mTOR. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. mTOR is a nutrient- and growth-factor-sensitive kinase that integrates PI3K/Akt inputs to control protein synthesis and cell growth. The directionality runs from mTOR toward Cancer, so mTOR is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.

context.en-US: Cancer is driven by NFκB. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The directionality runs from NFκB toward Cancer, so NFκB is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.

context.en-US: Cancer is treated by Nutlins. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward Cancer, so Nutlins is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由 Nutlins 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 Cancer，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Cancer is linked to Oxidative Stress. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Oxidative stress arises from an imbalance of reactive oxygen species and inflicts DNA, protein, and lipid damage that can initiate and promote malignancy. The directionality runs from Oxidative Stress toward Cancer, so Oxidative Stress is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 連結到Oxidative Stress。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Oxidative Stress 由活性氧失衡引起，會造成 DNA、蛋白質和脂質損傷，進而引發和促進惡性腫瘤。方向性從 Oxidative Stress 朝向 Cancer，因此 Oxidative Stress 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer is suppressed by p53. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The directionality runs from p53 toward Cancer, so p53 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 被p53 抑制。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。方向性從 p53 向 Cancer，因此 p53 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Cancer is driven by PI3K. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Phosphoinositide 3-kinase generates PIP3 at the membrane to recruit and activate Akt, a central node of growth and survival signaling. The directionality runs from PI3K toward Cancer, so PI3K is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由PI3K 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。磷酸肌醇 3-激酶在膜上產生 PIP3，以募集並活化 Akt（生長和生存訊號傳導的中心節點）。方向性從 PI3K 朝向 Cancer，因此 PI3K 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer is driven by STAT3. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. STAT3 is a latent transcription factor activated by JAKs that drives proliferation, survival, and the inflammatory program of many tumors. The directionality runs from STAT3 toward Cancer, so STAT3 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由 STAT3 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 STAT3 是一種由 JAK 活化的潛在轉錄因子，可驅動許多腫瘤的增殖、存活和發炎程序。方向性從 STAT3 朝向 Cancer，因此 STAT3 是主動主體，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer is treated by trastuzumab. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against HER2 that inhibits signaling and recruits immune effector mechanisms in HER2-positive breast cancer. The directionality runs from trastuzumab toward Cancer, so trastuzumab is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由 trastuzumab 處理。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。曲妥珠單抗是一種針對 HER2 的單株抗體，可抑制訊號傳導並在 HER2 陽性 Breast Cancer 中招募免疫效應機制。方向性從 trastuzumab 向 Cancer，因此 trastuzumab 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Cancer is driven by Wnt. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Wnt signaling is a conserved pathway controlling cell fate and stemness whose beta-catenin arm is aberrantly activated in many cancers. The directionality runs from Wnt toward Cancer, so Wnt is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由Wnt 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。訊號傳導是控制細胞命運和乾性的保守途徑，其β-連環蛋白臂在許多癌症中被異常活化。方向性從 Wnt 朝向 Cancer，因此 Wnt 是主動主體，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer is driven by YAP1. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. YAP1 is the transcriptional co-activator of the Hippo pathway that, when nuclear, promotes proliferation and is inhibited by ivermectin in several cancers. The directionality runs from YAP1 toward Cancer, so YAP1 is the active agent and Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 由YAP1 驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 YAP1 是 Hippo 途徑的轉錄共活化因子，當進入細胞核時，可促進增殖，並在多種癌症中被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 YAP1 朝向 Cancer，因此 YAP1 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer Stem Cells drive Chemotherapy Resistance. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with Cancer Stem Cells acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer Stem Cells 驅動Chemotherapy Resistance。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer Stem Cells 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer Stem Cells relates to Ivermectin through the relation are_inhibited_by. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Cancer Stem Cells 透過關係式 are_inhibited_by 與 Ivermectin 相關。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Cancer Stem Cells relates to Nanog through the relation express. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Nanog is a core pluripotency transcription factor re-expressed in cancer stem cells to sustain self-renewal. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Cancer Stem Cells 透過關係表達與 Nanog 相關。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 Nanog 是一個核心多能性轉錄因子，在 Cancer Stem Cells 中重新表達以維持自我更新。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Cancer Stem Cells relates to Oct4 through the relation express. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Oct4 (POU5F1) is a pluripotency factor whose re-expression in tumors supports stemness and tumor-initiation capacity. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Cancer Stem Cells 透過關係式與 Oct4 相關。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 Oct4 (POU5F1) 是一種多能因子，其在腫瘤中的重新表現支持乾性和腫瘤啟動能力。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Cancer Stem Cells are regulated by PAK1. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. The directionality runs from PAK1 toward Cancer Stem Cells, so PAK1 is the active agent and Cancer Stem Cells the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Cancer Stem Cells 受 PAK1 調節。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 PAK1 朝向 Cancer Stem Cells，因此 PAK1 是主動主體，Cancer Stem Cells 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Cancer Stem Cells relates to Sox2 through the relation express. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.

context.en-US: Caspase-10 is downregulated in Cancer. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. context.en-US: Caspase-10 activates Caspase-3. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-10 acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse.
