context.en-US: Caspase-10 activates Caspase-7. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspase-7 is an executioner caspase closely related to caspase-3 that contributes to the proteolytic demolition of the cell. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-10 acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-7 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-10 啟動 Caspase-7。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。 Caspase-7 是一種與 caspase-3 密切相關的劊子手 caspase，有助於細胞的蛋白水解破壞。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-10 充當 Caspase-7 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-10 is activated at DISC. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. The directionality runs from DISC toward Caspase-10, so DISC is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-10 在 DISC 啟動。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。方向性從 DISC 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 DISC 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-12, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-12 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-12 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-12 是一種內質網定位的蛋白酶，可介導由內質網壓力引起的細胞凋亡訊號傳導。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-12，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-12 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Caspase-12 is activated by Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Caspase-12 is an ER-localized protease that mediates apoptotic signaling arising specifically from endoplasmic-reticulum stress. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The directionality runs from Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway toward Caspase-12, so Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway is the active agent and Caspase-12 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-12 由 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 啟動。 Caspase-12 是一種內質網定位的蛋白酶，可介導由內質網壓力引起的細胞凋亡訊號傳導。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。方向性從 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 朝向 Caspase-12，因此 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 是活性劑，Caspase-12 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: 14-3-3-zeta binds phospho-caspase-2 in a phosphorylation-dependent manner, shielding Ser135 from dephosphorylation and keeping the initiator caspase suppressed. Acetylation of 14-3-3-zeta causes it to dissociate from caspase-2, leading to caspase-2 activation and cell death. 14-3-3 thus serves as an inhibitory binding partner of caspase-2.
context.zh-TW: 14-3-3ζ 以磷酸化依賴方式與磷酸化 caspase-2 結合，保護 Ser135 免受去磷酸化，並使啟動型半胱天冬酶保持受抑制。14-3-3ζ 的乙醯化會使其與 caspase-2 分離，導致 caspase-2 激活與細胞死亡。因此 14-3-3 是 caspase-2 的抑制性結合夥伴。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 cleaves Bid. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. Bid is a BH3-only protein cleaved by caspase-8 into truncated Bid, physically linking the extrinsic and intrinsic apoptotic routes. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-2 acting as the operative agent upon Bid rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 劈開 Bid。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 Bid 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，被 caspase-8 切割成截短的 Bid，在物理上連接外源性和內源性細胞凋亡途徑。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-2 充當 Bid 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 is phosphorylated by CaMKII. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. CaMKII is a calcium/calmodulin-dependent kinase that, among other roles, phosphorylates caspase-2 in response to calcium fluxes. The directionality runs from CaMKII toward Caspase-2, so CaMKII is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 被 CaMKII 磷酸化。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 CaMKII 是一種鈣/鈣調蛋白依賴性激酶，除其他作用外，它還響應鈣流而磷酸化 caspase-2。方向性從 CaMKII 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 CaMKII 是主動主體，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-2, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 Caspase 是主動主體，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 is phosphorylated by CDK1. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. CDK1 in complex with cyclin B1 drives mitotic entry and can phosphorylate and regulate apical caspases such as caspase-2. The directionality runs from CDK1 toward Caspase-2, so CDK1 is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 被 CDK1 磷酸化。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 CDK1 與細胞週期蛋白 B1 形成複合物，可驅動有絲分裂進入，並可磷酸化和調節頂端 caspase，例如 caspase-2。方向性從 CDK1 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 CDK1 是活性劑，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 is phosphorylated at Ser157 by CK2, one of several kinase inputs that regulate this initiator caspase. Alongside CDK1/CYCLIN B1 (Ser308) and CaMKII (Ser164), CK2 contributes to the phosphorylation-dependent control of caspase-2. These modifications modulate its activity and its susceptibility to 14-3-3 binding.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 在 Ser157 被 CK2 磷酸化，這是調控此啟動型半胱天冬酶的幾個激酶輸入之一。與 CDK1/CYCLIN B1（Ser308）和 CaMKII（Ser164）並列，CK2 也參與對 caspase-2 的磷酸化依賴性調控。這些修飾調節其活性及其對 14-3-3 結合的敏感性。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 is activated by PIDDosome. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The directionality runs from PIDDosome toward Caspase-2, so PIDDosome is the active agent and Caspase-2 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 由 PIDDosome 啟動。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。方向性從 PIDDosome 朝向 Caspase-2，因此 PIDDosome 是主動主體，Caspase-2 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 is metabolically suppressed through the SIRT1-14-3-3-zeta axis. SIRT1 deacetylates 14-3-3-zeta at Lys49, maintaining 14-3-3-zeta binding to phospho-caspase-2 and protecting Ser135 from dephosphorylation, which keeps caspase-2 inactive. SIRT1 inhibition releases this suppression and enhances caspase-2-dependent cell death and paclitaxel sensitivity in breast tumor cells.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 透過 SIRT1–14-3-3ζ 軸被代謝性抑制。SIRT1 在 Lys49 去乙醯化 14-3-3ζ，維持 14-3-3ζ 與磷酸化 caspase-2 的結合，並保護 Ser135 免受去磷酸化，從而使 caspase-2 保持不活化。抑制 SIRT1 會解除此抑制，並增強乳癌細胞中依賴 caspase-2 的細胞死亡與紫杉醇敏感性。

context.en-US: Caspase-2 serves as the metabolic arm of the sirtuin-caspase crosstalk, linking cellular metabolic state to the apoptotic threshold. Through the SIRT1-14-3-3-zeta axis, falling pentose-phosphate-pathway flux activates caspase-2. This places caspase-2 at the interface of metabolism and cell death.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-2 是去乙醯化酶與半胱天冬酶交叉對話的代謝分支，將細胞代謝狀態與細胞凋亡閾值連結起來。透過 SIRT1–14-3-3ζ 軸，戊糖磷酸路徑流量的下降會激活 caspase-2。這使 caspase-2 位於代謝與細胞死亡的介面。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 is activated by Caspase-8. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The directionality runs from Caspase-8 toward Caspase-3, so Caspase-8 is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 由 Caspase-8 啟動。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。方向性從 Caspase-8 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 Caspase-8 是主動主體，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 is activated by Caspase-9. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The directionality runs from Caspase-9 toward Caspase-3, so Caspase-9 is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 由 Caspase-9 啟動。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。方向性從 Caspase-9 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 Caspase-9 是主動主體，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 cleaves ICAD. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. ICAD is the inhibitor of caspase-activated DNase that, upon caspase-3 cleavage, releases CAD to fragment nuclear DNA. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon ICAD rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 分裂 ICAD。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 ICAD 是 caspase 活化的 DNase 抑制劑，在 caspase-3 裂解時，釋放 CAD 以片段化核 DNA。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 ICAD 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 is induced by Ivermectin. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Caspase-3, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Caspase-3 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 由 Ivermectin 誘發。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 Caspase-3，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，Caspase-3 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 cleaves Lamins. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Lamins are the intermediate-filament proteins of the nuclear lamina whose cleavage by caspases drives nuclear collapse during apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon Lamins rather than the reverse. context.en-US: Caspase-6 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-6 is an executioner caspase particularly important for cleavage of nuclear lamins and the structural collapse of the nucleus. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-6, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-6 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.

context.en-US: Caspase-6 contributes to chromatin condensation. Caspase-6 is an executioner caspase particularly important for cleavage of nuclear lamins and the structural collapse of the nucleus. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-6 acting as the operative agent upon chromatin condensation rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by Akt. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The directionality runs from Akt toward Caspase-9, so Akt is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is activated at Apoptosome. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. The directionality runs from Apoptosome toward Caspase-9, so Apoptosome is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is activated by c-ABL. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. c-ABL is a tyrosine kinase that, upon genotoxic stress, can phosphorylate and activate caspase-9 to promote apoptosis. The directionality runs from c-ABL toward Caspase-9, so c-ABL is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 由 c-ABL 活化。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 c-ABL 是一種酪胺酸激酶，在基因毒性壓力下，可以磷酸化並活化 caspase-9 以促進細胞凋亡。方向性從 c-ABL 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 c-ABL 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 activates Caspase-3. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-9 acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 啟動 Caspase-3。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-9 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by ERK. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. The directionality runs from ERK toward Caspase-9, so ERK is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 被 ERK 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。方向性從 ERK 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 ERK 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by p38 MAPK. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. p38 MAPK is a stress-activated kinase that can both promote and suppress apoptosis depending on context, including by phosphorylating caspases. The directionality runs from p38 MAPK toward Caspase-9, so p38 MAPK is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 被 p38 MAPK 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 p38 MAPK 是一種壓力激活激酶，可根據具體情況促進和抑制細胞凋亡，包括透過磷酸化半胱天冬酶。方向性從 p38 MAPK 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 p38 MAPK 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by PKCζ. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. PKCzeta is an atypical protein kinase C isoform that can phosphorylate and inhibit caspase-9 to blunt apoptosis. The directionality runs from PKCζ toward Caspase-9, so PKCζ is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 被 PKCζ 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 PKCzeta 是一種非典型蛋白激酶 C 同工型，可磷酸化並抑制 caspase-9 以抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 PKCζ 向 Caspase-9，因此 PKCζ 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Caspase-9 is inhibited by XIAP. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Caspase-9, so XIAP is the active agent and Caspase-9 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 被 XIAP 抑制。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Caspase-9，因此 XIAP 是主動主體，Caspase-9 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: The plant flavone Apigenin halts cell cycle progression in cancer cells at either the G1 or G2/M phase depending on cell type. This block is linked to induction of the CDK inhibitors p21 and p27 and inhibition of Rb phosphorylation. Apigenin-induced cell cycle arrest is central to its anticancer and chemopreventive activity.
context.zh-TW: 植物黃酮 Apigenin 會使癌細胞的細胞週期進程停滯在 G1 或 G2/M 期，取決於細胞類型。此阻斷與 CDK 抑制劑 p21 和 p27 的誘導以及 Rb 磷酸化的抑制有關。Apigenin 誘導的細胞週期停滯對其抗癌與化學預防活性至關重要。

context.en-US: Cell cycle arrest at the G2/M phase is associated with decreased expression and kinase activity of CDK1 (cdc2) and Cyclin B. Removing the cyclin B-CDK1 drive halts the transition into mitosis. This downregulation is a hallmark of G2/M arrest induced by agents such as Apigenin.
context.zh-TW: G2/M 期的細胞週期停滯與 CDK1（cdc2）和 Cyclin B 表現及激酶活性下降有關。移除 cyclin B–CDK1 驅動力會阻止進入有絲分裂。這種下調是 Apigenin 等藥物誘導之 G2/M 停滯的標誌。

context.en-US: Cell cycle arrest is a reversible safeguard that provides time for DNA repair and maintenance of genome integrity. By halting proliferation at checkpoints, arrest allows damaged DNA to be repaired before replication or division. Failure of this arrest is a hallmark of cancer.
context.zh-TW: 細胞週期停滯是一種可逆的安全機制，為 DNA 修復與基因體完整性的維持提供時間。透過在檢查點停止增殖，停滯允許受損 DNA 在複製或分裂前得到修復。此停滯的失敗是癌症的標誌。

context.en-US: Induction of the CDK inhibitor p21 enforces cell cycle arrest, often through a p53-dependent pathway. p21 blocks cyclin-CDK activity, halting progression at defined checkpoints. Induction of p21 is a core mechanism linking stress signaling to cell cycle arrest.
context.zh-TW: CDK 抑制劑 p21 的誘導會強制實施細胞週期停滯，通常透過 p53 依賴途徑。p21 會阻斷 cyclin–CDK 活性，使進程停滯在特定檢查點。p21 的誘導是將壓力訊號與細胞週期停滯連結的核心機制。

context.en-US: The CDK inhibitor p27 is co-induced with p21 to enforce cell cycle arrest. p27 inhibits G1 cyclin-CDK complexes, maintaining cells in a non-proliferative state. Together with p21 it represents a key effector of growth arrest.
context.zh-TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27 與 p21 共同被誘導以強制實施細胞週期停滯。p27 抑制 G1 cyclin–CDK 複合體，使細胞維持在非增殖狀態。它與 p21 共同構成生長停滯的關鍵效應因子。

context.en-US: Cell cycle arrest is frequently enforced through the p53 pathway, which upregulates p21 to halt the cell cycle in response to stress or DNA damage. However, arrest can also occur through p53-independent pathways. p53 is thus an important but not exclusive upstream regulator of cell cycle arrest.
context.zh-TW: 細胞週期停滯常透過 p53 途徑強制實施，p53 會上調 p21，以在壓力或 DNA 損傷時停止細胞週期。然而，停滯也可透過 p53 非依賴途徑發生。因此 p53 是細胞週期停滯的重要但非唯一的上游調控因子。

context.en-US: Dephosphorylated (hypophosphorylated) Rb maintains cell cycle arrest in its active, growth-suppressive form. Inhibition of Rb phosphorylation during arrest preserves this tumor-suppressive state. Rb is thus a central mediator of cell cycle arrest, particularly at the G1 checkpoint.
context.zh-TW: 去磷酸化的 Rb 以其活性、抑制生長的形式維持細胞週期停滯。在停滯期間抑制 Rb 磷酸化可保留此腫瘤抑制狀態。因此 Rb 是細胞週期停滯（尤其是 G1 檢查點）的核心媒介。

context.en-US: Cholangiocarcinoma is a malignancy of the bile-duct epithelium (adenocarcinoma).
context.zh-TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 是膽管上皮的惡性腫瘤（腺癌）。

context.en-US: Cholangiocarcinoma harbors cancer stem-like cells that drive recurrence and chemoresistance.
context.zh-TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 含有促進復發和化療抗藥性的癌症幹細胞樣細胞。

context.en-US: First-line systemic therapy is gemcitabine plus cisplatin; options remain limited and prognosis poor.
context.zh-TW: 第一線全身治療是吉西他濱加順鉑；選擇仍然有限，預後不佳。

context.en-US: Evasion of programmed cell death is a hallmark of colon cancer, with p53 loss central to apoptosis resistance. Pro-apoptotic effectors such as Bax and Bak and BH3-only proteins like Bik modulate colon cancer chemosensitivity. Apoptosis pathways are therefore central to colon cancer biology and treatment.
context.zh-TW: 逃避程式性細胞死亡是結腸癌的標誌，其中 p53 缺失是細胞凋亡抗性的核心。Bax 和 Bak 等促凋亡效應因子以及 Bik 等 BH3-only 蛋白調節結腸癌的化療敏感性。因此細胞凋亡途徑對結腸癌生物學與治療至關重要。

context.en-US: BRAF V600E mutation drives the serrated pathway of colon cancer and is associated with microsatellite instability through MLH1 promoter hypermethylation. BRAF V600E confers worse prognosis in metastatic disease. It defines a distinct molecular subtype of colon cancer.
context.zh-TW: BRAF V600E 突變驅動結腸癌的鋸齒狀途徑，並透過 MLH1 啟動子高甲基化與微衛星不穩定相關。BRAF V600E 在轉移性疾病中賦予較差的預後。它定義了結腸癌的一個獨特分子亞型。

context.en-US: Colon cancer is a malignancy of the large intestine (colon) and represents a major subset of colorectal cancer. It is the third most commonly diagnosed cancer worldwide. Colon cancer shares the colorectal continuum with rectal cancer but is managed distinctly.
context.zh-TW: 結腸癌是大腸（結腸）的惡性腫瘤，代表結直腸癌的一個主要亞群。它是全球第三大最常被診斷的癌症。結腸癌與直腸癌共享結直腸連續體，但治療方式不同。

context.en-US: FOLFOX (5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin) is the standard adjuvant chemotherapy regimen for stage III and high-risk stage II colon cancer, and a backbone for metastatic disease. FOLFOX and FOLFIRI are interchangeable as first-line chemotherapy in metastatic colon cancer. It is a cornerstone of colon cancer treatment.
context.zh-TW: FOLFOX（5-氟尿嘧啶、亞葉酸、奧沙利鉑）是第三期與高風險第二期結腸癌的標準輔助化療方案，也是轉移性疾病的主幹。FOLFOX 和 FOLFIRI 在轉移性結腸癌中可互換作為一線化療。它是結腸癌治療的基石。

context.en-US: Oncogenic KRAS mutation, most commonly at codon 12 or 13, constitutively activates the MAPK/ERK pathway and drives proliferation of intermediate adenomas in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. KRAS activation is a key step in the Vogelstein model of colon cancer. KRAS mutation status also guides anti-EGFR therapy selection.
context.zh-TW: 致癌性 KRAS 突變（最常見於密碼子 12 或 13）持續激活 MAPK/ERK 途徑，並在腺瘤–癌序列中驅動中間腺瘤的增殖。KRAS 激活是結腸癌 Vogelstein 模型中的關鍵步驟。KRAS 突變狀態也指導抗 EGFR 療法的選擇。

context.en-US: Loss of p53 function abolishes DNA damage checkpoints and apoptosis, permitting the final transition to invasive carcinoma in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. p53 is mutated or lost in about 60% of colon cancers. p53 loss is therefore a late and decisive event in colon tumorigenesis.
context.zh-TW: p53 功能喪失會廢除 DNA 損傷檢查點與細胞凋亡，允許腺瘤–癌序列中向侵襲性癌的最終轉變。p53 在約 60% 的結腸癌中發生突變或缺失。因此 p53 缺失是結腸腫瘤發生中晚期且具決定性的事件。

context.en-US: Deletion of SMAD4 (and neighboring DCC) on chromosome 18q disrupts TGF-beta signaling, enabling escape from growth-inhibitory signals in late adenomas. SMAD4 loss is a step in the Vogelstein model of colon cancer. It contributes to progression toward invasive carcinoma.
context.zh-TW: 18q 上 SMAD4（及相鄰的 DCC）的刪除會擾亂 TGF-β 訊號傳導，使晚期腺瘤得以逃脫生長抑制訊號。SMAD4 缺失是結腸癌 Vogelstein 模型中的一個步驟。它促成向侵襲性癌的進展。

context.en-US: Constitutive Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, driven by APC loss, is activated in the majority of sporadic colon cancers. Aberrant Wnt signaling from inactivating APC mutation is the initiating event in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. The Wnt pathway is therefore central to colon cancer initiation.
context.zh-TW: 由 APC 缺失驅動的持續性 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號傳導在多數散發性結腸癌中被激活。源自 APC 失活突變的異常 Wnt 訊號傳導是腺瘤–癌序列的起始事件。因此 Wnt 途徑對結腸癌的起始至關重要。

context.en-US: Colon Cancer is driven by Wnt Signaling. Constitutive Wnt/β-catenin signaling—initiated by APC loss—is the initiating driver in the majority of sporadic colon cancers, leading to dysplastic aberrant crypt foci and progression along the adenoma-carcinoma sequence.
context.zh-TW: 大腸癌（Colon Cancer）由 Wnt 訊息傳遞（Wnt Signaling）所驅動。由 APC 缺失所啟動的持續 Wnt/β-catenin 訊息傳遞是多數散發性大腸癌的起始驅動因子，導致發育不良的異常隱窩病灶，並沿腺瘤-癌序列進展。

context.en-US: XIAP is overexpressed in colon cancer and confers resistance to apoptosis and chemotherapy. As an inhibitor of apoptosis protein, XIAP suppresses caspases and blunts cell death. XIAP expression is therefore relevant to colon cancer chemoresistance.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 在結腸癌中過度表現，並賦予對細胞凋亡與化療的抗性。作為凋亡抑制蛋白，XIAP 抑制半胱天冬酶並削弱細胞死亡。因此 XIAP 表現與結腸癌化療抗性相關。

context.en-US: DISC activates Caspase-8. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-8 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: DISC 啟動 Caspase-8。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，DISC 充當 Caspase-8 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: DISC is formed by DR4. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. DR4 (TRAIL-R1) is a death receptor that binds TRAIL and nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis. The directionality runs from DR4 toward DISC, so DR4 is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: DISC 由 DR4 組成。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 DR4 (TRAIL-R1) 是一種死亡受體，可結合 TRAIL 並使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性細胞凋亡。方向性從 DR4 向 DISC，因此 DR4 是活性劑，DISC 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: DISC is formed by DR5. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. DR5 (TRAIL-R2) is a death receptor that binds TRAIL and nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis, often more prominently than DR4. The directionality runs from DR5 toward DISC, so DR5 is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: DISC由DR5組成。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 DR5 (TRAIL-R2) 是一種死亡受體，它與 TRAIL 結合並使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，通常比 DR4 更顯著。方向性從 DR5 朝向 DISC，因此 DR5 是活性劑，DISC 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: DISC uses FADD. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. FADD is the core death-adaptor protein of the DISC that bridges death receptors to procaspase-8 via its death domain and DED. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon FADD rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: DISC 使用 FADD。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 FADD is the core death-adaptor protein of the DISC that bridges death receptors to procaspase-8 via its death domain and DED. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon FADD rather than than reverse.這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標誌物機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: DISC is formed by Fas. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. Fas (CD95) is a death receptor whose ligation by FasL initiates the extrinsic apoptotic pathway through DISC assembly. The directionality runs from Fas toward DISC, so Fas is the active agent and DISC the recipient of the effect. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: DISC 由 Fas 組成。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 Fas (CD95) 是一種死亡受體，其與 FasL 的連接可透過 DISC 組裝啟動外源性凋亡路徑。方向性從 Fas 向 DISC，因此 Fas 是活性劑，DISC 是效果的接受者。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Drug repositioning includes fenbendazole, an established benzimidazole anthelmintic now studied for its interference with microtubules, glycolysis, and p53 in tumors. The approach aims to convert a safe veterinary/human agent into a cancer therapeutic. The relationship is directional and reflects the logic of repurposing known drugs. Clinical validation for fenbendazole in oncology is still lacking.
context.zh-TW: Drug Repositioning 包括芬苯達唑，一種成熟的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，目前正在研究其對腫瘤微管、糖酵解和 p53 的幹擾。該方法旨在將安全的獸醫/人類藥物轉化為癌症治療劑。這種關係是方向性的，反映了重新利用已知藥物的邏輯。芬苯達唑在腫瘤學的臨牀驗證仍缺乏。

context.en-US: Drug repositioning includes ivermectin, which is being redeployed from antiparasitic use to oncology on the strength of its multi-kinase and pro-death effects. Such repositioning exploits established human safety to shorten the path to clinical use. The relationship is directional, with the repositioning strategy encompassing the drug rather than the reverse. Its anticancer efficacy in patients remains to be rigorously confirmed.
context.zh-TW: Drug Repositioning 包括伊維菌素，由於其多激酶和促死亡作用，它正在從抗寄生蟲用途重新部署到腫瘤學用途。這種重新定位利用了已建立的人類安全性來縮短臨牀使用的路徑。這種關係是定向的，重新定位策略包括藥物而不是相反。其對患者的抗癌功效仍有待嚴格證實。

context.en-US: EMT promotes Chemotherapy Resistance. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with EMT acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: EMT 促進 Chemotherapy Resistance。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，EMT 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: EMT is a hallmark of Hallmarks of Cancer. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. The Hallmarks of Cancer are the enabling biological capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis, including sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The directionality runs from Hallmarks of Cancer toward EMT, so Hallmarks of Cancer is the active agent and EMT the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: EMT 是 Hallmarks of Cancer 的標誌。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。 Hallmarks of Cancer是腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的生物學能力，包括持續增生、逃避死亡和轉移。方向性從 Hallmarks of Cancer 向 EMT，因此 Hallmarks of Cancer 是活性劑，EMT 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: EMT is inhibited by Ivermectin. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward EMT, so Ivermectin is the active agent and EMT the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: EMT 被 Ivermectin 抑制。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 EMT，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，EMT 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: EMT enables Metastasis. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with EMT acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: EMT 啟用 Metastasis。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，EMT 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: EMT is induced by TGFβ. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. TGF-beta is a cytokine with dual roles: it restrains epithelial proliferation yet, in advanced cancer, actively induces EMT and immunosuppression. The directionality runs from TGFβ toward EMT, so TGFβ is the active agent and EMT the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: EMT 由 TGFβ 誘發。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。 TGF-β 是一種具有雙重作用的細胞激素：它抑制上皮細胞增殖，但在晚期癌症中，積極誘導 β 和免疫抑制。方向性從 TGFβ 向 EMT，因此 TGFβ 是主動主體，EMT 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway is a type of Apoptosis. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The directionality runs from Apoptosis toward Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway, so Apoptosis is the active agent and Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 是 Apoptosis 的一種。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。方向性從 Apoptosis 向 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway，因此 Apoptosis 是活性劑，Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway converges at Common Pathway. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The common execution phase of apoptosis is the point at which all initiation routes converge on effector caspases that proteolyze the cellular proteome. The relationship is directional, with Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Common Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 收斂於Common Pathway。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。細胞凋亡的共同執行階段是所有起始途徑匯聚到效應器半胱天冬酶上的點，該效應器半胱天冬酶對細胞蛋白質組進行蛋白質分解。這種關係是有方向的，Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 充當Common Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway is triggered by Hypoxia. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. Hypoxia is a low-oxygen state common in poorly perfused tumors that stabilizes HIF-1alpha and drives angiogenesis, glycolysis, and therapy resistance. The directionality runs from Hypoxia toward Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway, so Hypoxia is the active agent and Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 由Hypoxia 觸發。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。 Hypoxia 是一種低氧狀態，常見於灌注不良的腫瘤中，可穩定 HIF-1α 並驅動血管生成、糖解作用和治療抗性。方向性從 Hypoxia 向 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway，因此 Hypoxia 是活性劑，Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: ERK1_2 phosphorylates Bim. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. Bim is a sentinel BH3-only protein sequestered at microtubules that is released by stress to directly activate Bax/Bak. The relationship is directional, with ERK1_2 acting as the operative agent upon Bim rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: ERK1_2 磷酸化Bim。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。 Bim 是一種隔離在微管中的前哨 BH3 蛋白，壓力釋放時可直接活化 Bax/Bak。這種關係是有方向的，ERK1_2 充當 Bim 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: ERK1_2 is dysregulated in Cancer. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward ERK1_2, so Cancer is the active agent and ERK1_2 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: ERK1_2 在 Cancer 中失調。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 ERK1_2 延伸，因此 Cancer 是主動主體，ERK1_2 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: ERK1_2 is a type of MAPK. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. The mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades relay extracellular signals to transcriptional programs governing proliferation and stress responses. The directionality runs from MAPK toward ERK1_2, so MAPK is the active agent and ERK1_2 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: ERK1_2 是 MAPK 的一種。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。絲裂原活化的蛋白激酶級聯將細胞外訊號傳遞至控制增殖和壓力反應的轉錄程序。方向性從 MAPK 向 ERK1_2 延伸，因此 MAPK 是主動主體，ERK1_2 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: ERK1_2 stabilizes Mcl-1. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The relationship is directional, with ERK1_2 acting as the operative agent upon Mcl-1 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: ERK1_2 穩定 Mcl-1。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。這種關係是有方向的，ERK1_2 充當 Mcl-1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: ERK1_2 is activated by MEK. ERK1/2 are the terminal effectors of the RAS-RAF-MEK cascade that phosphorylate nuclear and cytoplasmic targets to drive division. MEK1/2 are the dual-specificity kinases immediately upstream of ERK that integrate RAS-RAF signals into proliferative output. The directionality runs from MEK toward ERK1_2, so MEK is the active agent and ERK1_2 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: ERK1_2 由 MEK 活化。 ERK1/2 是 RAS-RAF-MEK 級聯的末端效應子，磷酸化細胞核和細胞質標靶以驅動分裂。 MEK1/2 是緊鄰ERK上游的雙特異性激酶，可將 RAS-RAF 訊號整合到增殖輸出。方向性從 MEK 朝向 ERK1_2，因此 MEK 是主動主體，ERK1_2 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: ERK2 phosphorylates Bmf. ERK2 is the predominant isoform of the ERK1/2 MAPK pair that transduces RAS-RAF-MEK output to nuclear and cytoplasmic targets. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. The relationship is directional, with ERK2 acting as the operative agent upon Bmf rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: ERK2磷酸化Bmf。 ERK2 是 ERK1/2 MAPK 對的主要亞型，可將 RAS-RAF-MEK 輸出轉導至核子和細胞質標靶。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。這種關係是有方向的，ERK2 充當 Bmf 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Extrinsic Pathway activates Caspase-8. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The relationship is directional, with Extrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-8 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Extrinsic Pathway 啟動 Caspase-8。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，Extrinsic Pathway 充當 Caspase-8 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Extrinsic Pathway forms DISC. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. The relationship is directional, with Extrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon DISC rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Extrinsic Pathway 形式DISC。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。這種關係是有方向的，Extrinsic Pathway 充當 DISC 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Extrinsic Pathway is linked to Intrinsic Pathway. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The relationship is directional, with Extrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Intrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Extrinsic Pathway 連結到 Intrinsic Pathway。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，Extrinsic Pathway 充當 Intrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Extrinsic Pathway is restored by SHP1. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. SHP1 is a protein tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and reactivates caspase-8, restoring death-receptor-induced apoptosis. The directionality runs from SHP1 toward Extrinsic Pathway, so SHP1 is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Extrinsic Pathway 由 SHP1 恢復。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 SHP1 是一種蛋白質酪胺酸磷酸酶，可去磷酸化並重新活化 caspase-8，恢復死亡受體誘導的細胞凋亡。方向性從 SHP1 朝向 Extrinsic Pathway，因此 SHP1 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Extrinsic Pathway is suppressed by SRC kinase. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. SRC is a non-receptor tyrosine kinase that promotes survival and, notably, phosphorylates and inactivates caspase-8 and Bik. The directionality runs from SRC kinase toward Extrinsic Pathway, so SRC kinase is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Extrinsic Pathway 被 SRC kinase 抑制。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 SRC 是一種非受體酪胺酸激酶，可促進存活，尤其是磷酸化 caspase-8 和 Bik 並使其失去活性。方向性從SRC kinase 向Extrinsic Pathway 延伸，因此SRC kinase 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Extrinsic Pathway is initiated by TRAIL. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The directionality runs from TRAIL toward Extrinsic Pathway, so TRAIL is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Extrinsic Pathway 由 TRAIL 發起。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。方向性從 TRAIL 朝向 Extrinsic Pathway，因此 TRAIL 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: FAK promotes Angiogenesis. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with FAK acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: FAK 促進Angiogenesis。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，FAK 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: FAK is overexpressed in Cancer. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward FAK, so Cancer is the active agent and FAK the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: FAK 在 Cancer 中過度表現。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 朝向 FAK，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，FAK 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: FAK is activated by Integrins. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Integrins are transmembrane receptors that connect the extracellular matrix to the cytoskeleton and intracellular survival kinases. The directionality runs from Integrins toward FAK, so Integrins is the active agent and FAK the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: FAK 由 Integrins 活化。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。 Integrins 是將細胞外基質連接到細胞骨架和細胞內生存激酶的跨膜受體。方向性從 Integrins 朝向 FAK，因此 Integrins 是主動主體，FAK 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: FAK activates MAPK. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. The mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades relay extracellular signals to transcriptional programs governing proliferation and stress responses. The relationship is directional, with FAK acting as the operative agent upon MAPK rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: FAK 活化 MAPK。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。絲裂原活化的蛋白激酶級聯將細胞外訊號傳遞至控制增殖和壓力反應的轉錄程序。這種關係是有方向的，FAK 充當 MAPK 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: FAK promotes Metastasis. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with FAK acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: FAK 促進Metastasis。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，FAK 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: FAK activates PI3K. Focal adhesion kinase transduces integrin and growth-factor signals into survival, migration, and angiogenesis and is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Phosphoinositide 3-kinase generates PIP3 at the membrane to recruit and activate Akt, a central node of growth and survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with FAK acting as the operative agent upon PI3K rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: FAK 活化 PI3K。黏著斑激酶將整合素和生長因子訊號傳導成存活、遷移和血管生成，並在許多實體腫瘤中過度表現。磷酸肌醇 3-激酶在膜上產生 PIP3，以募集並活化 Akt（生長和生存訊號傳導的中心節點）。這種關係是有方向的，FAK 充當 PI3K 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole induces Apoptosis. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 誘發 Apoptosis。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole is a type of Benzimidazole. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. Benzimidazoles are a chemical class that includes the anthelmintic fenbendazole and binds tubulin to disrupt microtubule dynamics. The directionality runs from Benzimidazole toward Fenbendazole, so Benzimidazole is the active agent and Fenbendazole the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 是 Benzimidazole 的一種。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。它是一類化學物質，包括驅蟲藥芬苯達唑並結合微管蛋白以破壞微管動力學。方向性從 Benzimidazole 向 Fenbendazole，因此 Benzimidazole 是活性劑，Fenbendazole 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole is being investigated for repositioning from an anthelmintic into cancer therapy, motivated by its microtubule, glycolytic, and p53-directed activities. Repurposing leverages an existing safety record to accelerate exploration of antitumor benefit. The relationship is directional and exemplifies the drug-repositioning strategy. Human anticancer data, however, remain preliminary and largely anecdotal.
context.zh-TW: 正在研究 Fenbendazole 在微管、糖解作用和 p53 定向活性的推動下，將其從驅蟲藥重新定位為癌症治療。重新利用利用現有的安全記錄來加速探索抗腫瘤益處。這種關係是有方向性的，體現了藥物重新定位策略。然而，人類抗癌數據仍然是初步的，而且很大程度上是軼事。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole suppresses Glycolysis. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. Glycolysis is the cytosolic catabolism of glucose to pyruvate and, under the Warburg phenotype, onward to lactate, yielding rapid ATP and biosynthetic intermediates. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon Glycolysis rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 抑制 Glycolysis。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 Glycolysis 是葡萄糖到丙酮酸的胞質分解代謝，並在 Warburg 表型下進一步分解為乳酸，快速產生 ATP 和生物合成中間體。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當 Glycolysis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Benzimidazole anthelmintics including fenbendazole show preclinical anticancer activity across leukemic models via microtubule disruption.
context.zh-TW: Benzimidazole 包括芬苯達唑在內的驅蟲藥物透過微管破壞在白血病模型中顯示出臨牀前抗癌活性。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole interferes with Microtubule. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. Microtubules are dynamic cytoskeletal polymers essential for mitosis and targeted by taxanes and benzimidazoles in cancer therapy. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon Microtubule rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 幹擾 Microtubule。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 Microtubules 是有絲分裂所必需的動態細胞骨架聚合物，是癌症治療中紫杉烷類和苯並咪唑類藥物的標靶。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當Microtubule 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole activates p53. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Fenbendazole acting as the operative agent upon p53 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 激活 p53。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。這種關係是有方向的，Fenbendazole 充當 p53 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: HER2 amplification is a key molecular driver and biomarker in gastric cancer, targeted by the antibody trastuzumab. HER2 status guides therapy selection in advanced disease. HER2-positive gastric cancer is a distinct, targetable subtype.
context.zh-TW: HER2 擴增是胃癌的關鍵分子驅動因子與生物標記，由抗體 trastuzumab 靶向。HER2 狀態指導晚期疾病的治療選擇。HER2 陽性胃癌是一個獨特、可靶向的亞型。

context.en-US: Infection with Helicobacter pylori drives chronic inflammation that is the dominant etiological factor in gastric carcinogenesis. A metaplasia-dysplasia-carcinoma sequence driven by inflammation and oxidative DNA damage underlies intestinal-type tumors. Inflammation is therefore a central precursor of gastric cancer.
context.zh-TW: Helicobacter pylori 感染驅動的慢性發炎是胃癌發生的主要病因因素。由發炎與氧化性 DNA 損傷驅動的化生–異生–癌序列是腸型腫瘤的基礎。因此發炎是胃癌的核心前驅因素。

context.en-US: Ivermectin has demonstrated inhibitory effects on gastric cancer proliferation in preclinical models, where its activity depends on YAP1 expression. Cells with high YAP1 are more sensitive to ivermectin. Repurposing ivermectin, possibly with existing targeted drugs, is an active investigational avenue.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 在臨床前模型中已顯示對胃癌增殖的抑制效應，其活性取決於 YAP1 表現。YAP1 高的細胞對 ivermectin 更敏感。再利用 ivermectin（可能與現有靶向藥物合用）是一個活躍的研究方向。

context.en-US: p53 loss is among the key molecular drivers of gastric cancer alongside HER2 amplification, MET alterations, and activation of the Wnt/beta-catenin and PI3K/Akt pathways. These drivers reflect the molecular heterogeneity of gastric cancer. p53 alterations contribute to tumor progression.
context.zh-TW: p53 缺失是胃癌的關鍵分子驅動因子之一，與 HER2 擴增、MET 改變以及 Wnt/β-catenin 和 PI3K/Akt 途徑的激活並列。這些驅動因子反映了胃癌的分子異質性。p53 改變促成腫瘤進展。

context.en-US: SIRT4 is downregulated in gastric cancer, and low SIRT4 negatively correlates with tumor size and pathological grade, predicting poor prognosis. SIRT4 inhibits proliferation, migration, and invasion via EMT. SIRT4 thereby functions as a suppressor in gastric cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT4 在胃癌中被下調，且低 SIRT4 與腫瘤大小和病理分級呈負相關，預示不良預後。SIRT4 透過 EMT 抑制增殖、遷移與侵襲。因此 SIRT4 在胃癌中作為抑制因子。

context.en-US: SIRT5 enhances autophagy in gastric cancer cells via the AMPK/mTOR pathway, and SIRT5-induced deacetylation of lactate dehydrogenase B triggers hyperactivation of autophagy, a key event in tumorigenesis. SIRT5 thereby promotes gastric cancer progression. This contrasts with the suppressive roles of SIRT4 and SIRT6.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5 透過 AMPK/mTOR 途徑增強胃癌細胞中的自噬，且 SIRT5 誘導的乳酸脫氫酶 B 去乙醯化會觸發自噬的過度激活，這是腫瘤發生的關鍵事件。因此 SIRT5 促進胃癌進展。這與 SIRT4 和 SIRT6 的抑制角色形成對比。

context.en-US: SIRT6 inhibits the JAK2/STAT3 pathway to suppress gastric cancer growth, and its silencing overcomes sorafenib resistance by promoting ferroptosis. SIRT6 is downregulated in gastric cancer, correlating with poor prognosis. SIRT6 therefore acts as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 抑制 JAK2/STAT3 途徑以抑制胃癌生長，其沉默透過促進鐵死亡克服 sorafenib 抗性。SIRT6 在胃癌中被下調，與不良預後相關。因此 SIRT6 在胃癌中作為腫瘤抑制因子。

context.en-US: YAP1 expression is a determinant of ivermectin sensitivity in gastric cancer, with high-YAP1 cells being more sensitive. YAP1 is a Hippo-pathway transcriptional coactivator relevant to gastric cancer growth. It is studied as a determinant of response to repurposed agents.
context.zh-TW: YAP1 表現是胃癌中 ivermectin 敏感性的決定因素，YAP1 高的細胞更敏感。YAP1 是與胃癌生長相關的 Hippo 途徑轉錄輔激活因子。它被研究作為對再利用藥物反應的決定因素。

context.en-US: Humans and other vertebrates lack glutamate-gated chloride channels, which underpins the selective safety of avermectin/ivermectin at therapeutic doses.
context.zh-TW: Humans和其他脊椎動物缺乏穀氨酸門控氯離子通道，這支撐了阿維菌素/伊維菌素在治療劑量下的選擇性安全性。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is a positive allosteric modulator/agonist of invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels, causing sustained Cl- influx and parasite paralysis.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是無脊椎動物穀氨酸門控氯通道的正變構調節劑/激動劑，導致持續的 Cl- 流入和寄生蟲麻痺。

context.en-US: Activation of GluCls in nematodes and arthropods drives Cl- influx, membrane hyperpolarization, flaccid paralysis and death.
context.zh-TW: 線蟲和節肢動物中 GluCl 的活化會導致 Cl 流入、膜超極化、弛緩性麻痺和死亡。

context.en-US: Gossypol restores Apoptosis. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Gossypol acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Gossypol 恢復 Apoptosis。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Gossypol 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Gossypol binds Bcl-2. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The relationship is directional, with Gossypol acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-2 rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Gossypol 綁定 Bcl-2。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。這種關係是有方向的，Gossypol 充當 Bcl-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Gossypol binds Mcl-1. Gossypol is a natural BH3-mimetic derived from cottonseed that, unusually, also engages Mcl-1. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The relationship is directional, with Gossypol acting as the operative agent upon Mcl-1 rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: Gossypol 綁定 Mcl-1。 Gossypol 是一種從棉籽中提取的天然 BH3 模擬物，不同尋常的是，它也參與 Mcl-1。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。這種關係是有方向的，Gossypol 充當 Mcl-1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: In senescent hepatic stellate cells, accumulation of cytoplasmic DNA activates the cGAS-STING pathway, which drives transcription of SASP factors via NF-kB and IRF3. Knocking out STING in mouse models attenuated obesity-associated HCC. The cGAS-STING pathway is therefore a driver of HCC-associated SASP.
context.zh-TW: 在衰老的肝星狀細胞中，細胞質 DNA 的累積激活 cGAS-STING 途徑，該途徑經由 NF-kB 和 IRF3 驅動 SASP 因子的轉錄。在小鼠模型中敲除 STING 可減弱肥胖相關 HCC。因此 cGAS-STING 途徑是 HCC 相關 SASP 的驅動因子。

context.en-US: Obesity alters the gut microbiota, leading to increased production of deoxycholic acid, a secondary bile acid metabolite. DCA induces cellular senescence and SASP factor production in hepatic stellate cells, promoting HCC development. Deoxycholic acid is therefore a gut-derived driver of obesity-associated HCC.
context.zh-TW: 肥胖會改變腸道微生物群，導致次級膽酸代謝物脫氧膽酸的產生增加。DCA 誘導肝星狀細胞中的細胞衰老與 SASP 因子產生，促進 HCC 發展。因此脫氧膽酸是肥胖相關 HCC 的腸道來源驅動因子。

context.en-US: Obesity-altered gut microbiota produce deoxycholic acid, driving the senescence-SASP-HCC axis in obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. Targeting the gut-liver axis to reduce DCA production may prevent HSC senescence and SASP-driven HCC. The gut microbiome is therefore linked to HCC pathogenesis.
context.zh-TW: 肥胖改變的腸道微生物群產生脫氧膽酸，驅動肥胖相關肝細胞癌中的衰老–SASP–HCC 軸。靶向腸肝軸以減少 DCA 產生，可預防 HSC 衰老與 SASP 驅動的 HCC。因此腸道微生物群與 HCC 的發病機制相關。

context.en-US: Senescent hepatic stellate cells produce SASP factors that drive obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. HSC senescence, induced by deoxycholic acid from altered gut microbiota, creates a pro-inflammatory microenvironment. Hepatic stellate cells are therefore central to obesity-associated HCC.
context.zh-TW: 衰老的肝星狀細胞產生驅動肥胖相關肝細胞癌的 SASP 因子。由改變的腸道微生物群產生的脫氧膽酸誘導 HSC 衰老，創造促發炎微環境。因此肝星狀細胞對肥胖相關 HCC 至關重要。

context.en-US: Chronic hepatitis B and C virus infection and steatohepatitis drive persistent inflammation that promotes cirrhosis and a pro-tumorigenic niche in hepatocellular carcinoma. SASP-driven chronic inflammation is a key mechanism in obesity-associated HCC. Inflammation is therefore central to HCC pathogenesis.
context.zh-TW: 慢性 B 型和 C 型肝炎病毒感染以及脂肪性肝炎驅動持續發炎，促進肝硬化與肝細胞癌的促腫瘤微環境。SASP 驅動的慢性發炎是肥胖相關 HCC 的關鍵機制。因此發炎對 HCC 的發病機制至關重要。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma development by blocking YAP1 activity, demonstrated in spontaneous liver-cancer mouse models. This suggests a repurposing strategy that converges on the Hippo pathway. Ivermectin is therefore studied as a repurposed agent against HCC.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 透過阻斷 YAP1 活性抑制肝細胞癌發展，已在自發性肝癌小鼠模型中證實。這表明一種匯聚於 Hippo 途徑的再利用策略。因此 Ivermectin 被研究作為對抗 HCC 的再利用製劑。

context.en-US: Persistent inflammation and oxidative stress drive cirrhosis, creating a pro-tumorigenic niche for hepatocellular carcinoma. Oxidative stress contributes to DNA damage in the setting of chronic liver injury. It is a defining feature of the pathogenic microenvironment of HCC.
context.zh-TW: 持續的發炎與氧化壓力驅動肝硬化，為肝細胞癌創造促腫瘤微環境。在慢性肝損傷背景下，氧化壓力促成 DNA 損傷。它是 HCC 致病性微環境的定義性特徵。

context.en-US: p53 loss is among the molecular drivers of hepatocellular carcinoma, along with activation of the Wnt/beta-catenin, PI3K/Akt/mTOR, and YAP1/TAZ pathways. Aflatoxin B1 exposure causes a characteristic p53 R249S mutation. p53 alterations contribute to HCC pathogenesis.
context.zh-TW: p53 缺失是肝細胞癌的分子驅動因子之一，與 Wnt/β-catenin、PI3K/Akt/mTOR 和 YAP1/TAZ 途徑的激活並列。黃麴毒素 B1 暴露會造成特徵性的 p53 R249S 突變。p53 改變促成 HCC 的發病機制。

context.en-US: The SASP from senescent hepatic stellate cells promotes obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma through IL-1beta, IL-6, CXCL1, and COX-2/PGE2. Persistent SASP generates chronic inflammation and a pro-tumorigenic niche driving HCC. SASP plays a context-dependent dual role in the liver.
context.zh-TW: 衰老肝星狀細胞的 SASP 透過 IL-1beta、IL-6、CXCL1 和 COX-2/PGE2 促進肥胖相關肝細胞癌。持續的 SASP 產生慢性發炎與驅動 HCC 的促腫瘤微環境。SASP 在肝臟中扮演情境依賴的雙重角色。

context.en-US: Cellular senescence of hepatic stellate cells is a critical driver of obesity-associated hepatocellular carcinoma. Senescent HSC produce SASP factors that create a pro-inflammatory microenvironment promoting HCC. HSC senescence is therefore a key initiating event in obesity-associated HCC.
context.zh-TW: 肝星狀細胞的細胞衰老是肥胖相關肝細胞癌的關鍵驅動因子。衰老的 HSC 產生 SASP 因子，創造促進 HCC 的促發炎微環境。因此 HSC 衰老是肥胖相關 HCC 的關鍵起始事件。

context.en-US: Hepatocellular Carcinoma is suppressed by SIRT3. SIRT3 downregulates GST-π1 to enhance chemo/sorafenib-induced apoptosis; SIRT3 overexpression promoted apoptosis by enhancing Caspase-9 cleavage in HCC cells, and CDK4/6-inhibition modulation may enhance sorafenib combination therapy.
context.zh-TW: 肝細胞癌（Hepatocellular Carcinoma）受 SIRT3 抑制。SIRT3 會下調 GST-π1 以增強化療/索拉非尼誘導的凋亡；SIRT3 過度表現會透過增強 Caspase-9 的切割在 HCC 細胞中促進凋亡，而 CDK4/6 抑制調節可能增強索拉非尼聯合療法。

context.en-US: Hepatocellular Carcinoma is suppressed by SIRT4. SIRT4 acts as a tumor suppressor in HCC by inhibiting glutamine metabolism and upregulating p16/p21 while suppressing CyclinB1/Cdc2 and Cdc25c, promoting apoptosis; low SIRT4 correlates with decreased survival.
context.zh-TW: 肝細胞癌（Hepatocellular Carcinoma）受 SIRT4 抑制。SIRT4 在 HCC 中作為腫瘤抑制因子，透過抑制麩醯胺酸代謝並上調 p16/p21、同時抑制 CyclinB1/Cdc2 與 Cdc25c 來促進凋亡；低 SIRT4 與存活率下降相關。

context.en-US: Hepatocellular Carcinoma is suppressed by SIRT6. SIRT6 deacetylates hnRNP A1 to suppress glycolysis and metabolic reprogramming; SIRT6 depletion downregulates multidrug resistance protein 1, enhancing chemosensitivity, consistent with SIRT6 acting as a tumor suppressor in HCC.
context.zh-TW: 肝細胞癌（Hepatocellular Carcinoma）受 SIRT6 抑制。SIRT6 會去乙醯化 hnRNP A1 以抑制糖解作用與代謝重編程；SIRT6 缺失會下調多重抗藥性蛋白 1，增強化療敏感性，與 SIRT6 在 HCC 中扮演腫瘤抑制因子的角色一致。

context.en-US: The tumor microenvironment of hepatocellular carcinoma is rich in cancer-associated fibroblasts, myeloid-derived suppressors, and neovessels via angiogenesis. Senescent hepatic stellate cells in the TME produce SASP factors that drive obesity-associated HCC. The TME is therefore central to HCC biology.
context.zh-TW: 肝細胞癌的腫瘤微環境富含癌症相關纖維母細胞、骨髓來源抑制細胞，以及經由血管新生形成的新生血管。TME 中的衰老肝星狀細胞產生 SASP 因子，驅動肥胖相關 HCC。因此 TME 對 HCC 生物學至關重要。

context.en-US: Activation of the YAP1/TAZ pathway is a molecular driver of hepatocellular carcinoma, and YAP1 is the target of ivermectin's anti-HCC activity. Targeting YAP1/TAZ and downstream metabolic rewiring remains a priority. YAP1 is therefore relevant to both HCC pathogenesis and therapy.
context.zh-TW: YAP1/TAZ 途徑的激活是肝細胞癌的分子驅動因子，而 YAP1 是 ivermectin 抗 HCC 活性的靶點。靶向 YAP1/TAZ 及其下游代謝重編程仍是優先事項。因此 YAP1 與 HCC 的發病機制和治療均相關。

context.en-US: HER2 drives Breast Cancer. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The relationship is directional, with HER2 acting as the operative agent upon Breast Cancer rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: HER2 驅動 Breast Cancer。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。這種關係是有方向的，HER2 充當 Breast Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: HER2 is targeted by melittin. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward HER2, so melittin is the active agent and HER2 the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: HER2 是 melittin 的目標。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 向 HER2，因此 melittin 是活性劑，HER2 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: HER2 is targeted by trastuzumab. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against HER2 that inhibits signaling and recruits immune effector mechanisms in HER2-positive breast cancer. The directionality runs from trastuzumab toward HER2, so trastuzumab is the active agent and HER2 the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: HER2 是 trastuzumab 的目標。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。曲妥珠單抗是一種針對 HER2 的單株抗體，可抑制訊號傳導並在 HER2 陽性 Breast Cancer 中招募免疫效應機制。方向性從 trastuzumab 向 HER2，因此 trastuzumab 是活性劑，HER2 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Beyond its role in NF-kB signaling, IKK directly phosphorylates pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 family members such as Puma and Bad, modulating their activity and the balance between survival and death. This links inflammatory signaling to cell-survival decisions. IKK thus has a dual role in regulating apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 除了在 NF-kB 訊號傳導中的作用外，IKK 還直接磷酸化 Puma 和 Bad 等促凋亡 Bcl-2 家族成員，調節其活性以及存活與死亡之間的平衡。這將發炎訊號與細胞存活決策連結起來。因此 IKK 在調節細胞凋亡方面具有雙重作用。

context.en-US: IKK phosphorylates Bad. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon Bad rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
