context.zh-TW: IKK 磷酸化Bad。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。這種關係是有方向的，IKK 充當 Bad 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: IKK is activated in Cancer. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward IKK, so Cancer is the active agent and IKK the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: IKK 在 Cancer 中活化。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 IKK，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，IKK 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Activated IKK phosphorylates the inhibitor IkappaBalpha at Ser32/Ser36, triggering K48-linked ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of IkappaBalpha. This liberates the p50/RelA NF-kB dimer for nuclear translocation. Phosphorylation of IkappaBalpha is the canonical step through which IKK controls NF-kB signaling.
context.zh-TW: 激活的 IKK 在 Ser32/Ser36 磷酸化抑制因子 IkappaBalpha，觸發 K48 連接的泛素化與 IkappaBalpha 的蛋白酶體降解。這使 p50/RelA NF-kB 二聚體得以釋放並轉位至細胞核。磷酸化 IkappaBalpha 是 IKK 控制 NF-kB 訊號傳導的經典步驟。

context.en-US: The IKK complex contains the catalytic subunits IKKalpha (IKK1) and IKKbeta (IKK2) along with the regulatory scaffold IKKgamma/NEMO. IKKalpha contributes to alternative (non-canonical) NF-kB activation through phosphorylation of the p100 precursor. It is a structural and functional component of the IKK signalosome.
context.zh-TW: IKK 複合體含有催化亞基 IKKalpha（IKK1）和 IKKbeta（IKK2），以及調控支架 IKKgamma/NEMO。IKKalpha 透過磷酸化 p100 前驅物，參與替代性（非經典）NF-kB 激活。它是 IKK 訊號體的结构與功能組成部分。

context.en-US: IKKbeta (IKK2) is the principal catalytic subunit of the IKK complex activated by inflammatory stimuli such as TNF-alpha and IL-1. It is phosphorylated by TAK1 at Ser177/Ser181 during canonical activation. IKKbeta is frequently required for tumor initiation and maintenance in cancer models.
context.zh-TW: IKKbeta（IKK2）是 IKK 複合體的主要催化亞基，由 TNF-alpha 和 IL-1 等發炎刺激激活。在經典激活期間，它會被 TAK1 在 Ser177/Ser181 磷酸化。IKKbeta 在癌症模型中常為腫瘤起始與維持所需。

context.en-US: IKK/NF-kB signaling is intimately linked to inflammation, both as a downstream consequence of inflammatory stimuli and as a driver of inflammatory gene expression. Constitutive IKK/NF-kB activation is one of the Hallmarks of Cancer. This places IKK at the crossroads of inflammation and tumor cell fate.
context.zh-TW: IKK/NF-kB 訊號傳導與發炎密切相關，既是發炎刺激的下游結果，也是發炎基因表現的驅動者。IKK/NF-kB 的持續激活是癌症的標誌之一。這使 IKK 位於發炎與腫瘤細胞命運的十字路口。

context.en-US: IKK activates NFκB. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon NFκB rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: IKK 活化 NFκB。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。這種關係是定向的，IKK 充當 NFκB 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: IKK phosphorylates Puma. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. Puma is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein that binds and neutralizes essentially all anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 relatives to license mitochondrial death. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon Puma rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: IKK 磷酸化Puma。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 Puma 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，可結合並中和幾乎所有抗凋亡 Bcl-2 相關蛋白，從而允許粒線體死亡。這種關係是有方向的，IKK 充當 Puma 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: By phosphorylating and degrading XIAP, IKKepsilon relieves suppression of caspases and sensitizes cells to death stimuli. This is particularly relevant during virus-induced apoptosis, where IKKepsilon helps eliminate infected cells. IKKepsilon thereby potentiates the apoptotic program.
context.zh-TW: 透過磷酸化並降解 XIAP，IKKepsilon 解除對半胱天冬酶的抑制，並使細胞對死亡刺激敏感化。這在病毒誘導的細胞凋亡中尤其重要，IKKepsilon 在此協助清除受感染的細胞。因此 IKKepsilon 增強了細胞凋亡程式。

context.en-US: IKKepsilon is frequently amplified or overexpressed in subsets of breast, ovarian, and lung tumors, where it promotes proliferation, EMT, and metastasis. Because IKKepsilon overexpression supports tumor growth and therapy resistance, it is under investigation as a therapeutic target. Selective IKKepsilon/TBK1 inhibitors have shown antitumor activity in IKKepsilon-driven models.
context.zh-TW: IKKepsilon 在乳癌、卵巢癌與肺癌亞型中常被擴增或過度表現，並在此促進增殖、EMT 與轉移。由於 IKKepsilon 的過度表現支持腫瘤生長與治療抗性，它正被研究作為治療靶點。選擇性 IKKepsilon/TBK1 抑制劑已在 IKKepsilon 驅動的模型中顯示抗腫瘤活性。

context.en-US: In cancer, IKKepsilon overexpression promotes proliferation and epithelial-mesenchymal transition through NF-kB- and IRF-dependent target genes. It is frequently amplified or overexpressed in subsets of breast, ovarian, and lung tumors. IKKepsilon-driven EMT supports the invasive and metastatic phenotype.
context.zh-TW: 在癌症中，IKKepsilon 的過度表現透過 NF-kB 與 IRF 依賴的目標基因促進增殖與上皮間質轉化。它在乳癌、卵巢癌與肺癌亞型中常被擴增或過度表現。IKKepsilon 驅動的 EMT 支持侵襲與轉移性表型。

context.en-US: IKKepsilon overexpression in subsets of breast, ovarian, and lung tumors supports proliferation, EMT, and metastasis through NF-kB- and IRF-dependent programs. Its ability to degrade XIAP also couples death signaling to tumor cell vulnerability. IKKepsilon thereby contributes to cancer dissemination.
context.zh-TW: IKKepsilon 在乳癌、卵巢癌與肺癌亞型中的過度表現，透過 NF-kB 與 IRF 依賴的程式支持增殖、EMT 與轉移。其降解 XIAP 的能力也將死亡訊號與腫瘤細胞脆弱性連結起來。因此 IKKepsilon 有助於癌症的擴散。

context.en-US: IKKepsilon is closely related to TBK1, its closest paralog, with which it shares overlapping substrates in the type I interferon response including IRF3 and IRF7. Both kinases contribute to innate antiviral immunity and oncogenic signaling. Their overlapping functions make them jointly attractive therapeutic targets.
context.zh-TW: IKKepsilon 與其最接近的旁系同源基因 TBK1 密切相關，兩者在第一型干擾素反應中共享重疊的受質，包括 IRF3 和 IRF7。兩種激酶都參與先天抗病毒免疫與致癌性訊號傳導。其重疊功能使它們共同成為具吸引力的治療靶點。

context.en-US: IKKepsilon phosphorylates the inhibitor of apoptosis protein XIAP, marking it for degradation. This relieves caspase suppression and lowers the threshold for apoptosis. The XIAP-degradation function couples antiviral death signaling to tumor cell vulnerability.
context.zh-TW: IKKepsilon 磷酸化凋亡抑制蛋白 XIAP，標記其進行降解。這會解除對半胱天冬酶的抑制，並降低細胞凋亡的閾值。XIAP 降解功能將抗病毒死亡訊號與腫瘤細胞的脆弱性連結起來。

context.en-US: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Immune Checkpoint is targeted by Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Immune checkpoint inhibitors are antibodies that release the brakes on T cells by blocking PD-1/PD-L1 or CTLA-4 interactions. The directionality runs from Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors toward Immune Checkpoint, so Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: Immune Checkpoint 是 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 的目標。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是透過阻斷 PD-1/PD-L1 或 CTLA-4 交互作用來釋放 T 細胞煞車作用的抗體。方向性從 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 向 Immune Checkpoint 延伸，因此 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Immune Checkpoint includes PD-L1. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. The relationship is directional, with Immune Checkpoint acting as the operative agent upon PD-L1 rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Immune Checkpoint 包括PD-L1。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。這種關係是有方向的，Immune Checkpoint 充當 PD-L1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins are overexpressed in Cancer. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins, so Cancer is the active agent and Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: Cancer 中 Cancer 過度表現。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Cancer 延伸，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins relates to Caspase-3 through the relation inhibit. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 透過關係抑制與 Caspase-3 相關。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins relates to Caspase-7 through the relation inhibit. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Caspase-7 is an executioner caspase closely related to caspase-3 that contributes to the proteolytic demolition of the cell. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-7 透過關係抑制與 Caspase-7 相關。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Caspase-7 是一種與 caspase-3 密切相關的劊子手 caspase，有助於細胞的蛋白水解破壞。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins relates to Caspase-9 through the relation inhibit. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-9 透過關係抑制與 Caspase-9 相關。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins are antagonized by Smac-DIABLO. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The directionality runs from Smac-DIABLO toward Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins, so Smac-DIABLO is the active agent and Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: 被 Smac-DIABLO 對抗。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。方向性從 Smac-DIABLO 朝向 ϵ，因此 Smac-DIABLO 是活性劑，並且 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Intrinsic Pathway activates Apoptosome. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. The relationship is directional, with Intrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosome rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Intrinsic Pathway 啟動Apoptosome。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。這種關係是有方向的，Intrinsic Pathway 充當Apoptosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Intrinsic Pathway is inhibited by Bcl-2. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 toward Intrinsic Pathway, so Bcl-2 is the active agent and Intrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Intrinsic Pathway 被Bcl-2 抑制。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。方向性從 Bcl-2 朝向 Intrinsic Pathway，因此 Bcl-2 是活性劑，Intrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Intrinsic Pathway is regulated by Bcl-2 family. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Intrinsic Pathway, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Intrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Intrinsic Pathway 受Bcl-2 family 調節。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從Bcl-2 family 向Intrinsic Pathway 延伸，因此Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Intrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Intrinsic Pathway activates Caspase-9. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The relationship is directional, with Intrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-9 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Intrinsic Pathway 活化 Caspase-9。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。這種關係是有方向的，Intrinsic Pathway 充當 Caspase-9 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Intrinsic Pathway relates to MOMP through the relation involves. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Intrinsic Pathway 透過涉及關係與 MOMP 相關。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Intrinsic Pathway is inhibited by XIAP. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Intrinsic Pathway, so XIAP is the active agent and Intrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Intrinsic Pathway 被XIAP 抑制。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Intrinsic Pathway，因此 XIAP 是活性劑，Intrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits Akt. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Akt rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制 Akt。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 Akt 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Ivermectin induces Apoptosis. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 誘發 Apoptosis。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Ivermectin induces Autophagy. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Autophagy is a lysosomal degradation pathway that recycles organelles and protein to maintain homeostasis and can promote both survival and, at extremes, cell death. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Autophagy rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 誘發Autophagy。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 Autophagy是一種溶小體降解途徑，可回收細胞器和蛋白質以維持體內平衡，並可促進細胞存活，在極端情況下還可促進細胞死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 Autophagy 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Ivermectin is the 22,23-dihydro derivative of avermectin B1a, produced by chemical reduction of the natural avermectin fermentation product.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin是阿維菌素B1a的22,23-二氫衍生物，由天然阿維菌素發酵產物化學還原而成。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits Cancer Stem Cells. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Cancer Stem Cells rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制Cancer Stem Cells。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 Cancer Stem Cells 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Ivermectin suppresses cholangiocarcinoma cell proliferation and migration in preclinical models.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制臨牀前模型中膽管癌細胞的增殖和遷移。

context.en-US: Ivermectin synergizes with Cisplatin. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Cisplatin is a platinum compound that forms intra- and inter-strand DNA crosslinks, triggering damage responses that can culminate in senescence or death. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Cisplatin rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 與 Cisplatin 具有協同作用。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 Cisplatin 是一種鉑化合物，可形成鏈內和鏈間 DNA 交聯，引發損傷反應，最終導致老化或死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 Cisplatin 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Ivermectin synergizes with docetaxel. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Docetaxel is a taxane that stabilizes microtubules, arresting mitosis and inducing cell death in a range of carcinomas. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon docetaxel rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 與 docetaxel 協同作用。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。多西紫杉醇是一種紫杉烷，可穩定微管、阻止有絲分裂並誘導多種癌症的細胞死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 docetaxel 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Ivermectin, long used as an antiparasitic agent, has been repositioned in oncology based on its ability to inhibit PAK1, suppress Wnt/YAP1/Akt-mTOR signaling, and induce death. Because its human safety profile is already established, repurposing circumvents much of the early development risk. The relationship is directional: a known drug is being given a new cancer indication. Caution remains that most anticancer evidence is preclinical, with optimal dosing and efficacy in patients still under study.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 長期用作抗寄生蟲藥，由於其抑制 PAK1、抑制 Wnt/YAP1/Akt-mTOR 訊號傳導和誘導死亡的能力，已在腫瘤學中重新定位。由於其人類安全狀況已經確定，重新利用可以規避大部分早期開發風險。這種關係是定向的：一種已知的藥物正在被賦予新的癌症適應症。需要注意的是，大多數抗癌證據都是臨牀前的，患者的最佳劑量和療效仍在研究中。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits EMT. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon EMT rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制EMT。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 EMT 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Ivermectin preferentially kills leukemia cells at low concentrations while sparing normal hematopoietic cells in preclinical screens (Tang et al., 2020; PMID 32971268).
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 在臨牀前篩選中優先殺死低濃度的白血病細胞，同時保留正常造血細胞（Tang et al., 2020；PMID 32971268）。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits mTOR. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. mTOR is a nutrient- and growth-factor-sensitive kinase that integrates PI3K/Akt inputs to control protein synthesis and cell growth. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon mTOR rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制mTOR。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 mTOR 是一種營養和生長因子敏感激酶，可整合 PI3K/Akt 輸入來控制蛋白質合成和細胞生長。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 mTOR 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Ivermectin reverses Multidrug Resistance. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Multidrug Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 反轉Multidrug Resistance。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。這種關係是有方向性的，Ivermectin 充當 Multidrug Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Ivermectin synergizes with paclitaxel. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Paclitaxel is a microtubule-stabilizing taxane used broadly in breast, ovarian, and lung cancers. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon paclitaxel rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 與 paclitaxel 具有協同作用。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。紫杉醇是一種微管穩定紫杉烷，廣泛用於乳房、卵巢和卵巢。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 paclitaxel 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Ivermectin induces Pyroptosis. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Pyroptosis is an inflammatory, gasdermin-mediated lytic cell death that can be engaged in tumors as an alternative lethal program. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Pyroptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 誘發Pyroptosis。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 Pyroptosis 是一種發炎性的、gasdermin 介導的溶解性細胞死亡，可以作為一種替代的致死程序參與腫瘤。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當Pyroptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Ivermectin was developed from avermectin by William C. Campbell and colleagues at Merck.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 是由 William C. Campbell 和默克公司的同事從阿維菌素中開發出來的。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits Wnt. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. Wnt signaling is a conserved pathway controlling cell fate and stemness whose beta-catenin arm is aberrantly activated in many cancers. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon Wnt rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制Wnt。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。訊號傳導是控制細胞命運和乾性的保守途徑，其β-連環蛋白臂在許多癌症中被異常活化。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當Wnt 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits YAP1. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. YAP1 is the transcriptional co-activator of the Hippo pathway that, when nuclear, promotes proliferation and is inhibited by ivermectin in several cancers. The relationship is directional, with Ivermectin acting as the operative agent upon YAP1 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 抑制YAP1。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。 YAP1 是 Hippo 途徑的轉錄共活化因子，當進入細胞核時，可促進增殖，並在多種癌症中被伊維菌素抑制。這種關係是有方向的，Ivermectin 充當 YAP1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: JNK promotes Apoptosis. JNK is a stress-activated MAPK that can promote apoptosis through Bim and Mcl-1 regulation yet also support tumor invasion. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with JNK acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: JNK 促進 Apoptosis。 JNK是一種壓力活化的MAPK，可以透過Bim和Mcl-1調節促進細胞凋亡，同時也支持腫瘤侵襲。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，JNK 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: JNK phosphorylates Bim. JNK is a stress-activated MAPK that can promote apoptosis through Bim and Mcl-1 regulation yet also support tumor invasion. Bim is a sentinel BH3-only protein sequestered at microtubules that is released by stress to directly activate Bax/Bak. The relationship is directional, with JNK acting as the operative agent upon Bim rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: JNK 磷酸化Bim。 JNK是一種壓力活化的MAPK，可以透過Bim和Mcl-1調節促進細胞凋亡，同時也支持腫瘤侵襲。 Bim 是一種隔離在微管中的前哨 BH3 蛋白，壓力釋放時可直接活化 Bax/Bak。這種關係是有方向的，JNK 充當 Bim 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: JNK promotes EMT. JNK is a stress-activated MAPK that can promote apoptosis through Bim and Mcl-1 regulation yet also support tumor invasion. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. The relationship is directional, with JNK acting as the operative agent upon EMT rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: JNK 促進 EMT。 JNK是一種壓力活化的MAPK，可以透過Bim和Mcl-1調節促進細胞凋亡，同時也支持腫瘤侵襲。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。這種關係是有方向的，JNK 充當 EMT 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: JNK is a type of MAPK. JNK is a stress-activated MAPK that can promote apoptosis through Bim and Mcl-1 regulation yet also support tumor invasion. The mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades relay extracellular signals to transcriptional programs governing proliferation and stress responses. The directionality runs from MAPK toward JNK, so MAPK is the active agent and JNK the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: JNK 是 MAPK 的一種。 JNK是一種壓力活化的MAPK，可以透過Bim和Mcl-1調節促進細胞凋亡，同時也支持腫瘤侵襲。絲裂原活化的蛋白激酶級聯將細胞外訊號傳遞至控制增殖和壓力反應的轉錄程序。方向性從 MAPK 向 JNK，因此 MAPK 是活性劑，JNK 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: JNK phosphorylates Mcl-1. JNK is a stress-activated MAPK that can promote apoptosis through Bim and Mcl-1 regulation yet also support tumor invasion. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The relationship is directional, with JNK acting as the operative agent upon Mcl-1 rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: JNK 磷酸化Mcl-1。 JNK是一種壓力活化的MAPK，可以透過Bim和Mcl-1調節促進細胞凋亡，同時也支持腫瘤侵襲。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。這種關係是有方向的，JNK 充當 Mcl-1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: Satoshi Omura performed the soil-microbe screening that isolated Streptomyces avermectinius at the Kitasato Institute, Tokyo.
context.zh-TW: Satoshi Omura 在東京 Kitasato Institute 進行了土壤微生物篩選並分離出 Streptomyces avermectinius。

context.en-US: KRAS relays signals from receptor tyrosine kinases to downstream pathways including the PI3K/Akt cascade. In its active GTP-bound state, KRAS engages effectors that lead to Akt activation. This PI3K/Akt signaling supports cell survival and proliferation downstream of KRAS.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 將來自受體酪胺酸激酶的訊號傳遞到包括 PI3K/Akt 級聯在內的下游途徑。在其活化的 GTP 結合狀態下，KRAS 會接合導致 Akt 激活的效應因子。此 PI3K/Akt 訊號傳導支持 KRAS 下游的細胞存活與增殖。

context.en-US: KRAS mutates in Cancer. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The relationship is directional, with KRAS acting as the operative agent upon Cancer rather than the reverse. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 在 Cancer 中發生變異。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。這種關係是有方向的，KRAS 充當 Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: KRAS is mutated in approximately 40% of colorectal cancers, most commonly at G12V, G12D, and G13D. These hotspot mutations constitutively activate the MAPK/ERK pathway and drive proliferation of intermediate adenomas in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. KRAS mutation status also guides anti-EGFR therapy selection.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 在約 40% 的結直腸癌中發生突變，最常見於 G12V、G12D 和 G13D。這些熱點突變會持續激活 MAPK/ERK 途徑，並在腺瘤–癌序列中驅動中間腺瘤的增殖。KRAS 突變狀態也指導抗 EGFR 療法的選擇。

context.en-US: KRAS mutations frequently co-occur with LKB1 (STK11) loss in lung cancer, a combination that leads to STING silencing and immune evasion. This KL genotype is associated with resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors. The co-mutation thereby defines a distinct, immune-cold tumor subtype.
context.zh-TW: 在肺癌中，KRAS 突變常與 LKB1（STK11）缺失共同發生，此組合會導致 STING 沉默與免疫逃逸。這種 KL 基因型與免疫檢查點抑制劑的抗性有關。因此此共同突變定義了一種獨特的免疫冷性腫瘤亞型。

context.en-US: KRAS is mutated in approximately 30% of lung cancers, with G12C most common in adenocarcinomas of non-small-cell lung cancer. In lung cancer, KRAS mutations often co-occur with LKB1 or KEAP1/NRF2 alterations and p53 mutations. These co-mutations shape the immune and metabolic phenotype of the tumor.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 在約 30% 的肺癌中發生突變，其中 G12C 在非小細胞肺癌的腺癌中最常見。在肺癌中，KRAS 突變常與 LKB1 或 KEAP1/NRF2 改變以及 p53 突變共同發生。這些共同突變塑造了腫瘤的免疫與代謝表型。

context.en-US: KRAS activates MAPK. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. The mitogen-activated protein kinase cascades relay extracellular signals to transcriptional programs governing proliferation and stress responses. The relationship is directional, with KRAS acting as the operative agent upon MAPK rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 激活 MAPK。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。絲裂原活化的蛋白激酶級聯將細胞外訊號傳遞至控制增殖和壓力反應的轉錄程序。這種關係是有方向的，KRAS 充當 MAPK 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: KRAS is a type of Oncogene. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. An oncogene is a gain-of-function version of a normal growth-promoting gene whose aberrant activity drives neoplastic transformation. The directionality runs from Oncogene toward KRAS, so Oncogene is the active agent and KRAS the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 是 Oncogene 的一種。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。癌基因是正常生長促進基因的功能獲得版本，其異常活性可驅動腫瘤轉化。方向性從 Oncogene 向 KRAS，因此 Oncogene 是活性劑，KRAS 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: KRAS is mutated in approximately 90% of pancreatic cancers, with G12D the most common alteration. These mutations impair GTPase activity and lock KRAS in the active GTP-bound state. KRAS mutation is a defining driver of pancreatic tumorigenesis.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 在約 90% 的胰臟癌中發生突變，其中 G12D 是最常見的改變。這些突變會損害 GTPase 活性，並使 KRAS 鎖定在活化的 GTP 結合狀態。KRAS 突變是胰臟腫瘤發生的決定性驅動因子。

context.en-US: KRAS activates PI3K. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. Phosphoinositide 3-kinase generates PIP3 at the membrane to recruit and activate Akt, a central node of growth and survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with KRAS acting as the operative agent upon PI3K rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 活化 PI3K。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。磷酸肌醇 3-激酶在膜上產生 PIP3，以募集並活化 Akt（生長和生存訊號傳導的中心節點）。這種關係是有方向的，KRAS 充當 PI3K 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: KRAS is targeted by Sotorasib. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. Sotorasib is a covalent inhibitor of the KRAS G12C mutant that has demonstrated clinical efficacy in previously refractory lung adenocarcinoma. The directionality runs from Sotorasib toward KRAS, so Sotorasib is the active agent and KRAS the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 是 Sotorasib 的目標。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。 Sotorasib 是 KRAS G12C 突變體的共價抑制劑，已證明對既往難治性肺腺癌具有臨牀療效。方向性從 Sotorasib 朝向 KRAS，因此 Sotorasib 是活性劑，KRAS 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: In lung cancer, KRAS mutations co-occurring with LKB1 loss (the KL genotype) lead to silencing of STING through DNMT1-mediated DNA methylation. This results in reduced type I interferon signaling and lower PD-L1 expression, creating an immune-cold phenotype. KL tumors show resistance to immune checkpoint inhibitors.
context.zh-TW: 在肺癌中，與 LKB1 缺失共同發生的 KRAS 突變（KL 基因型）會透過 DNMT1 介導的 DNA 甲基化使 STING 沉默。這導致第一型干擾素訊號傳導降低與 PD-L1 表現下降，形成免疫冷性表型。KL 腫瘤對免疫檢查點抑制劑表現出抗性。

context.en-US: Leukemia is a clonal hematologic malignancy arising from abnormal hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells.
context.zh-TW: Leukemia 是一種由異常造血幹/祖細胞引起的克隆性血液惡性腫瘤。

context.en-US: Leukemia is treated with cytotoxic chemotherapy and, in selected cases, targeted agents; ivermectin's activity remains preclinical.
context.zh-TW: Leukemia 接受細胞毒性化療，在某些情況下使用標靶藥物；伊維菌素的活性仍處於臨牀前階段。

context.en-US: Leukemic clones derive from transformed hematopoietic stem or progenitor cells.
context.zh-TW: 白血病克隆源自於轉化的造血幹細胞或祖細胞。

context.en-US: Lung Cancer is a type of Cancer. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Lung Cancer, so Cancer is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Lung Cancer 是 Cancer 的一種。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Lung Cancer 延伸，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Lung Cancer is driven by EGFR. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The directionality runs from EGFR toward Lung Cancer, so EGFR is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Lung Cancer 由EGFR 驅動。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。方向性從EGFR向Lung Cancer延伸，因此EGFR是活性劑，Lung Cancer是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Lung Cancer is treated by erlotinib. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Erlotinib is a first-generation EGFR tyrosine-kinase inhibitor used in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer. The directionality runs from erlotinib toward Lung Cancer, so erlotinib is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: Lung Cancer 用 erlotinib 處理。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。厄洛替尼是第一代EGFR酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，用於EGFR突變的非小細胞Lung Cancer。方向性從 erlotinib 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 erlotinib 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Lung Cancer evades Immune System. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. The immune system surveys and eliminates nascent malignancies, a process tumors must subvert to establish and progress. The relationship is directional, with Lung Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Immune System rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Lung Cancer 迴避Immune System。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 Immune System 研究並消除新生的惡性腫瘤，這是腫瘤形成和發展必須顛覆的過程。這種關係是有方向的，Lung Cancer 充當Immune System 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Lung Cancer is inhibited by Ivermectin. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Lung Cancer, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Lung Cancer 被 Ivermectin 抑制。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Lung Cancer is driven by KRAS. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. The directionality runs from KRAS toward Lung Cancer, so KRAS is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Lung Cancer 由KRAS 驅動。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。方向性從 KRAS 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 KRAS 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MDM2 is amplified in Cancer. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward MDM2, so Cancer is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: MDM2 在 Cancer 中被放大。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 MDM2，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: MDM2 is downregulated by Fenbendazole. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. The directionality runs from Fenbendazole toward MDM2, so Fenbendazole is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: MDM2 被 Fenbendazole 下調。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。方向性從 Fenbendazole 向 MDM2，因此 Fenbendazole 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: MDM2 is inhibited by Nutlins. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward MDM2, so Nutlins is the active agent and MDM2 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: MDM2 被 Nutlins 抑制。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 MDM2，因此 Nutlins 是活性劑，MDM2 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: MDM2 relates to p53 through the relation degrades. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: MDM2 透過關係降級與 p53 相關。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: MDM2 blocks p53. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with MDM2 acting as the operative agent upon p53 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: MDM2塊p53。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。這種關係是有方向的，MDM2 充當 p53 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Mebendazole induces mitotic arrest and apoptosis in cancer cells via microtubule depolymerization.
context.zh-TW: Mebendazole 透過微管解聚誘導癌細胞有絲分裂停滯和凋亡。

context.en-US: Mebendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic in the same class as fenbendazole and albendazole.
context.zh-TW: Mebendazole是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，與芬苯達唑和阿苯達唑屬於同一類。

context.en-US: Mebendazole elicits potent antitumor effects in vitro and in vivo across multiple cancers (Mukhopadhyay et al., Clin Cancer Res 2002).
context.zh-TW: Mebendazole 在體外和體內對多種癌症具有有效的抗腫瘤作用（Mukhopadhyay 等人，Clin Cancer Res 2002）。

context.en-US: Mebendazole and fenbendazole are structurally related benzimidazole anthelmintics with overlapping anticancer mechanisms.
context.zh-TW: Mebendazole和芬苯達唑是結構相關的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，具有重疊的抗癌機制。

context.en-US: Mebendazole exerts preclinical antileukemic effects through tubulin depolymerization and mitotic arrest.
context.zh-TW: Mebendazole 透過微管蛋白解聚和有絲分裂停滯發揮臨牀前抗白血病作用。

context.en-US: By blocking tubulin polymerization, mebendazole disrupts the mitotic spindle, causing G2/M arrest and apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 透過阻斷微管蛋白聚合，甲苯咪唑破壞有絲分裂紡錘體，導致 G2/M 期停滯和細胞凋亡。

context.en-US: Mebendazole binds the colchicine site of beta-tubulin, inhibiting microtubule polymerization (Sasaki et al., Mol Cancer Ther 2002).
context.zh-TW: Mebendazole 在秋水仙鹼位點結合 β-微管蛋白，抑制微管組裝（Sasaki et al., Mol Cancer Ther 2002）。

context.en-US: Autophagy supports melanoma survival under metabolic stress and contributes to melanoma progression and resistance to therapy. Interventions such as fasting and intermittent fasting sensitize melanoma cells to treatments by stimulating autophagic apoptosis. Autophagy thereby plays a significant role in melanoma biology.
context.zh-TW: Autophagy 支持黑色素瘤在代謝壓力下的存活，並促成黑色素瘤的進展與治療抗性。禁食與間歇性禁食等干預措施透過刺激自噬性細胞凋亡，使黑色素瘤細胞對治療敏感化。因此 Autophagy 在黑色素瘤生物學中扮演重要角色。

context.en-US: BRAF V600E mutations are present in about 50% of cutaneous melanomas and constitutively activate the MAPK/ERK pathway. Paradoxically, BRAF activation in melanocytes of benign nevi induces oncogene-induced senescence that restrains progression. BRAF is therefore the dominant oncogenic driver of melanoma.
context.zh-TW: BRAF V600E 突變存在於約 50% 的皮膚黑色素瘤中，並持續激活 MAPK/ERK 途徑。矛盾的是，良性痣黑色素細胞中的 BRAF 激活會誘導致癌基因誘導的衰老，從而限制進展。因此 BRAF 是黑色素瘤的主要致癌驅動因子。

context.en-US: Melanoma is an aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from melanocytes, the pigment-producing cells of the skin. It accounts for the majority of skin-cancer deaths due to its high metastatic potential and ability to evade immune surveillance. It is a distinct subtype within the broader category of cancer.
context.zh-TW: Melanoma 是起源於黑色素細胞（皮膚的產色素細胞）的侵襲性惡性腫瘤。由於其高轉移潛力與逃避免疫監視的能力，它佔皮膚癌死亡的大多數。它是癌症這個更廣泛類別中的一個獨特亞型。

context.en-US: Metastatic colonization by melanoma depends on FTSJ1 and the Um34 modification of tRNA[Ser]Sec, which supports translation of antioxidant selenoproteins. FTSJ1-deficient cells are oxidatively stressed and show reduced metastatic colonization. FTSJ1/Um34 is therefore necessary and sufficient for melanoma metastasis in vivo.
context.zh-TW: 黑色素瘤的轉移性定殖依賴 FTSJ1 以及 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 修飾，後者支持抗氧化硒蛋白的轉譯。FTSJ1 缺陷細胞會受到氧化壓力，並表現出轉移性定殖減少。因此 FTSJ1/Um34 在體內對黑色素瘤轉移是必要且充分的。

context.en-US: Honeybee venom has demonstrated antitumoral effects in melanoma and other cancers, with higher cytotoxic potency in cancer cells. Both honeybee venom and its component melittin are studied for their anticancer activity. This positions honeybee venom as a candidate anticancer natural product.
context.zh-TW: Honeybee venom 在黑色素瘤和其他癌症中顯示出抗腫瘤效應，且對癌細胞的細胞毒性效力更高。蜂毒及其成分 Melittin 均被研究其抗癌活性。這使蜂毒成為具潛力的抗癌天然產物。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits melanoma activity and lung metastasis by acting as a PAK1 inhibitor and inducing autophagy-dependent cell death. It shows synergistic effects with dabrafenib. Ivermectin is thereby studied as a repurposed anticancer agent against melanoma.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 透過作為 PAK1 抑制劑並誘導依賴自噬的細胞死亡，抑制黑色素瘤活性與肺轉移。它與 dabrafenib 顯示協同效應。因此 Ivermectin 被研究作為對抗黑色素瘤的再利用抗癌藥物。

context.en-US: Melittin, a component of honeybee venom, has demonstrated antitumoral effects in melanoma by inhibiting the MAPK signaling pathway. It shows higher cytotoxic potency in cancer cells than in normal cells. Melittin is therefore studied as a natural-product agent against melanoma.
context.zh-TW: Melittin 是蜂毒的一種成分，透過抑制 MAPK 訊號傳導途徑，在黑色素瘤中顯示出抗腫瘤效應。它對癌細胞的細胞毒性效力高於正常細胞。因此 Melittin 被研究作為對抗黑色素瘤的天然產物製劑。

context.en-US: Melanoma has a high propensity for early metastasis and accounts for the majority of skin-cancer deaths through metastatic spread. Metastatic colonization is an oxidative-stress-sensitive process dependent on FTSJ1/Um34-driven selenoprotein translation. Oxidative stress inhibits the ability of melanoma cells to colonize distant sites.
context.zh-TW: Melanoma 具有早期轉移的高度傾向，並透過轉移擴散造成大多數皮膚癌死亡。轉移性定殖是一個對氧化壓力敏感的過程，依賴 FTSJ1/Um34 驅動的硒蛋白轉譯。氧化壓力會抑制黑色素瘤細胞定殖遠處部位的能力。

context.en-US: MITF amplification drives proliferation in melanoma, and MITF-M, an isoform enriched in melanoma, correlates strongly with expression of lysosomal genes containing CLEAR elements. MITF is a lineage-defining transcription factor for melanocytes. It contributes to the proliferative and lysosomal program of melanoma cells.
context.zh-TW: MITF 擴增驅動黑色素瘤中的增殖，而富含於黑色素瘤的 MITF-M 異構體與含有 CLEAR 元件的溶酶體基因表現密切相關。MITF 是黑色素細胞的譜系定義轉錄因子。它促成黑色素瘤細胞的增殖與溶酶體程式。

context.en-US: Epidemiological studies reveal a significant and reciprocal association between melanoma and Parkinson's disease, with each disorder increasing the risk of the other. This reflects shared biology of pigment cells and genetic overlap in pigmentation genes. Melanocytes and neuromelanin-containing dopaminergic neurons share the melanogenesis enzyme toolkit and vulnerability to oxidative damage.
context.zh-TW: 流行病學研究顯示黑色素瘤與帕金森氏症之間存在顯著且互惠的關聯，每一種疾病都會增加另一種疾病的風險。這反映了色素細胞的共同生物學以及色素沉著基因的遺傳重疊。黑色素細胞與含神經黑色素的多巴胺神經元共享黑色素生成酶工具組，並對氧化損傷具有共同脆弱性。

context.en-US: Melanoma is promoted by SASP. Senescent melanocytes in nevi are held in check by oncogene-induced senescence driven by BRAF V600E, but the SASP they produce—particularly IL-8 and GROα—can stimulate the proliferation of rare premalignant cells that escaped senescence, potentially driving melanoma development.
context.zh-TW: 黑色素瘤（Melanoma）受 SASP 促進。痣中的衰老黑色素細胞受 BRAF V600E 驅動的致癌基因誘導衰老（OIS）所抑制，但它們所產生的 SASP——尤其是 IL-8 與 GROα——可刺激已逃脫衰老的罕見癌前細胞增殖，可能驅動黑色素瘤的發展。

context.en-US: Melanoma is supported by Selenocysteine. Micrometastatic melanoma cells upregulate selenocysteine biosynthesis; efficient Sec insertion—dependent on the Um34 tRNA modification installed by FTSJ1—supports translation of antioxidant selenoproteins (e.g., GPx4, thioredoxin reductase) that buffer ROS and are required for metastatic colonization.
context.zh-TW: 黑色素瘤（Melanoma）依賴 Selenocysteine 支持。微轉移的黑色素瘤細胞會上調硒代半胱氨酸（Selenocysteine）生合成；有效插入 Sec——依賴由 FTSJ1 安裝的 Um34 tRNA 修飾——可支持抗氧化硒蛋白（如 GPx4、硫氧還蛋白還原酶）的轉譯，這些蛋白緩衝 ROS 並為轉移定植所必需。

context.en-US: Oncogene-induced senescence in melanocytes restrains melanoma progression, acting as a tumor-suppressive barrier. However, the SASP produced by senescent melanocytes can paradoxically stimulate the proliferation of premalignant cells that escaped senescence. Senescence is thus a double-edged sword in melanoma development.
context.zh-TW: 黑色素細胞中的致癌基因誘導衰老會限制黑色素瘤的進展，作為腫瘤抑制屏障。然而，衰老黑色素細胞產生的 SASP 反而可能刺激逃脫衰老的癌前細胞增殖。因此衰老在黑色素瘤發展中是一把雙刃劍。

context.en-US: melittin induces Caspase-3. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: melittin 誘發 Caspase-3。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: melittin disrupts Cell Membrane. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The cell membrane is the lipid bilayer whose integrity and receptor composition govern signaling, transport, and survival of tumor cells. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon Cell Membrane rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: melittin 擾亂 Cell Membrane。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 Cell Membrane 是脂質雙層，其完整性和受體組成控制腫瘤細胞的訊號傳導、運輸和存活。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 Cell Membrane 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: melittin synergizes with Cisplatin. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. Cisplatin is a platinum compound that forms intra- and inter-strand DNA crosslinks, triggering damage responses that can culminate in senescence or death. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon Cisplatin rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: melittin 與 Cisplatin 具有協同作用。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 Cisplatin 是一種鉑化合物，可形成鏈內和鏈間 DNA 交聯，引發損傷反應，最終導致老化或死亡。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 Cisplatin 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: melittin synergizes with docetaxel. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. Docetaxel is a taxane that stabilizes microtubules, arresting mitosis and inducing cell death in a range of carcinomas. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon docetaxel rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: melittin 與 docetaxel 具有協同作用。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。多西紫杉醇是一種紫杉烷，可穩定微管、阻止有絲分裂並誘導多種癌症的細胞死亡。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 docetaxel 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: melittin inhibits EGFR. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon EGFR rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: melittin 抑制 EGFR。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 EGFR 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: melittin inhibits HER2. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon HER2 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: melittin 抑制 HER2。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 HER2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: melittin reduces PD-L1. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. The relationship is directional, with melittin acting as the operative agent upon PD-L1 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: melittin 減少PD-L1。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。這種關係是有方向的，melittin 充當 PD-L1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Metabolic Reprogramming is inhibited by Fenbendazole. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Fenbendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic under investigation for anticancer effects via microtubule interference, glycolysis suppression, and p53 activation. The directionality runs from Fenbendazole toward Metabolic Reprogramming, so Fenbendazole is the active agent and Metabolic Reprogramming the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 被 Fenbendazole 抑制。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Fenbendazole 是一種苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，正在研究透過微管幹擾、糖酵解抑制和 p53 活化來發揮抗癌作用。方向性從 Fenbendazole 朝向 Metabolic Reprogramming，因此 Fenbendazole 是主動主體，Metabolic Reprogramming 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to GLUT1 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. GLUT1 is a high-capacity glucose transporter markedly upregulated on the tumor-cell surface to feed the glycolytic phenotype. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 GLUT1 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 GLUT1 是一種高容量葡萄糖轉運蛋白，在腫瘤細胞表面顯著上調以供給糖解表型。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Metabolic Reprogramming is a hallmark of Hallmarks of Cancer. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The Hallmarks of Cancer are the enabling biological capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis, including sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The directionality runs from Hallmarks of Cancer toward Metabolic Reprogramming, so Hallmarks of Cancer is the active agent and Metabolic Reprogramming the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 是Hallmarks of Cancer 的記號。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Hallmarks of Cancer是腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的生物學能力，包括持續增生、逃避死亡和轉移。方向性從 Hallmarks of Cancer 朝向 Metabolic Reprogramming，因此 Hallmarks of Cancer 是活性劑，Metabolic Reprogramming 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Hexokinase 2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Hexokinase 2 is the glycolytic first-step enzyme most strongly induced in cancer, where it often tethers to mitochondria to couple glycolysis to survival. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 Hexokinase 2 與 Hexokinase 2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Hexokinase 2 是癌症中最強烈誘導的糖解第一步酶，它經常與粒線體結合，將糖解與生存結合。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Pyruvate Kinase M2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Pyruvate kinase M2 is the embryonic/warburg isoform that diverts glycolytic flux toward biosynthetic precursors rather than efficient ATP production. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 Pyruvate Kinase M2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Pyruvate Kinase M2 是胚胎/warburg 亞型，它將糖解通量轉向生物合成前體而不是有效的 ATP 生產。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Metabolic Reprogramming includes Warburg Effect. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. The relationship is directional, with Metabolic Reprogramming acting as the operative agent upon Warburg Effect rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 包括Warburg Effect。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。這種關係是有方向的，Metabolic Reprogramming 充當Warburg Effect 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Through its stabilization of Bcl-2, MKP-3 reinforces resistance to apoptosis and can be co-opted in cancer to sustain Bcl-2 abundance. Reduced MKP-3 lowers Bcl-2 and can sensitize tumors to apoptosis. MKP-3-Bcl-2 crosstalk is a potential therapeutic node in restoring apoptotic competence.
context.zh-TW: 透過穩定 Bcl-2，MKP-3 強化對細胞凋亡的抗性，並可能在癌症中被利用以維持 Bcl-2 的豐度。MKP-3 降低會使 Bcl-2 下降，並可使腫瘤對細胞凋亡敏感化。MKP-3–Bcl-2 交叉對話是恢復細胞凋亡能力方面的潛在治療節點。

context.en-US: MKP-3 binds Bcl-2 and removes phosphate groups at Thr56, Thr74, and Ser87, which normally prime Bcl-2 for ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation. By dephosphorylating Bcl-2, MKP-3 prevents its turnover and elevates cellular Bcl-2 levels. This is the non-canonical apoptosis-relevant function of MKP-3.
context.zh-TW: MKP-3 結合 Bcl-2，並移除 Thr56、Thr74 和 Ser87 上的磷酸基團，這些位點的磷酸化通常會使 Bcl-2 準備進行泛素化與蛋白酶體降解。透過去磷酸化 Bcl-2，MKP-3 防止其周轉並提升細胞內 Bcl-2 水平。這是 MKP-3 與細胞凋亡相關的非經典功能。

context.en-US: By dephosphorylating Bcl-2 at Thr56, Thr74, and Ser87, MKP-3 prevents Bcl-2 ubiquitination and degradation, stabilizing the anti-apoptotic protein. This elevates cellular Bcl-2 levels and reinforces resistance to apoptosis. MKP-3 thereby couples MAPK pathway status to the mitochondrial death decision.
context.zh-TW: 透過在 Thr56、Thr74 和 Ser87 去磷酸化 Bcl-2，MKP-3 防止 Bcl-2 的泛素化與降解，從而穩定這種抗凋亡蛋白。這提升細胞內 Bcl-2 水平並強化對細胞凋亡的抗性。因此 MKP-3 將 MAPK 途徑狀態與粒線體死亡決策連結起來。

context.en-US: In cancer, MKP-3 can be co-opted to sustain Bcl-2 abundance, contributing to cancer cell survival under stress and evasion of chemotherapy-induced apoptosis. MKP-3 expression is explored as a biomarker of MAPK pathway activity and treatment response. The context-dependent role of MKP-3 makes it a relevant oncology target.
context.zh-TW: 在癌症中，MKP-3 可能被利用以維持 Bcl-2 的豐度，促成癌細胞在壓力下的存活與逃避化療誘導的細胞凋亡。MKP-3 表現被探索作為 MAPK 途徑活性與治療反應的生物標記。MKP-3 的情境依賴角色使其成為相關的腫瘤學靶點。

context.en-US: MKP-3 inactivates ERK by hydrolyzing the phosphothreonine and phosphotyrosine residues of its activation loop. This provides a negative feedback brake on proliferative RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling. ERK1/2 is the canonical MAPK substrate of MKP-3.
context.zh-TW: MKP-3 透過水解 ERK 激活環上的磷酸蘇氨酸與磷酸酪氨酸殘基，使 ERK 失活。這為增殖性 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK 訊號傳導提供了負回饋煞車。ERK1/2 是 MKP-3 的經典 MAPK 受質。

context.en-US: MKP-3 is a dual-specificity phosphatase of the MAP kinase phosphatase family that shuts off ERK1/2 signaling. It tempers mitogenic signaling by inactivating ERK within the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade. MKP-3 thereby provides negative feedback control over the MAPK pathway.
context.zh-TW: MKP-3 是 MAP 激酶磷酸酶家族的雙特異性磷酸酶，可關閉 ERK1/2 訊號傳導。它透過使 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK 級聯中的 ERK 失活來調節有絲分裂訊號。因此 MKP-3 對 MAPK 途徑提供負回饋控制。

context.en-US: MMP promotes Angiogenesis. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MMP 促進 Angiogenesis。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MMP promotes Metastasis. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MMP 促進Metastasis。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MMP is a component of SASP. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The senescence-associated secretory phenotype is the pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells that can both restrain and, chronically, promote tumors. The directionality runs from SASP toward MMP, so SASP is the active agent and MMP the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: MMP 是 SASP 的組成。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。老化相關的分泌表型是衰老細胞的促發炎分泌組，它既可以抑制腫瘤，也可以長期促進腫瘤。方向性從 SASP 向 MMP，因此 SASP 是活性劑，MMP 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: MMP remodels Tumor Microenvironment. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Tumor Microenvironment rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MMP改造Tumor Microenvironment。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Tumor Microenvironment 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MOMP is driven by Bak. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bak is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector anchored at the mitochondrial outer membrane that cooperates with Bax to execute MOMP.
