The directionality runs from Bak toward MOMP, so Bak is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 由Bak 驅動。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bak 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，錨定在粒線體外膜上，與 Bax 合作執行 MOMP。方向性從 Bak 向 MOMP，因此 Bak 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MOMP is driven by Bax. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bax is a pro-apoptotic Bcl-2 effector that, upon activation, oligomerizes to form the pores that permeabilize the mitochondrial outer membrane. The directionality runs from Bax toward MOMP, so Bax is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 由Bax 驅動。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bax 是一種促凋亡 Bcl-2 效應子，活化後會寡聚形成使粒線體外膜通透的孔。方向性從 Bax 朝向 MOMP，因此 Bax 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MOMP is inhibited by Bcl-2. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 toward MOMP, so Bcl-2 is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 被 Bcl-2 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。方向性從 Bcl-2 朝向 MOMP，因此 Bcl-2 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: MOMP is inhibited by Bcl-xL. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Bcl-xL is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein that maintains mitochondrial integrity and is essential for platelet and many tumor-cell survival. The directionality runs from Bcl-xL toward MOMP, so Bcl-xL is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 被 Bcl-xL 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Bcl-xL 是一種抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，可維持粒線體完整性，對於血小板和許多腫瘤細胞的存活至關重要。方向性從 Bcl-xL 朝向 MOMP，因此 Bcl-xL 是主動主體，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: MOMP is restored by BH3 mimetics. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward MOMP, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 由 BH3 mimetics 恢復。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從 BH3 mimetics 朝向 MOMP，因此 BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MOMP releases Cytochrome c. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Cytochrome c is an electron-carrier of the respiratory chain that, once released to the cytosol, nucleates apoptosome assembly. The relationship is directional, with MOMP acting as the operative agent upon Cytochrome c rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 釋放 Cytochrome c。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Cytochrome c 是呼吸鏈的電子載體，一旦釋放到細胞質中，就會使凋亡體組裝成核。這種關係是有方向的，MOMP 充當 Cytochrome c 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MOMP is inhibited by Mcl-1. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Mcl-1 is a labile anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family protein whose rapid turnover makes it a frequent, difficult-to-target resistance determinant in cancer. The directionality runs from Mcl-1 toward MOMP, so Mcl-1 is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 被 Mcl-1 抑制。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Mcl-1 是一種不穩定的抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 蛋白，其快速週轉使其成為癌症中常見的、難以靶向的抗藥性決定因素。方向性從 Mcl-1 朝向 MOMP，因此 Mcl-1 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: MOMP is regulated by p53. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The directionality runs from p53 toward MOMP, so p53 is the active agent and MOMP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 受p53 調節。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。方向性從 p53 向 MOMP，因此 p53 是活性劑，MOMP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: MOMP releases Smac-DIABLO. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The relationship is directional, with MOMP acting as the operative agent upon Smac-DIABLO rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 發布 Smac-DIABLO。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。這種關係是有方向的，MOMP 充當 Smac-DIABLO 的操作代理，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Multidrug Resistance is driven by Akt. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The directionality runs from Akt toward Multidrug Resistance, so Akt is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Multidrug Resistance 由 Akt 驅動。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 Akt 向 Multidrug Resistance 延伸，因此 Akt 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Multidrug Resistance is driven by EGFR. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The directionality runs from EGFR toward Multidrug Resistance, so EGFR is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Multidrug Resistance由EGFR驅動。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。方向性從 EGFR 延伸到 Multidrug Resistance，因此 EGFR 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Multidrug Resistance is reversed by Ivermectin. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward Multidrug Resistance, so Ivermectin is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Multidrug Resistance 與 Ivermectin 反轉。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 Multidrug Resistance，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Multidrug Resistance is driven by NFκB. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The directionality runs from NFκB toward Multidrug Resistance, so NFκB is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Multidrug Resistance由NFκB驅動。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。其方向性是從NFκB向Multidrug Resistance延伸，因此NFκB是活性劑，也是效應的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Multidrug Resistance is mediated by P-gp. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) is an ATP-binding-cassette efflux pump that expels cytotoxic drugs from cells and is a major mediator of multidrug resistance. The directionality runs from P-gp toward Multidrug Resistance, so P-gp is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Multidrug Resistance是由P-gp介導的。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 P-糖蛋白（ABCB1）是一種ATP結合盒外排泵，可將細胞毒性藥物從細胞中排出，是Multidrug Resistance的主要介質。方向性從 P-gp 朝向 Multidrug Resistance，因此 P-gp 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Nutlins 透過關係歸納與 Apoptosis 相關。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Nutlins relates to MDM2 through the relation inhibit. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Nutlins 透過關係抑制與 MDM2 相關。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Nutlins stabilizes p53. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Nutlins acting as the operative agent upon p53 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Nutlins 使 p53 穩定。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。這種關係是有方向的，Nutlins 充當 p53 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Nutlins relates to Senescence through the relation induce. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. Cellular senescence is an irreversible arrest program triggered by telomere dysfunction, oncogene activation, or therapy that limits tumor growth. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Nutlins 透過關係歸納與 Senescence 相關。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。細胞老化是由端粒功能障礙、癌基因活化或限制腫瘤生長的治療引發的不可逆的停滯程序。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Omi/HtrA2 promotes Apoptosis. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Omi/HtrA2 促進 Apoptosis。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Omi/HtrA2 antagonizes Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Omi/HtrA2 對抗Omi/HtrA2。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當Omi/HtrA2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Omi/HtrA2 relates to MOMP through the relation is_released_from. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Omi/HtrA2 透過關係式 is_released_from 與 MOMP 相關。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Omi/HtrA2 antagonizes XIAP. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon XIAP rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Omi/HtrA2對抗XIAP。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當 XIAP ​​的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: BRCA1/2 defects and homologous-recombination deficiency characterize the high-grade serous subtype of ovarian cancer. BRCA status is used to determine PARP-inhibitor eligibility. BRCA alterations are therefore central to ovarian cancer biology and targeted therapy.
context.zh-TW: BRCA1/2 缺陷與同源重組缺陷是高惡性度漿液性卵巢癌亞型的特徵。BRCA 狀態用於決定 PARP 抑制劑的適用資格。因此 BRCA 改變對卵巢癌生物學與靶向治療至關重要。

context.en-US: First-line therapy for ovarian cancer is cytoreductive surgery plus platinum/taxane chemotherapy, with Cisplatin as a central platinum agent. Ivermectin enhances the efficacy of Cisplatin in ovarian cancer models. Cisplatin is therefore central to ovarian cancer treatment and resistance studies.
context.zh-TW: 卵巢癌的一線治療是腫瘤減積手術加上鉑類/紫杉烷化療，其中 Cisplatin 是核心鉑類藥物。Ivermectin 在卵巢癌模型中增強 Cisplatin 的療效。因此 Cisplatin 對卵巢癌的治療與抗性研究至關重要。

context.en-US: Ivermectin inhibits proliferation of ovarian cancer lines by inactivating PAK1 and suppressing Akt/mTOR signaling, and also acts via a KPNB1-dependent mechanism. It enhances the efficacy of Cisplatin and paclitaxel. Ivermectin is therefore studied as a repurposed agent to overcome resistance in ovarian cancer.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 透過使 PAK1 失活並抑制 Akt/mTOR 訊號傳導，抑制卵巢癌細胞株的增殖，並透過 KPNB1 依賴機制作用。它增強 Cisplatin 和 paclitaxel 的療效。因此 Ivermectin 被研究作為克服卵巢癌抗性的再利用製劑。

context.en-US: Melittin exerts antitumoral effects in ovarian cancer cells by inhibiting the JAK2/STAT3 axis. This natural-product agent is studied to overcome resistance and re-sensitize tumors to standard cytotoxic therapy. Melittin thereby represents a candidate repurposed agent against ovarian cancer.
context.zh-TW: Melittin 透過抑制 JAK2/STAT3 軸，在卵巢癌細胞中發揮抗腫瘤效應。這種天然產物製劑被研究用於克服抗性並使腫瘤對標準細胞毒性療法重新敏感化。因此 Melittin 是對抗卵巢癌的候選再利用製劑。

context.en-US: Ovarian cancer is characterized by late presentation with widespread peritoneal metastasis, which defines advanced disease. Peritoneal spread and acquired resistance to platinum-taxane chemotherapy drive poor long-term survival. Metastasis is therefore central to ovarian cancer lethality.
context.zh-TW: 卵巢癌以晚期表現並伴有廣泛腹膜轉移為特徵，這定義了晚期疾病。腹膜擴散與對鉑類–紫杉烷化療的後天抗性導致長期存活率不佳。因此轉移對卵巢癌的致死性至關重要。

context.en-US: High-grade serous carcinoma, the dominant ovarian cancer subtype, is characterized by p53 mutation. p53 mutation is a defining feature of this aggressive subtype. p53 alterations contribute to the molecular pathology of ovarian cancer.
context.zh-TW: 高惡性度漿液性癌是卵巢癌的主要亞型，以 p53 突變為特徵。p53 突變是這種侵襲性亞型的定義性特徵。p53 改變促成卵巢癌的分子病理。

context.en-US: Paclitaxel is a taxane used in the platinum/taxane first-line chemotherapy for ovarian cancer. Ivermectin enhances the efficacy of paclitaxel in ovarian cancer models. Paclitaxel is therefore central to ovarian cancer treatment.
context.zh-TW: Paclitaxel 是用於卵巢癌鉑類/紫杉烷一線化療的紫杉烷類藥物。Ivermectin 在卵巢癌模型中增強 paclitaxel 的療效。因此 Paclitaxel 對卵巢癌治療至關重要。

context.en-US: PAK1 is a key target of Ivermectin in ovarian cancer, whose inactivation inhibits proliferation. PAK1 signaling contributes to the dysregulated survival network in ovarian cancer. It is therefore studied as a molecular node for repurposed drug action.
context.zh-TW: PAK1 是 Ivermectin 在卵巢癌中的關鍵靶點，其失活會抑制增殖。PAK1 訊號傳導促成卵巢癌中失調的存活網路。因此它被研究作為再利用藥物作用的分子節點。

context.en-US: STAT3 is a survival transcription factor in the JAK2/STAT3 pathway targeted by Melittin in ovarian cancer cells. Dysregulated JAK2/STAT3 signaling is part of the survival network in ovarian cancer. STAT3 is therefore a relevant molecular target in ovarian cancer.
context.zh-TW: STAT3 是 JAK2/STAT3 途徑中的存活轉錄因子，在卵巢癌細胞中被 Melittin 靶向。失調的 JAK2/STAT3 訊號傳導是卵巢癌存活網路的一部分。因此 STAT3 是卵巢癌中的相關分子靶點。

context.en-US: p53 functions as the archetypal tumor suppressor in cancer, integrating DNA damage and oncogenic stress into arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Its inactivation, most often by missense mutation, removes a central barrier to genomic instability and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional and protective: intact p53 suppresses transformation, whereas its loss permits malignant evolution. Mutant p53 can additionally acquire dominant-negative and gain-of-function oncogenic activities.
context.zh-TW: p53 充當癌症中的原型Tumor Suppressor，將DNA Damage 和致癌壓力整合到停滯、老化或凋亡中。它的失活（最常見的是錯義突變）消除了基因組不穩定和治療抗藥性的主要障礙。這種關係是方向性的和保護性的：完整的p53抑制轉化，而它的喪失則允許惡性進化。突變體p53也可以獲得顯性失活和功能性獲得性致癌活性。

context.en-US: p53 is mutated in Cancer. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward p53, so Cancer is the active agent and p53 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: p53 在 Cancer 中發生突變。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 p53，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，p53 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: p53 is inhibited by MDM2. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. MDM2 is the principal E3 ubiquitin ligase and transcriptional antagonist that keeps p53 quiescent in unstressed cells. The directionality runs from MDM2 toward p53, so MDM2 is the active agent and p53 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: p53 被 MDM2 抑制。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 MDM2 是主要的 E3 泛素連接酶和轉錄拮抗劑，可使 p53 在未受壓力的細胞中保持靜止狀態。方向性從 MDM2 向 p53，因此 MDM2 是活性劑，p53 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: p53 regulates MOMP. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The relationship is directional, with p53 acting as the operative agent upon MOMP rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: p53 調節 MOMP。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。這種關係是有方向的，p53 充當 MOMP 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: p53 induces Noxa. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Noxa is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein with selective affinity for Mcl-1 and A1, sensitizing cells to mitochondrial apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with p53 acting as the operative agent upon Noxa rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: p53 誘發 Noxa。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Noxa 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，對 Mcl-1 和 A1 具有選擇性親和力，使細胞對粒線體凋亡敏感。這種關係是有方向的，p53 充當 Noxa 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: p53 is restored by Nutlins. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Nutlins are cis-imidazoline small molecules that block the MDM2-p53 interface, stabilizing p53 to enforce arrest or apoptosis. The directionality runs from Nutlins toward p53, so Nutlins is the active agent and p53 the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: p53 由 Nutlins 恢復。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Nutlins 是順式咪唑啉小分子，可阻斷 MDM2-p53 界面，穩定 p53 強制抑製或凋亡。方向性從 Nutlins 朝向 p53，因此 Nutlins 是主動主體，p53 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: p53 induces Puma. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. Puma is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein that binds and neutralizes essentially all anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 relatives to license mitochondrial death. The relationship is directional, with p53 acting as the operative agent upon Puma rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: p53 誘發Puma。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。 Puma 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，可結合並中和幾乎所有抗凋亡 Bcl-2 相關蛋白，從而允許粒線體死亡。這種關係是有方向的，p53 充當 Puma 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PAK1 phosphorylates Bad. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. The relationship is directional, with PAK1 acting as the operative agent upon Bad rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: PAK1 磷酸化Bad。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。這種關係是有方向的，PAK1 充當Bad 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: PAK1 regulates Cancer Stem Cells. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. The relationship is directional, with PAK1 acting as the operative agent upon Cancer Stem Cells rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: PAK1 調節Cancer Stem Cells。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。這種關係是有方向的，PAK1 充當 Cancer Stem Cells 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PAK1 is inhibited by Ivermectin. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward PAK1, so Ivermectin is the active agent and PAK1 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: PAK1 被 Ivermectin 抑制。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 PAK1，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，PAK1 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: PD-L1 enables Immune Evasion. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. Immune evasion is a recognized hallmark whereby tumors disarm or exclude cytotoxic lymphocytes through checkpoints and immunosuppressive microenvironments. The relationship is directional, with PD-L1 acting as the operative agent upon Immune Evasion rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: PD-L1 啟用 Immune Evasion。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。 Immune Evasion是一個公認的標誌，腫瘤透過檢查點和免疫抑制微環境解除或排除細胞毒性淋巴細胞。這種關係是有方向的，PD-L1 充當 Immune Evasion 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PD-L1 is reduced by melittin. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. Melittin is the principal peptide of honeybee venom that permeabilizes membranes and suppresses oncogenic receptors and checkpoints. The directionality runs from melittin toward PD-L1, so melittin is the active agent and PD-L1 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: PD-L1 減少 melittin。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。蜂毒肽是蜜蜂毒液的主要勝肽，可透化膜並抑制致癌受體和檢查點。方向性從 melittin 向 PD-L1，因此 melittin 是活性劑，PD-L1 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: PD-L1 is expressed in triple-negative breast cancer. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. Triple-negative breast cancer lacks estrogen-, progesterone-, and HER2-receptors, limiting therapy to chemotherapy and emerging immunotherapy. The directionality runs from triple-negative breast cancer toward PD-L1, so triple-negative breast cancer is the active agent and PD-L1 the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: PD-L1用triple-negative breast cancer表示。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。 ﹣ 缺乏雌激素、黃體素和HER2受體，限制了化療和新興免疫療法的治療。方向性從 triple-negative breast cancer 向 PD-L1 延伸，因此 triple-negative breast cancer 是活性劑，PD-L1 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: PIDD activates Caspase-2. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: PIDD 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PIDD activates NFκB. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon NFκB rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: PIDD 活化 NFκB。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。這種關係是定向的，PIDD 充當 NFκB 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PIDD is induced by p53. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The directionality runs from p53 toward PIDD, so p53 is the active agent and PIDD the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: PIDD 由 p53 誘發。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。方向性從 p53 朝向 PIDD，因此 p53 是主動主體，PIDD 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PIDD forms PIDDosome. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon PIDDosome rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: PIDD 形式PIDDosome。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 PIDDosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: PIDDosome activates Caspase-2. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDDosome acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: PIDDosome 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDDosome 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PIDDosome responds to DNA Damage. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. DNA damage, particularly unrepaired double-strand breaks, is both a driver of mutagenesis and a trigger of p53-dependent tumor suppression. The relationship is directional, with PIDDosome acting as the operative agent upon DNA Damage rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: PIDDosome 響應​​ DNA Damage。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 DNA Damage，尤其是未修復的雙股斷裂，既是誘變的驅動因素，也是p53依賴性腫瘤抑制的觸發因素。這種關係是有方向的，PIDDosome 充當 DNA Damage 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: PIDDosome is composed of PIDD. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. The directionality runs from PIDD toward PIDDosome, so PIDD is the active agent and PIDDosome the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: PIDDosome 由 PIDD 組成。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。方向性從 PIDD 朝向 PIDDosome，因此 PIDD 是主動主體，PIDDosome 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: PIDDosome is composed of RAIDD. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. The directionality runs from RAIDD toward PIDDosome, so RAIDD is the active agent and PIDDosome the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: PIDDosome 由 RAIDD 組成。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。方向性從 RAIDD 朝向 PIDDosome，因此 RAIDD 是主動主體，PIDDosome 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis is a form of programmed cell death distinct from apoptosis, although both are regulated cell-death modalities. In some contexts they are mutually regulated, for example when Ivermectin induces both apoptosis and autophagy alongside pyroptosis. Understanding their crosstalk matters for cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 是與細胞凋亡不同的程式性細胞死亡形式，雖然兩者都是受調控的細胞死亡方式。在某些情境下它們互相調節，例如 Ivermectin 在誘導細胞焦亡的同時也誘導細胞凋亡與自噬。了解它們的交叉對話對癌症治療很重要。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis is initiated by the assembly of inflammasomes containing a pattern recognition receptor, ASC, and pro-caspase-1, which activates Caspase-1. Active Caspase-1 cleaves pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into mature forms and cleaves Gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. Caspase-1 is therefore the central executor protease of pyroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 由含有模式識別受體、ASC 和 pro-caspase-1 的發炎小體組裝所啟動，並激活 Caspase-1。活化的 Caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 和 pro-IL-18 裂解為成熟形式，並裂解 Gasdermin D 以執行細胞焦亡。因此 Caspase-1 是細胞焦亡的核心執行蛋白酶。

context.en-US: Caspase-1 cleaves Gasdermin D, whose N-terminal fragment forms pores in the plasma membrane, executing pyroptosis. Pore formation leads to cell swelling and rupture with release of proinflammatory cytokines. Gasdermin D is thus the executioner of pyroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-1 裂解 Gasdermin D，其 N 端片段在質膜上形成孔洞，執行細胞焦亡。孔洞形成導致細胞腫脹與破裂，並釋放促發炎細胞因子。因此 Gasdermin D 是細胞焦亡的執行者。

context.en-US: NLRP3 is a common inflammasome involved in pyroptosis, functioning as an important component of innate immunity. Inflammasome assembly involving NLRP3 leads to Caspase-1 activation and pyroptotic cell death. NLRP3 thereby links inflammatory signaling to pyroptosis.
context.zh-TW: NLRP3 是參與細胞焦亡的常見發炎小體，是先天免疫的重要組成部分。涉及 NLRP3 的發炎小體組裝會導致 Caspase-1 激活與細胞焦亡性細胞死亡。因此 NLRP3 將發炎訊號與細胞焦亡連結起來。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis is a form of regulated (programmed) cell death induced by inflammasomes, distinct from apoptosis. It is characterized by cell swelling and rupturing, leading to the release of proinflammatory cytokines. Pyroptosis is therefore a distinct modality within regulated cell death.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 是由發炎小體誘導的一種受調控（程式性）細胞死亡形式，與細胞凋亡不同。其特徵是細胞腫脹與破裂，導致促發炎細胞因子的釋放。因此 Pyroptosis 是受調控細胞死亡中的一種獨特形式。

context.en-US: Pyroptosis can inhibit tumor growth by inducing cell death and stimulating an inflammatory response in the tumor microenvironment. This positions pyroptosis as a tumor-suppressive modality in some contexts. Inducers such as Ivermectin have been observed to trigger pyroptosis in cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: Pyroptosis 可透過誘導細胞死亡並刺激腫瘤微環境中的發炎反應來抑制腫瘤生長。這使細胞焦亡在某些情境下成為腫瘤抑制形式。已觀察到 Ivermectin 等誘導劑可觸發癌細胞中的細胞焦亡。

context.en-US: RAIDD promotes Apoptosis. RAIDD (CRADD) is the death-domain/CARD adaptor that bridges PIDD to procaspase-2 within the PIDDosome. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: RAIDD 推廣 Apoptosis。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，RAIDD 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
