The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. The relationship is directional, with RAIDD acting as the operative agent upon PIDDosome rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
context.zh-TW: RAIDD 形式PIDDosome。 RAIDD (CRADD) 是死亡域/CARD 轉接器，將 PIDD 橋接到 PIDDosome 內的 procaspase-2。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。這種關係是有方向的，RAIDD 充當 PIDDosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

context.en-US: 5-FU (fluorouracil) is the infusional fluoropyrimidine backbone of rectal cancer chemoradiation, delivered as a radiosensitizer in neoadjuvant chemoradiation. It is standard for locally advanced rectal cancer. 5-FU is therefore central to the nCRT regimen.
context.zh-TW: 5-FU（氟尿嘧啶）是直腸癌化放療的輸注型氟嘧啶主幹，在新輔助化放療中作為放射增敏劑給藥。它是局部晚期直腸癌的標準治療。因此 5-FU 對 nCRT 方案至關重要。

context.en-US: Capecitabine is an oral fluoropyrimidine prodrug used as a radiosensitizer in neoadjuvant chemoradiation for rectal cancer. It is an alternative to infusional 5-FU in the nCRT regimen. Capecitabine is therefore central to rectal cancer chemoradiation.
context.zh-TW: Capecitabine 是口服氟嘧啶前驅藥，用作直腸癌新輔助化放療中的放射增敏劑。它是 nCRT 方案中輸注 5-FU 的替代品。因此 Capecitabine 對直腸癌化放療至關重要。

context.en-US: Rectal cancer is often grouped with colon cancer as colorectal cancer, but is managed distinctly due to pelvic anatomical constraints and differing treatment paradigms. Rectal cancer exhibits a higher propensity for locoregional recurrence while colon cancer more often recurs distantly. They are neighboring entities along the colorectal continuum with distinct biology.
context.zh-TW: 直腸癌常與結腸癌合稱為結直腸癌，但因骨盆解剖限制與不同的治療模式而治療方式不同。直腸癌具有較高的局部區域復發傾向，而結腸癌較常在遠端復發。它們是結直腸連續體上相鄰但生物學不同的實體。

context.en-US: FOLFOX is a systemic chemotherapy regimen used in total neoadjuvant therapy protocols for rectal cancer. TNT delivers systemic chemotherapy before or after chemoradiation, prior to surgery. FOLFOX is therefore part of the emerging neoadjuvant strategy for high-risk rectal cancer.
context.zh-TW: FOLFOX 是用於直腸癌全新輔助治療方案的全身化療方案。TNT 在化放療之前或之後、手術之前給予全身化療。因此 FOLFOX 是高風險直腸癌新興新輔助策略的一部分。

context.en-US: p53 mutations are common in rectal cancer, contributing to its molecular pathology. Along with APC mutations and near-universal Wnt signaling dysregulation, p53 loss is a feature of rectal carcinogenesis. p53 alterations influence tumor behavior and treatment response.
context.zh-TW: p53 突變在直腸癌中很常見，促成其分子病理。與 APC 突變及近乎普遍的 Wnt 訊號失調並列，p53 缺失是直腸癌發生的特徵。p53 改變影響腫瘤行為與治療反應。

context.en-US: The Wnt signaling pathway is nearly universally dysregulated in rectal cancer, alongside a higher frequency of APC mutations. Aberrant Wnt signaling drives rectal carcinogenesis. Wnt pathway dysregulation is therefore a defining molecular feature of rectal cancer.
context.zh-TW: Wnt 訊號傳導途徑在直腸癌中近乎普遍失調，同時 APC 突變頻率也較高。異常的 Wnt 訊號傳導驅動直腸癌發生。因此 Wnt 途徑失調是直腸癌的定義性分子特徵。

context.en-US: Elevated expression of XIAP in rectal cancer correlates with chemoradioresistance. As an inhibitor of apoptosis protein, XIAP suppresses caspases and blunts treatment-induced cell death. XIAP is therefore relevant to rectal cancer treatment resistance.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 在直腸癌中的表現升高與化放療抗性相關。作為凋亡抑制蛋白，XIAP 抑制半胱天冬酶並削弱治療誘導的細胞死亡。因此 XIAP 與直腸癌的治療抗性相關。

context.en-US: Omura conducted the avermectin discovery research at the Kitasato Institute.
context.zh-TW: 大村在 Kitasato Institute 進行了阿維菌素發現研究。

subject: Satoshi Ōmura
object: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine

context.en-US: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
context.zh-TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

context.en-US: Omura isolated and cultured Streptomyces avermectinius from Japanese soil, the sole known natural source of avermectins.
context.zh-TW: 大村從日本土壤中分離和培養，這是阿維菌素唯一已知的天然來源。

context.en-US: Smac-DIABLO promotes Apoptosis. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Smac-DIABLO 推廣 Apoptosis。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 Apoptosis 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Smac-DIABLO relates to MOMP through the relation is_released_from. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Smac-DIABLO 透過關係式 is_released_from 與 MOMP 相關。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Smac-DIABLO antagonizes Survivin. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon Survivin rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Smac-DIABLO 對抗 Survivin。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 Survivin 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Smac-DIABLO synergizes with TRAIL. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon TRAIL rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Smac-DIABLO 與 TRAIL 具有協同作用。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 TRAIL 的操作代理，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Smac-DIABLO antagonizes XIAP. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon XIAP rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Smac-DIABLO對抗XIAP。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 XIAP ​​的操作代理，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: BCL-2 overexpression is a frequent molecular feature of small-cell lung cancer, contributing to evasion of apoptosis and chemoresistance. Along with PTEN loss and PI3K/AKT/mTOR dysregulation, BCL-2 overexpression shapes the SCLC phenotype. It represents a therapeutic target in SCLC.
context.zh-TW: BCL-2 過度表現是 Small-cell lung cancer 的常見分子特徵，促成逃避細胞凋亡與化療抗性。與 PTEN 缺失及 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 失調並列，BCL-2 過度表現塑造了 SCLC 的表型。它代表 SCLC 中的治療靶點。

context.en-US: Small-cell lung cancer is treated with Chemotherapy. Platinum-based chemotherapy is the backbone of SCLC treatment: concurrent platinum plus etoposide with thoracic radiotherapy for limited-stage disease, and platinum-based chemotherapy combined with a PD-L1 inhibitor for extensive-stage disease.
context.zh-TW: 小細胞肺癌（Small-cell lung cancer）以化療（Chemotherapy）治療。含鉑化療是 SCLC 治療的骨幹：侷限期以含鉑加 etoposide 並合併胸部放射治療，廣泛期則以含鉑化療合併 PD-L1 抑制劑治療。

context.en-US: Cisplatin is a platinum agent used in limited-stage small-cell lung cancer, delivered concurrently with etoposide and thoracic radiotherapy. Platinum-based chemotherapy is the backbone of SCLC treatment. Cisplatin is therefore central to LS-SCLC therapy.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 是用於局限性 Small-cell lung cancer 的鉑類藥物，與 etoposide 及胸部放療同時給藥。鉑類化療是 SCLC 治療的主幹。因此 Cisplatin 對 LS-SCLC 的治療至關重要。

context.en-US: Etoposide is a topoisomerase inhibitor used in small-cell lung cancer chemotherapy, combined with a platinum agent and, in limited-stage disease, thoracic radiotherapy. It is a backbone agent of SCLC treatment. Etoposide is therefore central to SCLC therapy.
context.zh-TW: Etoposide 是用於 Small-cell lung cancer 化療的拓撲異構酶抑制劑，與鉑類藥物聯用，並在局限性疾病中與胸部放療聯用。它是 SCLC 治療的主幹藥物。因此 Etoposide 對 SCLC 治療至關重要。

context.en-US: Small-cell lung cancer is a major histologic subtype of lung cancer, accounting for approximately 15% of all lung cancers. It is a highly aggressive neuroendocrine carcinoma strongly linked to tobacco smoking. It is one of the deadliest thoracic malignancies.
context.zh-TW: Small-cell lung cancer 是肺癌的主要組織學亞型，約佔所有肺癌的 15%。它是一種高度侵襲性的神經內分泌癌，與吸菸密切相關。它是最致命的胸部惡性腫瘤之一。

context.en-US: MYC family amplification (MYC, MYCN, MYCL) is a frequent secondary event in small-cell lung cancer, driving proliferation and contributing to the aggressive phenotype. MYC amplification is a hallmark of SCLC biology. It represents a relevant oncogenic driver in SCLC.
context.zh-TW: MYC 家族擴增（MYC、MYCN、MYCL）是 Small-cell lung cancer 中常見的繼發事件，驅動增殖並促成侵襲性表型。MYC 擴增是 SCLC 生物學的標誌。它代表 SCLC 中的相關致癌驅動因子。

context.en-US: Small-cell lung cancer is classified as a high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma expressing neuroendocrine markers including Synaptophysin, Chromogranin A, and CD56. These markers are used in SCLC diagnosis. The neuroendocrine phenotype defines SCLC biology.
context.zh-TW: Small-cell lung cancer 被歸類為高惡性度神經內分泌癌，表現包括 Synaptophysin、Chromogranin A 和 CD56 在內的神經內分泌標記。這些標記用於 SCLC 診斷。神經內分泌表型定義了 SCLC 的生物學。

context.en-US: Small-cell lung cancer and non-small-cell lung cancer are the two major histologic categories of lung cancer, with distinct biology and treatment paradigms. SCLC is treated predominantly with chemotherapy and radiotherapy, whereas NSCLC encompasses diverse subtypes. They are distinguished on the basis of histology and clinical behavior.
context.zh-TW: Small-cell lung cancer 與 non-small-cell lung cancer 是肺癌的兩大組織學類別，具有不同的生物學與治療模式。SCLC 主要以化療與放療治療，而 NSCLC 涵蓋多種亞型。它們依據組織學與臨床行為加以區分。

context.en-US: Small-cell lung cancer is defined by near-universal inactivation of RB1 and p53, with loss of both occurring in approximately 90% of cases. p53 loss contributes to the aggressive phenotype and chemoresistance of SCLC. p53 is therefore a defining tumor suppressor lost in SCLC.
context.zh-TW: Small-cell lung cancer 以 RB1 和 p53 近乎普遍的失活為特徵，兩者的缺失發生在約 90% 的病例中。p53 缺失促成 SCLC 的侵襲性表型與化療抗性。因此 p53 是 SCLC 中缺失的定義性腫瘤抑制因子。

context.en-US: First-line therapy for extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer combines platinum-based chemotherapy with a PD-L1 inhibitor such as atezolizumab or durvalumab. PD-L1 blockade confers a modest but significant survival benefit in ES-SCLC. PD-L1 is therefore a relevant immune-checkpoint target in SCLC.
context.zh-TW: 廣泛期 Small-cell lung cancer 的一線治療將鉑類化療與 atezolizumab 或 durvalumab 等 PD-L1 抑制劑結合。PD-L1 阻斷在 ES-SCLC 中提供適度但顯著的存活益處。因此 PD-L1 是 SCLC 中的相關免疫檢查點靶點。

context.en-US: Small-cell lung cancer is defined by near-universal inactivation of RB1 and p53, with loss of both tumor suppressors occurring in approximately 90% of cases. RB1 loss is a defining genomic feature of SCLC. It contributes to the aggressive, rapidly proliferating phenotype.
context.zh-TW: Small-cell lung cancer 以 RB1 和 p53 近乎普遍的失活為特徵，兩種腫瘤抑制因子的缺失發生在約 90% 的病例中。RB1 缺失是 SCLC 的定義性基因體特徵。它促成侵襲性、快速增殖的表型。

context.en-US: SRC kinase promotes degradation of Bik. SRC is a non-receptor tyrosine kinase that promotes survival and, notably, phosphorylates and inactivates caspase-8 and Bik. Bik is a BH3-only protein that directly activates Bax/Bak and is itself suppressed by oncogenic kinase signaling. The relationship is directional, with SRC kinase acting as the operative agent upon Bik rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: SRC kinase 促進Bik 的降解。 SRC 是一種非受體酪胺酸激酶，可促進存活，尤其是磷酸化 caspase-8 和 Bik 並使其失去活性。 Bik 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，可直接活化 Bax/Bak，且本身受到致癌激酶訊號傳導的抑制。這種關係是有方向的，SRC kinase 充當Bik 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: The avermectin-producing strain Streptomyces avermectinius was isolated from Japanese soil at the Kitasato Institute.
context.zh-TW: 產生阿維菌素的菌株Streptomyces avermectinius是從日本土壤分離出來的。

context.en-US: Survivin is overexpressed in Cancer. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Survivin, so Cancer is the active agent and Survivin the recipient of the effect. This altered abundance or activity is a recurring feature of malignancy that can serve as a diagnostic, prognostic, or predictive biomarker and sometimes as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: Survivin 在 Cancer 中過度表現。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 朝向 Survivin，因此 Cancer 是主動主體，Survivin 是效果的接受者。這種豐度或活性的改變是惡性腫瘤的一個反覆出現的特徵，可以作為診斷、預後或預測生物標記物，有時還可以作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: Survivin confers resistance to Chemotherapy. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. Chemotherapy uses cytotoxic agents to kill rapidly dividing cells, and its efficacy is limited by innate and acquired resistance mechanisms. The relationship is directional, with Survivin acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Survivin 賦予對 Chemotherapy 的抵抗力。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。 Chemotherapy 使用細胞毒性劑殺死快速分裂的細胞，其功效受到先天和後天抗藥性機制的限制。這種關係是有方向的，Survivin 充當 Chemotherapy 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Survivin confers resistance to docetaxel. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. Docetaxel is a taxane that stabilizes microtubules, arresting mitosis and inducing cell death in a range of carcinomas. The relationship is directional, with Survivin acting as the operative agent upon docetaxel rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Survivin 賦予對 docetaxel 的抗力。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。多西紫杉醇是一種紫杉烷，可穩定微管、阻止有絲分裂並誘導多種癌症的細胞死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Survivin 充當 docetaxel 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Survivin is a member of Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are endogenous caspase-suppressor proteins that block cell death and are frequently co-opted by tumors. The directionality runs from Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins toward Survivin, so Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins is the active agent and Survivin the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Survivin 是 的成員。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。 (IAP) 是內源性半胱天冬酶抑制蛋白，可阻止細胞死亡，並經常被腫瘤利用。方向性從Survivin 走向Survivin，因此Survivin 是主動主體，Survivin 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: TGFβ induces EMT. TGF-beta is a cytokine with dual roles: it restrains epithelial proliferation yet, in advanced cancer, actively induces EMT and immunosuppression. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. The relationship is directional, with TGFβ acting as the operative agent upon EMT rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: TGFβ 誘發 EMT。 TGF-β 是一種具有雙重作用的細胞激素：它抑制上皮細胞增殖，但在晚期癌症中，積極誘導 β 和免疫抑制。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。這種關係是有方向的，TGFβ 充當 EMT 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-induced senescence imposes an initial durable arrest that can suppress tumor growth, yet the accompanying SASP can later stimulate proliferation of neighboring cells and foster relapse. This duality means senescence can be both a therapeutic success and a latent driver of recurrence. The relationship is bidirectional in outcome: acute suppression versus chronic promotion. Combinations with senolytics or senomorphics are therefore being tested to capture the benefit while removing the liability.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 施加最初的持久抑制，可以抑制腫瘤生長，但隨之而來的 SASP 可以隨後刺激鄰近細胞的增殖並促進復發。這種二元性意味著老化既可以是治療的成功，也是復發的潛在驅動因素。這種關係在結果上是雙向的：急性抑制與慢性促進。因此，正在測試與 senolytics 或 senomorphics 的組合，以獲得好處，同時消除責任。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is induced by Cisplatin. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Cisplatin is a platinum compound that forms intra- and inter-strand DNA crosslinks, triggering damage responses that can culminate in senescence or death. The directionality runs from Cisplatin toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Cisplatin is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由 Cisplatin 誘發。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。 Cisplatin 是一種鉑化合物，可形成鏈內和鏈間 DNA 交聯，引發損傷反應，最終導致老化或死亡。方向性從 Cisplatin 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Cisplatin 是主動主體，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is induced by docetaxel. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Docetaxel is a taxane that stabilizes microtubules, arresting mitosis and inducing cell death in a range of carcinomas. The directionality runs from docetaxel toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so docetaxel is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由 docetaxel 誘發。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。多西紫杉醇是一種紫杉烷，可穩定微管、阻止有絲分裂並誘導多種癌症的細胞死亡。方向性從 docetaxel 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 docetaxel 是主動主體，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is enforced by p16. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. p16 (CDKN2A) inhibits CDK4/6 to lock cells in senescence and is frequently inactivated by deletion or methylation in cancer. The directionality runs from p16 toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so p16 is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由 p16 強制執行。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。 p16 (CDKN2A) 抑制 CDK4/6 以鎖定細胞衰老，並且經常因癌症中的缺失或甲基化而失去活性。方向性從 p16 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 p16 是主動主體，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is enforced by p21. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. p21 (CDKN1A) is a p53-inducible CDK inhibitor that enforces G1 arrest during senescence and DNA-damage responses. The directionality runs from p21 toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so p21 is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由p21 強制執行。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。 p21 (CDKN1A) 是一種 p53 誘導型 CDK 抑制劑，可在老化和 DNA 損傷反應期間強制 G1 期停滯。方向性從 p21 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 p21 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is enforced by p53. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The directionality runs from p53 toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so p53 is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由p53 強制執行。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。方向性從 p53 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 p53 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is enforced by Rb. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Retinoblastoma protein is a tumor suppressor that, when hypophosphorylated, binds E2F to block S-phase entry and underpins senescence arrest. The directionality runs from Rb toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Rb is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由Rb 強制執行。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白是一種蛋白質，當低磷酸化時，它會與 E2F 結合，阻止進入 S 期並支持老化停滯。方向性從 Rb 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Rb 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence produces SASP. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. The senescence-associated secretory phenotype is the pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells that can both restrain and, chronically, promote tumors. The relationship is directional, with Therapy-Induced Senescence acting as the operative agent upon SASP rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 產生 SASP。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。老化相關的分泌表型是衰老細胞的促發炎分泌組，它既可以抑制腫瘤，也可以長期促進腫瘤。這種關係是有方向的，Therapy-Induced Senescence 充當 SASP 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is resisted by SCAPs. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senescent-cell anti-apoptotic pathways are networks (Bcl-2 family, PI3K/Akt) that senescent cells upregulate to resist death and persist. The directionality runs from SCAPs toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so SCAPs is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 受到 SCAPs 的抵抗。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。衰老細胞抗凋亡途徑是衰老細胞上調以抵抗死亡並持續存在的網絡（Bcl-2 family、PI3K/Akt）。方向性從 SCAPs 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 SCAPs 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is a type of Senescence. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Cellular senescence is an irreversible arrest program triggered by telomere dysfunction, oncogene activation, or therapy that limits tumor growth. The directionality runs from Senescence toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senescence is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 是Senescence 的一種。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。細胞老化是由端粒功能障礙、癌基因活化或限制腫瘤生長的治療引發的不可逆的停滯程序。方向性從 Senescence 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senescence 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senescence Surveillance. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senescence surveillance is the immune-mediated clearance of senescent cells orchestrated by their SASP chemokine and cytokine output. The directionality runs from Senescence Surveillance toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senescence Surveillance is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由Senescence Surveillance 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。監視是由衰老細胞的趨化因子和細胞激素輸出協調的免疫介導的清除。方向性從 Senescence Surveillance 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senescence Surveillance 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senolytic. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senolytics are agents that preferentially kill senescent cells, often by disabling their anti-apoptotic SCAP survival networks. The directionality runs from Senolytic toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senolytic is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 用 Senolytic 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它們是優先殺死衰老細胞的藥物，通常是透過禁用其抗凋亡 SCAP 生存網絡來實現的。方向性從 Senolytic 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senolytic 是主動主體，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Therapy-Induced Senescence is suppressed by Senomorphic Therapy. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senomorphics suppress the SASP without killing senescent cells, dampening chronic inflammation and paracrine tumor promotion. The directionality runs from Senomorphic Therapy toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senomorphic Therapy is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 被 Senomorphic Therapy 抑制。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它可以抑制衰老細胞而不殺死衰老細胞，從而抑制慢性發炎和旁分泌腫瘤的發生。方向性從 Senomorphic Therapy 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senomorphic Therapy 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: The tumor microenvironment supports angiogenesis through proangiogenic factors such as VEGF secreted by tumor and stromal cells. SASP from senescent cells in the TME also drives tumor vascularization. Angiogenesis is thereby promoted by the tumor microenvironment.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤微環境透過腫瘤與基質細胞分泌的 VEGF 等促血管生成因子支持血管新生。TME 中衰老細胞的 SASP 也驅動腫瘤血管形成。因此血管新生受到腫瘤微環境的促進。

context.en-US: Tumor Microenvironment promotes Cancer. The TME is the non-malignant cellular context surrounding tumors; its cellular and soluble components—CAFs, TAMs, MDSCs, endothelial cells, and remodeled ECM—support tumor progression via proliferation, invasion, angiogenesis, immune modulation, and ECM remodeling.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤微環境（Tumor Microenvironment）促進癌症（Cancer）。TME 是包圍腫瘤的非惡性細胞環境；其細胞與可溶性成分——CAF、TAM、MDSC、內皮細胞與重塑的 ECM——透過增殖、侵襲、血管新生、免疫調節與 ECM 重塑來支持腫瘤進展。

context.en-US: CD38 is expressed on multiple immunosuppressive TME cell populations including Tregs, MDSCs, TAMs, and Bregs. Its enzymatic activity depletes NAD+ and generates adenosine, suppressing anti-tumor T-cell and NK-cell responses. CD38 is therefore a major therapeutic target in the tumor microenvironment.
context.zh-TW: CD38 表現於多種免疫抑制性 TME 細胞族群，包括 Treg、MDSC、TAM 和 Breg。其酶活性耗竭 NAD+ 並產生腺苷，抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞與 NK 細胞反應。因此 CD38 是腫瘤微環境中的主要治療靶點。

context.en-US: Cancer-associated fibroblasts are major cellular components of the tumor microenvironment that secrete growth factors, cytokines, and proteases. Senescent fibroblasts with a SASP are a key source of pro-tumorigenic factors. Fibroblasts are therefore a defining stromal element of the TME.
context.zh-TW: 癌症相關纖維母細胞是腫瘤微環境的主要細胞成分，分泌生長因子、細胞因子與蛋白酶。具有 SASP 的衰老纖維母細胞是促腫瘤因子的關鍵來源。因此纖維母細胞是 TME 的定義性基質元素。

context.en-US: Tumor Microenvironment promotes Immune Evasion. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. Immune evasion is a recognized hallmark whereby tumors disarm or exclude cytotoxic lymphocytes through checkpoints and immunosuppressive microenvironments. The relationship is directional, with Tumor Microenvironment acting as the operative agent upon Immune Evasion rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Tumor Microenvironment 促進Immune Evasion。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。 Immune Evasion是一個公認的標誌，腫瘤透過檢查點和免疫抑制微環境解除或排除細胞毒性淋巴細胞。這種關係是有方向的，Tumor Microenvironment 充當Immune Evasion 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Chronic inflammation in the tumor microenvironment parallels age-related inflammaging, linking the TME to aging biology. Inflammatory signals in the TME promote tumor progression and immunosuppression. This connection motivates senomorphic and anti-inflammatory strategies in oncology.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤微環境中的慢性發炎與年齡相關的發炎老化平行，將 TME 與衰老生物學連結起來。TME 中的發炎訊號促進腫瘤進展與免疫抑制。這種關聯促使腫瘤學中採取衰老修飾與抗發炎策略。

context.en-US: Tumor-associated macrophages are prominent immune cells of the tumor microenvironment, often polarized toward an M2-like immunosuppressive phenotype. TAM polarization is metabolically coupled through a SENP1-SIRT3-cholesterol axis that suppresses CD8 T cells. Macrophages are a defining immune component of the TME.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤相關巨噬細胞是腫瘤微環境中的主要免疫細胞，常極化為 M2 樣免疫抑制表型。TAM 極化透過 SENP1–SIRT3–膽固醇軸在代謝上耦合，並抑制 CD8 T 細胞。巨噬細胞是 TME 的定義性免疫成分。

context.en-US: Tumor Microenvironment promotes Metastasis. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with Tumor Microenvironment acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Tumor Microenvironment 促進Metastasis。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，Tumor Microenvironment 充當Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: CD38 expressed on immunosuppressive TME cell populations depletes NAD+ in the tumor microenvironment and generates adenosine via CD73, further suppressing anti-tumor immune responses. This NAD+ depletion and adenosine generation are metabolic features of the TME. Anti-CD38 therapies can counteract this immunosuppression.
context.zh-TW: TME 免疫抑制細胞族群上表現的 CD38 會耗竭腫瘤微環境中的 NAD+，並經由 CD73 產生腺苷，進一步抑制抗腫瘤免疫反應。這種 NAD+ 耗竭與腺苷產生是 TME 的代謝特徵。抗 CD38 療法可對抗這種免疫抑制。

context.en-US: Tumor Microenvironment is remodeled by SASP. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. The senescence-associated secretory phenotype is the pro-inflammatory secretome of senescent cells that can both restrain and, chronically, promote tumors. The directionality runs from SASP toward Tumor Microenvironment, so SASP is the active agent and Tumor Microenvironment the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Tumor Microenvironment 被SASP 改造。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。老化相關的分泌表型是衰老細胞的促發炎分泌組，它既可以抑制腫瘤，也可以長期促進腫瘤。方向性從 SASP 向 Tumor Microenvironment，因此 SASP 是活性劑，Tumor Microenvironment 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Senescent cells accumulate in the tumor microenvironment, particularly following cancer therapy, and profoundly alter its composition through the SASP. SASP factors recruit immunosuppressive cells and impair immune function, enabling immune evasion. Senescent cells are therefore important modifiers of the TME.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞會在腫瘤微環境中累積，尤其是在癌症治療之後，並透過 SASP 深刻改變其組成。SASP 因子招募免疫抑制細胞並損害免疫功能，促成免疫逃逸。因此衰老細胞是 TME 的重要修飾者。

context.en-US: Tumor Microenvironment is targeted by Senolytic Therapy. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. Senolytic therapy selectively eliminates senescent cells to remove their SASP and has been explored to blunt therapy-induced relapse. The directionality runs from Senolytic Therapy toward Tumor Microenvironment, so Senolytic Therapy is the active agent and Tumor Microenvironment the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: Tumor Microenvironment 的目標是 Senolytic Therapy。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。 Senolytic 療法選擇性地消除衰老細胞以消除其SASP，並已被探索用於抑制治療引起的復發。方向性從 Senolytic Therapy 朝向 Tumor Microenvironment，因此 Senolytic Therapy 是活性劑，Tumor Microenvironment 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Tumor Microenvironment is targeted by Senomorphic Therapy. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. Senomorphics suppress the SASP without killing senescent cells, dampening chronic inflammation and paracrine tumor promotion. The directionality runs from Senomorphic Therapy toward Tumor Microenvironment, so Senomorphic Therapy is the active agent and Tumor Microenvironment the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: Tumor Microenvironment 是 Senomorphic Therapy 的目標。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。它可以抑制衰老細胞而不殺死衰老細胞，從而抑制慢性發炎和旁分泌腫瘤的發生。方向性從 Senomorphic Therapy 朝向 Tumor Microenvironment，因此 Senomorphic Therapy 是活性劑，Tumor Microenvironment 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Tumor Microenvironment is remodeled by Therapy-Induced Senescence. Cancer therapy generates senescent cells that accumulate in the TME, profoundly altering its composition through pro-tumorigenic SASP (IL-6, IL-8, VEGF, MMPs, GROα) that promotes proliferation, invasion, and angiogenesis.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤微環境（Tumor Microenvironment）受治療誘導衰老（Therapy-Induced Senescence）重塑。癌症治療會產生衰老細胞並累積於 TME 中，透過促腫瘤的 SASP（IL-6、IL-8、VEGF、MMP、GROα）深刻改變其組成，促進增殖、侵襲與血管新生。

context.en-US: The tumor microenvironment profoundly influences tumor growth, invasion, and progression through stromal, immune, and extracellular-matrix components. Senescence-associated SASP signaling within the TME can promote cancer cell proliferation and immune evasion. The TME is thus a major contributor to tumorigenesis.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤微環境透過基質、免疫與細胞外基質成分，深刻影響腫瘤生長、侵襲與進展。TME 中與衰老相關的 SASP 訊號傳導可促進癌細胞增殖與免疫逃逸。因此 TME 是腫瘤發生的主要促成因素。

context.en-US: Tumorigenesis is initiated by irreversible DNA damage (mutations) in proto-oncogenes or tumor suppressor genes during the initiation stage. This mutation step is the first of the initiation-promotion-progression sequence. DNA damage thereby seeds the transformation of normal cells into malignant cells.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤發生由起始階段中原致癌基因或腫瘤抑制基因中不可逆的 DNA 損傷（突變）所啟動。此突變步驟是起始–促進–進展序列的第一步。因此 DNA 損傷為正常細胞向惡性細胞的轉化埋下種子。

context.en-US: Genomic instability is a driving force for tumor progression, arising from the accumulation of additional mutations during the progression stage. It enables the acquisition of invasive and metastatic capacity. Genomic instability is a hallmark that fuels tumorigenesis.
context.zh-TW: 基因體不穩定是腫瘤進展的驅動力，源於進展階段額外突變的累積。它使人們得以獲得侵襲與轉移能力。基因體不穩定是助燃腫瘤發生的標誌。

context.en-US: Tumorigenesis proceeds through the acquisition of genetic and epigenetic alterations that confer the Hallmarks of Cancer. These enabling biological capabilities include sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The Hallmarks of Cancer framework describes the capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤發生透過獲得賦予癌症標誌的遺傳與表觀遺傳改變而進行。這些賦能生物學能力包括持續增生、逃避死亡與轉移。癌症標誌架構描述了腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的能力。

context.en-US: Activating mutations in proto-oncogenes such as KRAS drive tumorigenesis during the initiation and progression stages. Oncogenic KRAS (e.g., G12V) triggers oncogene-induced senescence as a barrier, but also drives malignant transformation in cooperation with other alterations. KRAS is a key driver of tumorigenesis in many cancers.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 等原致癌基因的激活突變在起始與進展階段驅動腫瘤發生。致癌性 KRAS（例如 G12V）會觸發致癌基因誘導的衰老作為屏障，但也在與其他改變合作時驅動惡性轉化。KRAS 是許多癌症中腫瘤發生的關鍵驅動因子。

context.en-US: Oncogene-induced senescence is a barrier to tumorigenesis triggered by oncogenic mutations such as KRAS G12V and BRAF V600E. It permanently arrests pre-malignant cells, restraining tumor development. However, escape from this senescence barrier drives progression toward malignancy.
context.zh-TW: 致癌基因誘導的衰老是腫瘤發生的屏障，由 KRAS G12V 和 BRAF V600E 等致癌突變所觸發。它永久停止癌前細胞，限制腫瘤發展。然而，逃脫此衰老屏障會驅動向惡性進展。

context.en-US: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype from senescent cells can paradoxically promote tumorigenesis by creating a pro-inflammatory, immunosuppressive microenvironment. This SASP-driven promotion contrasts with the tumor-suppressive barrier of senescence. The dual role of SASP is central to the tumor microenvironment's influence on tumorigenesis.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞的衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）反而可透過創造促發炎、免疫抑制的微環境來促進腫瘤發生。這種 SASP 驅動的促進作用與衰老的腫瘤抑制屏障形成對比。SASP 的雙重角色對腫瘤微環境影響腫瘤發生至關重要。

context.en-US: Senescence acts as a barrier to tumorigenesis by permanently arresting the proliferation of pre-malignant cells. This is mediated by oncogene-induced senescence triggered by oncogenic insults. Senescence thereby restrains the development of cancer.
context.zh-TW: Senescence 透過永久停止癌前細胞的增殖，作為腫瘤發生的屏障。這由致癌性傷害觸發的致癌基因誘導衰老所介導。因此衰老限制了癌症的發展。

context.en-US: VEGF drives Angiogenesis. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. Angiogenesis is the sprouting of new vessels from preexisting vasculature that tumors must recruit to grow beyond a few millimeters and to metastasize. The relationship is directional, with VEGF acting as the operative agent upon Angiogenesis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: VEGF 驅動 Angiogenesis。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。是指從先前存在的脈管系統長出新血管，腫瘤必須招募新血管才能生長超過幾毫米並發生轉移。這種關係是有方向的，VEGF 充當 Angiogenesis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: VEGF is a hallmark of Hallmarks of Cancer. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. The Hallmarks of Cancer are the enabling biological capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis, including sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The directionality runs from Hallmarks of Cancer toward VEGF, so Hallmarks of Cancer is the active agent and VEGF the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
context.zh-TW: VEGF 是 Hallmarks of Cancer 的標誌。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。 Hallmarks of Cancer是腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的生物學能力，包括持續增生、逃避死亡和轉移。方向性從 Hallmarks of Cancer 向 VEGF，因此 Hallmarks of Cancer 是活性劑，VEGF 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

context.en-US: VEGF is induced by HIF-1α. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. HIF-1alpha is the oxygen-responsive subunit of the hypoxia-inducible factor that rewires transcription toward glycolysis and angiogenesis under low oxygen. The directionality runs from HIF-1α toward VEGF, so HIF-1α is the active agent and VEGF the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: VEGF 由 HIF-1α 誘發。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。 HIF-1α 是缺氧誘導因子的氧響應亞基，可在低氧條件下重新連接轉錄以進行糖解作用和血管生成。方向性從 HIF-1α 向 VEGF，因此 HIF-1α 是活性劑，VEGF 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: VEGF enables Metastasis. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. Metastasis is the multistep dissemination of tumor cells to distant organs and the principal cause of cancer mortality. The relationship is directional, with VEGF acting as the operative agent upon Metastasis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: VEGF 啟用 Metastasis。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。 Metastasis 是腫瘤細胞向遠端器官的多步驟傳播，也是癌症死亡的主要原因。這種關係是有方向的，VEGF 充當 Metastasis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: VEGF is targeted by Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. Tyrosine-kinase inhibitors block receptor or cytoplasmic kinases and include the anti-VEGF and anti-EGFR agents used in solid tumors. The directionality runs from Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors toward VEGF, so Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors is the active agent and VEGF the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
context.zh-TW: VEGF 的目標是 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。酪胺酸激酶抑制劑阻斷受體或細胞質激酶，包括用於實體腫瘤的抗-和抗-藥物。方向性從 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors 向 VEGF，因此 Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors 是活性劑，VEGF 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

context.en-US: Warburg Effect relates to Glycolysis through the relation involves. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. Glycolysis is the cytosolic catabolism of glucose to pyruvate and, under the Warburg phenotype, onward to lactate, yielding rapid ATP and biosynthetic intermediates. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
context.zh-TW: Warburg Effect 透過關係涉及 與 Glycolysis 相關。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。 Glycolysis 是葡萄糖到丙酮酸的胞質分解代謝，並在 Warburg 表型下進一步分解為乳酸，快速產生 ATP 和生物合成中間體。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

context.en-US: Warburg Effect is driven by HIF-1α. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. HIF-1alpha is the oxygen-responsive subunit of the hypoxia-inducible factor that rewires transcription toward glycolysis and angiogenesis under low oxygen. The directionality runs from HIF-1α toward Warburg Effect, so HIF-1α is the active agent and Warburg Effect the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Warburg Effect 由HIF-1α 驅動。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。 HIF-1α 是缺氧誘導因子的氧響應亞基，可在低氧條件下重新連接轉錄以進行糖解作用和血管生成。方向性從 HIF-1α 朝向 Warburg Effect，因此 HIF-1α 是活性劑，Warburg Effect 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Warburg Effect produces Lactate. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. Lactate is the end product of aerobic glycolysis whose export acidifies the tumor microenvironment and fosters invasion and immune suppression. The relationship is directional, with Warburg Effect acting as the operative agent upon Lactate rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Warburg Effect 產生 Lactate。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。 Lactate 是有氧糖解的最終產物，其輸出酸化 Tumor Microenvironment 並促進入侵和免疫抑制。這種關係是有方向的，Warburg Effect 充當 Lactate 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Warburg Effect is driven by MYC. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. MYC is a broadly acting oncogenic transcription factor that drives proliferation, metabolism, and ribosome biogenesis and is deregulated in the majority of cancers. The directionality runs from MYC toward Warburg Effect, so MYC is the active agent and Warburg Effect the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: Warburg Effect 由MYC 驅動。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。 MYC 是一種作用廣泛的致癌轉錄因子，可驅動增殖、代謝和核醣體生物發生，並且在大多數癌症中不受調控。方向性從 MYC 朝向 Warburg Effect，因此 MYC 是活性劑，Warburg Effect 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: Warburg Effect is suppressed by p53. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. p53 is the archetypal tumor-suppressor transcription factor that integrates stress signals into cell-cycle arrest, senescence, or apoptosis. The directionality runs from p53 toward Warburg Effect, so p53 is the active agent and Warburg Effect the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: Warburg Effect 被p53 抑制。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。 p53 是典型的腫瘤抑制轉錄因子，它將壓力訊號整合到細胞週期停滯、老化或凋亡。方向性從 p53 朝向 Warburg Effect，因此 p53 是活性劑，Warburg Effect 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: At Merck, Campbell led the effort to derivatize avermectin B1a into 22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a (ivermectin).
context.zh-TW: 在默克，Campbell 領導了將阿維菌素 B1a 衍生化為 22,23-二氫阿維菌素 B1a（伊維菌素）的工作。

context.en-US: Campbell's avermectin-to-ivermectin development was carried out at Merck & Co.
context.zh-TW: 坎貝爾的阿維菌素到伊維菌素的開發是在默克公司進行的。

subject: William C. Campbell
object: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine

context.en-US: Campbell shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing avermectin into ivermectin.
context.zh-TW: 坎貝爾分享了2015年將阿維菌素發展成伊維菌素的歷程。

context.en-US: XIAP is stabilized by Akt. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Akt is a serine/threonine kinase that phosphorylates a broad panel of substrates to promote growth, glycolysis, and suppression of apoptosis. The directionality runs from Akt toward XIAP, so Akt is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 由 Akt 穩定。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Akt 是一種絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，可磷酸化多種底物，以促進生長、糖解和抑制細胞凋亡。方向性從 Akt 向 XIAP，因此 Akt 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: XIAP inhibits Caspase-3. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. The relationship is directional, with XIAP acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-3 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 抑制 Caspase-3。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。這種關係是有方向的，XIAP 充當 Caspase-3 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: XIAP inhibits Caspase-9. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Caspase-9 is the mitochondrial initiator caspase activated by the apoptosome to launch the execution phase. The relationship is directional, with XIAP acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-9 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 抑制 Caspase-9。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Caspase-9 是粒線體啟動子 caspase，被凋亡體活化以啟動執行階段。這種關係是有方向的，XIAP 充當 Caspase-9 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: XIAP is downregulated by miR-24. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. miR-24 is a microRNA that targets several anti-apoptotic and cell-cycle mRNAs, including XIAP, to lower the death threshold. The directionality runs from miR-24 toward XIAP, so miR-24 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 被 miR-24 下調。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 miR-24 是一種 microRNA，可針對多種抗凋亡和細胞週期 mRNA（包括 XIAP），以降低死亡閾值。方向性從 miR-24 向 XIAP，因此 miR-24 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: XIAP is downregulated by miR-7. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. miR-7 is a microRNA with tumor-suppressive roles that downregulates survival proteins such as XIAP and EGFR signaling. The directionality runs from miR-7 toward XIAP, so miR-7 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 被 miR-7 下調。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 miR-7 是一種具有腫瘤抑製作用的 microRNA，可下調 XIAP 和 EGFR 訊號等存活蛋白。方向性從 miR-7 朝向 XIAP，因此 miR-7 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: XIAP is antagonized by Smac-DIABLO. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. The directionality runs from Smac-DIABLO toward XIAP, so Smac-DIABLO is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 被 Smac-DIABLO 拮抗。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。方向性從 Smac-DIABLO 朝向 XIAP，因此 Smac-DIABLO 是活性劑，並且 XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: XIAP is degraded by TBK1. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. TBK1 is a kinase of the innate immune pathway that phosphorylates XIAP to trigger its autoubiquitination and degradation. The directionality runs from TBK1 toward XIAP, so TBK1 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: XIAP 被 TBK1 降級。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 TBK1 是先天免疫途徑的一種激酶，可磷酸化 XIAP 以觸發其自動泛素化和降解。方向性從 TBK1 朝向 XIAP，因此 TBK1 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: YAP1 promotes Cancer. YAP1 is the transcriptional co-activator of the Hippo pathway that, when nuclear, promotes proliferation and is inhibited by ivermectin in several cancers. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The relationship is directional, with YAP1 acting as the operative agent upon Cancer rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
context.zh-TW: YAP1 促進Cancer。 YAP1 是 Hippo 途徑的轉錄共活化因子，當進入細胞核時，可促進增殖，並在多種癌症中被伊維菌素抑制。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。這種關係是有方向的，YAP1 充當 Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

context.en-US: YAP1 is inhibited by Ivermectin. YAP1 is the transcriptional co-activator of the Hippo pathway that, when nuclear, promotes proliferation and is inhibited by ivermectin in several cancers. Ivermectin is an approved antiparasitic drug repurposed in oncology for its multi-kinase, anti-Wnt, and pro-death activities across cancers. The directionality runs from Ivermectin toward YAP1, so Ivermectin is the active agent and YAP1 the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
context.zh-TW: YAP1 被 Ivermectin 抑制。 YAP1 是 Hippo 途徑的轉錄共活化因子，當進入細胞核時，可促進增殖，並在多種癌症中被伊維菌素抑制。 Ivermectin 是一種經批准的抗寄生蟲藥物，因其在癌症中的多激酶、抗 Wnt 和促死亡活性而被重新用於腫瘤學。方向性從 Ivermectin 朝向 YAP1，因此 Ivermectin 是活性劑，YAP1 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

context.en-US: Prostate cancer is the clearest male-specific malignancy driven by androgen-receptor signaling — the male-androgen pole of hormone-driven cancer biology mirroring the estrogen pole in Breast Cancer. Androgen-AR signaling couples to mTORC1 activation in male cancers, and AR and the PI3K/AKT/mTOR network show reciprocal negative-feedback regulation. ADT (androgen deprivation therapy) is the archetypal male sex-hormone-targeted therapy.
context.zh-TW: 攝護腺癌是由雄激素受體訊號驅動的最明確男性特異惡性腫瘤——荷爾蒙驅動癌症生物學的男性—雄激素極點，鏡像於乳癌的雌激素極點。雄激素-AR 訊號在男性癌症中與 mTORC1 活化相耦合，且 AR 與 PI3K/AKT/mTOR 網絡呈互惠性負回饋調控。ADT（雄激素剝奪療法）是典型的男性性荷爾蒙標靶療法。

context.en-US: Prostate cancer (AR/androgen) and breast cancer (ER/estrogen) are the two poles of a single vault-wide principle: sex-hormone-receptor signaling is the master determinant of hormone-driven tumor biology, and the same hormones drive the sex differences seen throughout Apoptosis, mTORC1, NF-κB, and Senescence.
context.zh-TW: 攝護腺癌（AR/雄激素）與乳癌（ER/雌激素）是單一全域原則的兩極：性荷爾蒙受體訊號是荷爾蒙驅動腫瘤生物學的主要決定因素，且相同荷爾蒙驅動 Apoptosis、mTORC1、NF-κB 與 Senescence 中所見的性別差異。

context.en-US: MOMP is driven by Bim. Bim is a direct Bax/Bak activator sequestered at microtubules and released by stress (e.g. JNK signaling) to trigger MOMP.
context.zh-TW: MOMP 由 Bim 驅動。Bim 是隔離於微管的直接 Bax/Bak 激活因子，受壓力（如 JNK 訊號）釋放以觸發 MOMP。

context.en-US: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
context.zh-TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

context.en-US: AIF mediates caspase-independent cell death. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released via MOMP, drives chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation without caspase activation.
context.zh-TW: AIF 調節不依賴 caspase 的細胞死亡。Apoptosis 誘導因子是粒線體黃素蛋白，經 MOMP 釋放後，不經 caspase 活化即驅動 chromatin condensation 與 DNA 片段化。

context.en-US: Aging is the foremost non-modifiable risk factor for cancer, reflecting accumulated mutations, epigenetic drift, and a senescence-shaped microenvironment.
context.zh-TW: Aging 是癌症最重要的不可改變危險因子，反映累積突變、表觀遺傳漂變與衰老塑造的微環境。

context.en-US: Bim is a direct activator of the effectors Bax and Bak; stress-released Bim triggers Bax oligomerization and MOMP.
context.zh-TW: Bim 是效應因子 Bax 與 Bak 的直接激活因子；壓力釋放的 Bim 觸發 Bax 寡聚化與 MOMP。

context.en-US: Bim binds and neutralizes all major anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 members including Mcl-1, lowering the apoptotic threshold.
context.zh-TW: Bim 結合併中和包括 Mcl-1 在內的主要抗凋亡 Bcl-2 成員，降低凋亡閾值。

context.en-US: Noxa selectively binds Mcl-1 and promotes its degradation, sensitizing cells to mitochondrial apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: Noxa 選擇性結合 Mcl-1 並促進其降解，使細胞對粒線體凋亡敏感化。

context.en-US: The Apaf-1 heptamer recruits pro-Caspase-9 via CARD-CARD interactions, driving its auto-activation and launching the caspase cascade.
context.zh-TW: Apaf-1 七聚體經 CARD-CARD 交互作用招募 pro-Caspase-9，驅動其自我激活並啟動 caspase 級聯。

context.en-US: Cytosolic Cytochrome c binds Apaf-1 (with dATP/ATP), triggering the conformational change and oligomerization that assembles the apoptosome.
context.zh-TW: 細胞質 Cytochrome c 結合 Apaf-1（與 dATP/ATP），觸發構形改變與寡聚化以組裝 Apoptosome。

context.en-US: Mcl-1 sequesters pro-apoptotic effectors including Bax, blocking their oligomerization and raising the MOMP threshold.
context.zh-TW: Mcl-1 隔離包括 Bax 在內的促凋亡效應因子，阻斷其寡聚化並提高 MOMP 閾值。

context.en-US: p53-induced Puma neutralizes anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins and can directly engage Bax/Bak to trigger the intrinsic pathway.
context.zh-TW: p53 誘導的 Puma 中和抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白，並可直接作用於 Bax/Bak 以觸發 Intrinsic Pathway。

context.en-US: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
context.zh-TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

context.en-US: Inactivating APC mutation is the initiating event of the adenoma-carcinoma sequence, driving constitutive Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in most sporadic colon cancers.
context.zh-TW: APC 失活突變是腺瘤–癌序列的起始事件，在多數散發性結腸癌中驅動持續性 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號。

context.en-US: JAK2 trans-phosphorylates downstream STAT factors, notably STAT3, coupling cytokine receptors to proliferation/survival transcription.
context.zh-TW: JAK2 反式磷酸化下游 STAT 因子（特別是 STAT3），將細胞激素受體與增殖/存活轉錄偶聯。

context.en-US: Active Ras-recruited RAF1 phosphorylates MEK1/2, relaying Ras signals through the MAPK/ERK cascade.
context.zh-TW: 被 Ras 招募激活的 RAF1 磷酸化 MEK1/2，經 MAPK/ERK 級聯傳遞 Ras 訊號。

context.en-US: Like other benzimidazoles, albendazole binds the colchicine site of beta-tubulin, blocking polymerization into microtubules.
context.zh-TW: 與其他苯並咪唑一樣，Albendazole 結合 β-tubulin 的秋水仙鹼位點，阻斷其聚合成 Microtubule。

context.en-US: Truncated Bid (tBid), generated by caspase-8/caspase-2 cleavage, translocates to mitochondria and activates Bax/Bak oligomerization that drives MOMP.
context.zh-TW: 截短型 Bid (tBid) 由 caspase-8/caspase-2 切割產生，轉位至粒線體並激活 Bax/Bak 寡聚化以驅動 MOMP。

context.en-US: TRAIL binding induces DR4 trimerization and DISC recruitment, initiating extrinsic apoptosis with tumor selectivity.
context.zh-TW: TRAIL 結合誘發 DR4 三聚化與 DISC 招募，啟動具腫瘤選擇性的外源性凋亡。

context.en-US: DR5 is the primary TRAIL receptor; ligand binding nucleates the DISC to initiate extrinsic apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: DR5 是主要的 TRAIL 受體；配體結合使 DISC 成核以啟動外源性凋亡。

context.en-US: DR5/KILLER is a canonical p53 transcriptional target upregulated after DNA damage, mirroring the p53-Noxa/Puma edges.
context.zh-TW: DR5/KILLER 是典型的 p53 轉錄標的，在 DNA 損傷後上調，呼應 p53-Noxa/Puma 邊。

context.en-US: FADD death-effector domains recruit pro-caspase-8, enabling its autoactivation at the DISC.
context.zh-TW: FADD 死亡效應結構域招募 pro-caspase-8，使其在 DISC 自我活化。

context.en-US: FADD death domains bind activated Fas directly, bridging receptor to caspase-8.
context.zh-TW: FADD 死亡結構域直接結合活化的 Fas，將受體橋接至 caspase-8。

context.en-US: FasL binding induces Fas trimerization, the upstream trigger of FADD/DISC assembly.
context.zh-TW: FasL 結合誘發 Fas 三聚化，是 FADD/DISC 組裝的上游觸發。

context.en-US: TNFR1 death signaling assembles Complex II via TRADD/FADD to activate initiator caspase-8.
context.zh-TW: TNFR1 死亡訊號經 TRADD/FADD 組裝 Complex II 以活化起始 caspase-8。

context.en-US: TNFR1 Complex I drives the pro-survival inflammatory arm via NF-kB activation.
context.zh-TW: TNFR1 Complex I 經由 NF-κB 活化驅動促存活發炎分支。

context.en-US: TRADD is recruited by ligated TNFR1, placing the adaptor downstream of the receptor.
context.zh-TW: TRADD 被結合的 TNFR1 招募，將銜接蛋白置於受體下游。

context.en-US: TRADD nucleates FADD/Complex II assembly leading to caspase-8 activation.
context.zh-TW: TRADD 使 FADD/Complex II 組裝成核，導致 caspase-8 活化。

context.en-US: TRADD Complex I signaling activates NF-kB survival transcription.
context.zh-TW: TRADD Complex I 訊號活化 NF-κB 存活轉錄。

context.en-US: MEK1/2 dual-specificity kinases phosphorylate the ERK Thr+Tyr activation loop, refining the existing is_activated_by edge.
context.zh-TW: MEK1/2 雙特異性激酶磷酸化 ERK Thr+Tyr 活化環，細化既有的 is_activated_by 邊。

context.en-US: BRAF phosphorylates MEK downstream of RAS, paralleling the covered RAF1 edge as a distinct entity.
context.zh-TW: BRAF 在 RAS 下游磷酸化 MEK，與已涵蓋的 RAF1 邊平行但為不同實體。

context.en-US: ERK phosphorylates Bim at Ser69 and related sites, priming its ubiquitination and degradation.
context.zh-TW: ERK 在 Ser69 等位點磷酸化 Bim，促使其泛素化與降解。

context.en-US: ERK phosphorylation of Mcl-1 at T163 blocks the GSK3 phosphodegron cascade, stabilizing the protein.
context.zh-TW: ERK 在 T163 磷酸化 Mcl-1 阻斷 GSK3 磷酸降解決聯，穩定蛋白。

context.en-US: RSK is the canonical ERK effector kinase transducing MAPK output to survival and death substrates.
context.zh-TW: RSK 是典型的 ERK 效應激酶，將 MAPK 輸出傳遞至存活與死亡受質。

context.en-US: RSK phosphorylates the Bim S93/S94/S98 degron primed by ERK Ser69, feeding SCF-Beta-TrCP turnover.
context.zh-TW: RSK 磷酸化經 ERK Ser69 啟動的 Bim S93/S94/S98 降解子，供養 SCF-Beta-TrCP 週轉。

context.en-US: RSK phosphorylates pro-apoptotic Bad, contributing to its inactivation.
context.zh-TW: RSK 磷酸化促凋亡 Bad，促使其失活。

context.en-US: RSK-primed phospho-Bim is recognized by SCF-Beta-TrCP for proteasomal degradation.
context.zh-TW: RSK 啟動的磷酸化 Bim 被 SCF-Beta-TrCP 辨識以蛋白酶體降解。

context.en-US: Phospho-Bim is recognized by the E3 ligase c-CBL for proteasomal degradation.
context.zh-TW: 磷酸化 Bim 被 E3 連接酶 c-CBL 辨識以蛋白酶體降解。

context.en-US: JNK phosphorylation at Thr112/Ser65 activates Bim pro-apoptotic function, opposing ERK.
context.zh-TW: JNK 在 Thr112/Ser65 的磷酸化活化 Bim 促凋亡功能，與 ERK 相反。

context.en-US: RSK installs the S93/S94/S98 degron on Bim downstream of ERK priming.
context.zh-TW: RSK 在 ERK 啟動下游於 Bim 安裝 S93/S94/S98 降解子。

context.en-US: The CDK1-cyclin B1 complex constitutes MPF driving G2/M entry; the cyclin box binds and activates CDK1.
context.zh-TW: CDK1-cyclin B1 複合體構成驅動 G2/M 進入的 MPF；cyclin box 結合並活化 CDK1。

context.en-US: The CIP1 inhibitor p21 restrains CDK1 activity, enforcing checkpoint arrest.
context.zh-TW: CIP1 抑制因子 p21 約束 CDK1 活性，執行檢查點停滯。

context.en-US: Cyclin D1 is the catalytic partner of CDK4 driving Rb phosphorylation and G1 progression.
context.zh-TW: Cyclin D1 是 CDK4 的催化夥伴，驅動 Rb 磷酸化與 G1 進展。

context.en-US: Cyclin D1 belongs to the D-type cyclin family governing G1 CDK4/6 activation.
context.zh-TW: Cyclin D1 屬於掌管 G1 CDK4/6 活化的 D 型 cyclin 家族。

context.en-US: CDK1 phosphorylates caspase-9 at Thr125, suppressing it as a mitotic death gate.
