context.zh-TW: MYC 高細胞依賴麩醯胺酸作為 TCA 碳燃料。

source_document: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md

subject: Complex I

context.en-US: Respiratory Complex I regenerates NAD+ from NADH, coupling OXPHOS to TCA flux.
context.zh-TW: 呼吸複合體 I 從 NADH 再生 NAD+，將 OXPHOS 耦合到 TCA 通量。

source_document: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md

subject: Mubritinib

context.en-US: Mubritinib inhibits the Complex I Q-site with high MYC selectivity.
context.zh-TW: Mubritinib 抑制 Complex I Q 位點，具高度 MYC 選擇性。

source_document: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md

subject: CB-839

context.en-US: CB-839 blocks the first step of glutaminolysis at glutaminase.
context.zh-TW: CB-839 在麩醯胺酸酶阻斷麩醯胺酸分解第一步。

source_document: _document_ - Complex I drives glutamine-dependent TCA cycle to support viability of MYChigh breast cancer cells (NAD+).md

context.en-US: NAD+ availability sustains sirtuin deacetylase resilience programs.
context.zh-TW: NAD+ 可用性維持 sirtuin 去乙醯化韌性程序。

context.en-US: Necroptosis is a NCCD-standard regulated death modality distinct from apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: Necroptosis 是與凋亡不同的 NCCD 標準受調控死亡形式。

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent regulated death modality.
context.zh-TW: Ferroptosis 是鐵依賴的受調控死亡形式。

context.en-US: Apoptosis is the classic programmed arm of regulated cell death.
context.zh-TW: Apoptosis 是受調控細胞死亡的典型程序臂。

context.en-US: Glutathione keeps lipid peroxides sub-toxic via GPX4, suppressing ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Glutathione 經 GPX4 使脂質過氧化物維持次毒性，抑制 Ferroptosis。

context.en-US: Chromatin compaction is a defining nuclear hallmark of apoptotic execution.
context.zh-TW: 染色質緻密是凋亡執行的定義性核標誌。

context.en-US: Blebbing is the execution-phase morphological signature of apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 起泡是凋亡執行期的形態特徵。

context.en-US: Caspase-3 removes the inhibitory C-terminal fragment of ROCK1, activating it.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-3 移除 ROCK1 抑制性 C 端片段以活化之。

context.en-US: Active ROCK1 drives MLC phosphorylation and actomyosin contraction producing blebs.
context.zh-TW: 活化的 ROCK1 驅動 MLC 磷酸化與肌動球蛋白收縮產生泡。

context.en-US: Erlotinib selectively blocks the EGFR ATP pocket, mirroring the melittin edge.
context.zh-TW: erlotinib 選擇性阻斷 EGFR ATP 口袋，呼應 melittin 邊。

context.en-US: Erlotinib is an anilinoquinazoline EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor.
context.zh-TW: erlotinib 是 anilinoquinazoline EGFR 酪胺酸激酶抑制劑。

context.en-US: EGFR blockade restores apoptotic competency in EGFR-addicted tumors.
context.zh-TW: EGFR 阻斷在 EGFR 成癮腫瘤恢復凋亡能力。

context.en-US: Erlotinib is approved with gemcitabine for pancreatic cancer.
context.zh-TW: erlotinib 與 gemcitabine 合併核准用於胰臟癌。

context.en-US: Trastuzumab binds the HER2 extracellular subdomain IV.
context.zh-TW: trastuzumab 結合 HER2 胞外第四次結構域。

context.en-US: Trastuzumab is a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody.
context.zh-TW: trastuzumab 是人源化 IgG1 單株抗體。

context.en-US: Trastuzumab is approved for HER2-positive gastric cancer, the second indication.
context.zh-TW: trastuzumab 核准用於 HER2 陽性胃癌，為第二適應症。

context.en-US: Paclitaxel is a listed systemic indication for breast cancer beyond ovarian use.
context.zh-TW: paclitaxel 是乳癌列載的全身性適應症，超出卵巢用途。

context.en-US: Docetaxel is a backbone TNBC regimen with melittin-combo data.
context.zh-TW: docetaxel 是 TNBC 主幹方案，具 melittin 合併數據。

context.en-US: SN-38 traps the topoisomerase I cleavage complex, causing fork-collision breaks.
context.zh-TW: SN-38 捕獲拓樸異構酶 I 切割複合體，導致複製叉碰撞斷裂。

context.en-US: Irinotecan is a cytotoxic camptothecin-analog chemotherapy.
context.zh-TW: irinotecan 是細胞毒性喜樹鹼類似物化療藥。

context.en-US: Topoisomerase-I-mediated DSBs drive p53 apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: 拓樸異構酶 I 介導的 DSB 驅動 p53 凋亡。

context.en-US: Irinotecan is a flagship colorectal cancer therapeutic.
context.zh-TW: irinotecan 是結直腸癌旗艦治療藥。

context.en-US: FOLFIRI is a primary systemic regimen for colorectal cancer.
context.zh-TW: FOLFIRI 是結直腸癌主要全身性方案。

context.en-US: Irinotecan is the topoisomerase-I component of FOLFIRI.
context.zh-TW: irinotecan 是 FOLFIRI 的拓樸異構酶 I 成分。

context.en-US: FOLFIRI is a 5-FU/leucovorin/irinotecan chemotherapy regimen.
context.zh-TW: FOLFIRI 是 5-FU/亞葉酸/irinotecan 化療方案。

context.en-US: FOLFIRI downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 84 percent, detectable 24 hours post-dose.
context.zh-TW: FOLFIRI 下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 84%，給藥 24 小時可測。

context.en-US: FOLFIRI reduces muscle NAD+ by 18 percent and liver NAD+ by 20 percent.
context.zh-TW: FOLFIRI 減少肌肉 NAD+ 18% 與肝 NAD+ 20%。

context.en-US: Prolonged FOLFIRI contributes to muscle loss and chemo-induced cachexia.
context.zh-TW: 長期 FOLFIRI 促成肌肉流失與化療誘發惡病質。

context.en-US: FOLFOX is a 5-FU/leucovorin/oxaliplatin chemotherapy regimen.
context.zh-TW: FOLFOX 是 5-FU/亞葉酸/oxaliplatin 化療方案。

context.en-US: FOLFOX downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 92 percent with high significance.
context.zh-TW: FOLFOX 高顯著下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 92%。

context.en-US: FOLFOX reduces hepatic NAD+ by 15 percent while muscle NAD+ is preserved.
context.zh-TW: FOLFOX 減少肝 NAD+ 15%，肌肉 NAD+ 保留。

context.en-US: FOLFOX causes mild muscle loss, contributing to chemo-induced cachexia.
context.zh-TW: FOLFOX 導致輕度肌肉流失，促成化療誘發惡病質。

context.en-US: Sotorasib covalently occupies the KRAS G12C switch-II pocket, locking the GDP state.
context.zh-TW: Sotorasib 共價佔據 KRAS G12C switch-II 口袋，鎖定 GDP 狀態。

context.en-US: Sotorasib is approved for KRAS G12C non-small-cell lung cancer.
context.zh-TW: Sotorasib 核准用於 KRAS G12C 非小細胞肺癌。

context.en-US: The antisense Oblimersen lowers Bcl-2 protein via RNase-H mRNA cleavage.
context.zh-TW: 反義 Oblimersen 經 RNase-H mRNA 切割降低 Bcl-2 蛋白。

context.en-US: Oblimersen sensitizes tumors to cytotoxics, mirroring the BH3-mimetic synergy.
context.zh-TW: Oblimersen 使腫瘤對細胞毒藥物敏感化，呼應 BH3 模擬物協同。

context.en-US: Oblimersen lowers the mitochondrial brake threshold, enabling MOMP.
context.zh-TW: Oblimersen 降低粒線體煞車閾值，促成 MOMP。

context.en-US: Cilengitide antagonizes alphav-beta3/beta5 integrins at the ligand pocket.
context.zh-TW: Cilengitide 在配體口袋拮抗 αvβ3/β5 integrin。

context.en-US: Cilengitide is a cyclic RGD pentapeptide derivative.
context.zh-TW: Cilengitide 是環狀 RGD 五肽衍生物。

context.en-US: Cilengitide was designed anti-angiogenic; phase III missed OS so the edge is investigational.
context.zh-TW: Cilengitide 設計為抗血管生成；第三期未達 OS 故此邊為研究性。

context.en-US: iRGD homes to alphav tumor vasculature via its RGD motif as step one.
context.zh-TW: iRGD 經 RGD 基序歸巢 αv 腫瘤血管作為第一步。

context.en-US: iRGD is engineered from the parent RGD motif plus a CendR element.
context.zh-TW: iRGD 由母 RGD 基序加 CendR 元件工程化。

context.en-US: Cleaved CendR engages Neuropilin-1 for tumor penetration as step two.
context.zh-TW: 切割的 CendR 接合 Neuropilin-1 以腫瘤穿透作為第二步。

context.en-US: CendR-receptor binding triggers transcytosis and tissue penetration.
context.zh-TW: CendR-受體結合觸發胞吞轉運與組織穿透。

subject: RGD peptide

context.en-US: Unconjugated RGD blocks integrin-ligand interaction, limiting vessel formation.
context.zh-TW: 未偶聯 RGD 阻斷 integrin-配體交互，限制血管形成。

source_document: _document_ - RGD peptide in cancer targeting Benefits, challenges, solutions, and possible integrin–RGD interactions.md

context.en-US: The Neuropilin-1 b1/b2 domain binds VEGF165 as co-receptor.
context.zh-TW: Neuropilin-1 b1/b2 結構域結合 VEGF165 作為共受體。

context.en-US: Neuropilin-1 amplifies VEGF-driven vessel formation.
context.zh-TW: Neuropilin-1 放大 VEGF 驅動的血管形成。

context.en-US: Neuropilin-1 is overexpressed on endothelial and tumor cells.
context.zh-TW: Neuropilin-1 在內皮與腫瘤細胞過度表現。

context.en-US: Neuropilin-1 leaky vasculature enables pro-invasive dissemination.
context.zh-TW: Neuropilin-1 通透血管促成促侵襲播散。

context.en-US: Neuropilin-1 potentiates VEGFR2 signaling as co-receptor.
context.zh-TW: Neuropilin-1 作為共受體增強 VEGFR2 訊號。

context.en-US: The RGD tripeptide is the minimal alphav-family integrin binding motif.
context.zh-TW: RGD 三肽是最小的 αv 家族 integrin 結合基序。

context.en-US: Alphav-beta3/beta5 integrins directly form neovessels.
context.zh-TW: αvβ3/β5 integrin 直接形成新生血管。

context.en-US: Integrins enable invasion and anchorage-independent survival.
context.zh-TW: Integrin 促成侵襲與非錨定依賴存活。

context.en-US: Integrin survival signaling resists cytotoxic therapy.
context.zh-TW: Integrin 存活訊號抵抗細胞毒治療。

context.en-US: Outside-in integrin signaling activates MAPK via FAK/SRC.
context.zh-TW: 由外而內 integrin 訊號經 FAK/SRC 活化 MAPK。

context.en-US: Tumor exosomes traffic microRNA cargo between cells.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤外泌體在細胞間運送 microRNA 貨物。

context.en-US: Exosomal vesicle communication shapes TME composition.
context.zh-TW: 外泌體囊泡通訊塑造 TME 組成。

context.en-US: Exosomal DNA activates recipient-cell cGAS-STING signaling.
context.zh-TW: 外泌體 DNA 活化受體細胞 cGAS-STING 訊號。

context.en-US: Tumor exosomes transfer oncoproteins driving vessel formation.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤外泌體轉移致癌蛋白驅動血管形成。

context.en-US: Ki-67 is the standard immunohistochemical proliferation biomarker.
context.zh-TW: Ki-67 是標準的免疫組織化學增殖生物標記。

context.en-US: Ki-67 is expressed in G1 through M phases of the cell cycle.
context.zh-TW: Ki-67 在細胞週期 G1 至 M 期表現。

context.en-US: Elevated Ki-67 index tracks TNBC aggressiveness.
context.zh-TW: 升高的 Ki-67 指數追蹤 TNBC 侵襲性。

context.en-US: Importin-beta1 KPNB1 mediates NLS-dependent nuclear import as its primary function.
context.zh-TW: Importin-β1 KPNB1 以 NLS 依賴核輸入為主要功能。

context.en-US: Ivermectin blocks KPNB1-dependent cell-cycle progression and survival.
context.zh-TW: Ivermectin 阻斷 KPNB1 依賴的細胞週期進展與存活。

context.en-US: KPNB1 is a druggable essential survival oncogene in ovarian cancer models.
context.zh-TW: KPNB1 在卵巢癌模型是可藥物化的必要存活致癌基因。

context.en-US: KPNB1 loss induces apoptosis, marking KPNB1 as a death suppressor.
context.zh-TW: KPNB1 缺失誘發凋亡，標記 KPNB1 為死亡抑制因子。

context.en-US: Cisplatin downregulates muscle Nrk2 by 93 percent with high significance.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 高顯著下調肌肉 Nrk2 達 93%。

context.en-US: NRK2 is the consistent earliest responder suppressed across chemo models.
context.zh-TW: NRK2 是化療模型一致最早反應的被抑制者。

context.en-US: Cisplatin depletes muscle NAD+ by 14 percent with NADH/NADPH declines.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 耗竭肌肉 NAD+ 14% 併 NADH/NADPH 下降。

context.en-US: Doxorubicin single-dose ranks Nrk2 the top downregulated muscle transcript.
context.zh-TW: Doxorubicin 單劑使 Nrk2 居肌肉下調轉錄首位。

context.en-US: Chemotherapy alone induces cachexia-like signatures even without tumor.
context.zh-TW: 化療單獨即誘發惡病質樣特徵，無需腫瘤。

context.en-US: NRK2 is the muscle-specific NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme.
context.zh-TW: NRK2 是肌肉特異的 NAD+ 生合成酶。

context.en-US: ABCB1/P-gp efflux is the canonical docetaxel resistance mechanism.
context.zh-TW: ABCB1/P-gp 外排是典型的 docetaxel 抗性機制。

context.en-US: The metaplasia-dysplasia-carcinoma cascade from Barrett's esophagus to adenocarcinoma is textbook.
context.zh-TW: Barrett 食道至腺癌的化生—異生—癌級聯是教科書等級。

context.en-US: Chronic reflux is the primary etiological driver of Barrett's-to-adenocarcinoma progression.
context.zh-TW: 慢性逆流是 Barrett 至腺癌進展的主要病因驅動。

context.en-US: EBV is the established etiologic driver of nasopharyngeal carcinoma oncogenesis.
context.zh-TW: EBV 是鼻咽癌致癌的既定病因驅動。

context.en-US: Oral SCC belongs to the anatomical head-and-neck cancer parent class.
context.zh-TW: 口腔鱗癌屬於解剖學頭頸癌母類。

context.en-US: Mitochondrial SIRT3 overexpression supports OSCC growth and chemo/radio-resistance.
context.zh-TW: 粒線體 SIRT3 過度表現支持口腔鱗癌生長與化放療抗性。

context.en-US: Cisplatin is the standard chemotherapy backbone for cervical cancer.
context.zh-TW: Cisplatin 是子宮頸癌標準化療主幹。

context.en-US: PDAC is the dominant histology within the pancreatic cancer parent category.
context.zh-TW: PDAC 是胰臟癌母類中的主要組織學。

context.en-US: Oncogenic KRAS drives over 90 percent of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
context.zh-TW: 致癌 KRAS 驅動逾九成胰管腺癌。

context.en-US: DLBCL is an aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtype.
context.zh-TW: DLBCL 是侵襲性 B 細胞非何杰金淋巴瘤亞型。

context.en-US: R-CHOP is the standard first-line regimen for DLBCL.
context.zh-TW: R-CHOP 是 DLBCL 標準一線方案。

context.en-US: t(14;18)-driven Bcl-2 overexpression is the hallmark lesion of follicular lymphoma.
context.zh-TW: t(14;18) 驅動的 Bcl-2 過度表現是濾泡淋巴瘤標誌病灶。

context.en-US: Anti-CD20 rituximab is the backbone of B-cell NHL regimens.
context.zh-TW: 抗 CD20 rituximab 是 B 細胞 NHL 方案主幹。

context.en-US: APL is the M3 subtype of acute myeloid leukemia.
context.zh-TW: APL 是急性骨髓性白血病的 M3 亞型。

context.en-US: The PML-RARA fusion oncoprotein defines acute promyelocytic leukaemia.
context.zh-TW: PML-RARA 融合致癌蛋白定義急性前骨髓球白血病。

context.en-US: EGFR mutation is a major driver and therapeutic target in NSCLC.
context.zh-TW: EGFR 突變是 NSCLC 主要驅動與治療標靶。

context.en-US: KRAS mutation is a frequent adenocarcinoma driver in NSCLC.
context.zh-TW: KRAS 突變是 NSCLC 常見的腺癌驅動。

context.en-US: TNBC is a breast cancer subtype defined by absent ER/PR/HER2 receptors.
context.zh-TW: TNBC 是以 ER/PR/HER2 受體缺失定義的乳癌亞型。

context.en-US: EGFR is frequently overexpressed in triple-negative breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: EGFR 在三陰性乳癌經常過度表現。

context.en-US: Roughly half of TNBC is MYC-high with OXPHOS/Complex I vulnerability.
context.zh-TW: 約半數 TNBC 為 MYC 高並具 OXPHOS/Complex I 脆弱性。

context.en-US: HER2-enriched cancer is a molecular subtype of breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: HER2 富集癌是乳癌的分子亞型。

context.en-US: HER2 amplification is the defining driver receptor of this subtype.
context.zh-TW: HER2 擴增是此亞型的定義性驅動受體。

context.en-US: Trastuzumab is the standard anti-HER2 antibody for this subtype.
context.zh-TW: trastuzumab 是此亞型的標準抗 HER2 抗體。

context.en-US: Cytarabine is the nucleoside-analog backbone of leukemia therapy, synergizing with ivermectin.
context.zh-TW: cytarabine 是白血病治療的核苷類似物主幹，與 ivermectin 協同。

context.en-US: Daunorubicin is the anthracycline of the 7+3 leukemia backbone.
context.zh-TW: Daunorubicin 是白血病 7+3 主幹的蒽環類藥。

context.en-US: Xp11 translocation RCC is a renal cell carcinoma subtype.
context.zh-TW: Xp11 易位 RCC 是腎細胞癌亞型。

context.en-US: Rearranged TFE3 transcription factor defines Xp11 translocation RCC.
context.zh-TW: 重排的 TFE3 轉錄因子定義 Xp11 易位 RCC。

context.en-US: Germline LKB1/STK11 loss causes Peutz-Jeghers syndrome.
context.zh-TW: 生殖系 LKB1/STK11 缺失導致 Peutz-Jeghers 症候群。

context.en-US: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome markedly elevates pancreatic cancer risk.
context.zh-TW: Peutz-Jeghers 症候群顯著提高胰臟癌風險。

context.en-US: miR-24 tunes the death threshold in cancer cells via XIAP and related targets.
context.zh-TW: miR-24 經 XIAP 等標的調節癌細胞死亡閾值。

context.en-US: EGFR is the principal directly-repressed RTK target restraining proliferation.
context.zh-TW: EGFR 是主要的直接抑制 RTK 標的以約束增殖。

context.en-US: miR-101 directly targets anti-apoptotic Mcl-1.
context.zh-TW: miR-101 直接標靶抗凋亡 Mcl-1。

context.en-US: miR-101 unleashes Bax-dependent death via Mcl-1 suppression.
context.zh-TW: miR-101 經 Mcl-1 抑制釋放 Bax 依賴死亡。

context.en-US: miR-29b directly targets pro-survival Mcl-1.
context.zh-TW: miR-29b 直接標靶促存活 Mcl-1。

context.en-US: miR-29b targets DNMT3a; its loss reinforces leukemic hypermethylation.
context.zh-TW: miR-29b 標靶 DNMT3a；其缺失強化白血病高甲基化。

context.en-US: N-Myc is a MYC-family oncogenic transcription factor.
context.zh-TW: N-Myc 是 MYC 家族致癌轉錄因子。

context.en-US: N-Myc obligately heterodimerizes with MAX for DNA binding.
context.zh-TW: N-Myc 與 MAX 專性異二聚化以結合 DNA。

context.en-US: COX-2 is the rate-limiting synthetic enzyme for prostaglandin E2.
context.zh-TW: COX-2 是前列腺素 E2 的速率限制合成酶。

context.en-US: NSAIDs pharmacologically block prostaglandin E2 synthesis.
context.zh-TW: NSAID 藥理阻斷前列腺素 E2 合成。

context.en-US: Prostaglandin E2 is a key lipid mediator of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.
context.zh-TW: 前列腺素 E2 是衰老相關分泌表型的關鍵脂質介體。

context.en-US: Checkpoint inhibitors prototypically block the PD-1 receptor to release T-cell brakes.
context.zh-TW: 檢查點抑制劑典型阻斷 PD-1 受體以釋放 T 細胞煞車。

context.en-US: Checkpoint inhibitors block the PD-L1 ligand, restoring T-cell function.
context.zh-TW: 檢查點抑制劑阻斷 PD-L1 配體，恢復 T 細胞功能。

context.en-US: Pembrolizumab is the prototypical PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor.
context.zh-TW: Pembrolizumab 是典型的 PD-1 檢查點抑制劑。

context.en-US: The VEGF family canonically drives blood-vessel formation.
context.zh-TW: VEGF 家族典型驅動血管形成。

context.en-US: VEGF-C is a lymphangiogenic member of the VEGF family.
context.zh-TW: VEGF-C 是 VEGF 家族的淋巴管生成成員。

context.en-US: VEGF is the primary ligand activating VEGFR2 blood-vascular signaling.
context.zh-TW: VEGF 是活化 VEGFR2 血液血管訊號的主要配體。

context.en-US: VEGFR2 transduces the blood-vascular angiogenic output.
context.zh-TW: VEGFR2 傳導血液血管生成輸出。

context.en-US: VEGFR2 is a vascular-endothelial-growth-factor-receptor family member.
context.zh-TW: VEGFR2 是血管內皮生長因子受體家族成員。

context.en-US: VEGF-C is the primary ligand defining the VEGFR3 lymphatic axis.
context.zh-TW: VEGF-C 是定義 VEGFR3 淋巴軸的主要配體。

context.en-US: TGF-beta3 drives epithelial-mesenchymal transition in late-stage signaling.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β3 在晚期訊號驅動上皮間質轉化。

context.en-US: TGF-beta3 is a ligand isoform of the TGF-beta superfamily.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β3 是 TGF-β 超家族的配體亞型。

context.en-US: TGF-beta superfamily signaling enforces growth arrest in recipient cells.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β 超家族訊號在受體細胞執行生長停滯。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole is under preclinical investigation for cholangiocarcinoma as part of the repurposed anthelmintic anticancer cluster.
